# Flow: DASH Ai · Trading rules (`dash`)

> One self-contained file for converting this flow to another platform. Read https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/CONVERT.md first. Design system: Lemonnade V3 @ `cdf73c6` (components, tokens and rules: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonnade-v3-docs/llms.txt).

Describe a trading habit; DASH builds it into a rule, backtests it, saves it. Your active rules, on / off, delete.

Prototype: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/dash · machine-readable: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/dash.json

```
dash-06 Proceed ─▶ backtest ─▶ dash-07 (saved) | dash-08 (cost) | dash-09 (no data)     · refine ─▶ dash-05
dash-07/08/09 rule description ─▶ dash-10/11/12 (Okay ─▶ back) · Yes, save it / No, save as it is ─▶ dash-13
dash-08 Yes, improve my rule ─▶ dash-05
dash-13 View Rules ─▶ dash-14 · Cancel ─▶ back to the chat

home / empty chat top bar: history ─▶ Past chats sheet (dash-30) · Your creations ─▶ dash-14
Past chats sheet: a row ─▶ its chat · hold a row ─▶ Delete this chat ─▶ Delete this chat? ─Yes─▶ back to the sheet, row gone
a started chat's top bar: ⋮ ─▶ dropdown: Past chats ─▶ dash-30 · Your creations ─▶ dash-14 · Delete this chat ─▶ Delete this chat? ─Yes─▶ home
home Pick up where you left off: a card ─▶ its chat · View all ─▶ dash-30 · (compact card) hold ─▶ Delete this draft?

dash-02 Create Custom Indicator ─▶ dash-20 ─prompt─▶ dash-21 ─chart─▶ dash-22 ─timeframe─▶ dash-23 ─built─▶ dash-24
dash-24 Modify ─▶ DASH asks for a manual change ─send─▶ same preview + Modify / Save indicator · Save indicator ─▶ dash-25
dash-25 View indicator ─▶ fno-06 Scalper (Indicators sheet open, saved DASH indicator in Your indicators)
```

### Data

`data.ts` (types = the API contract, values = examples):
- `examplePrompts: string[][]` — the example rows on `dash-03`; a tap sends the prompt as the user's message.
- DASH's turn: `RuleQuestion { question, options[], freeText }` (a follow-up), then a `DraftRule { title, value, description }`.
- `Backtest` on the user's last N months: `{ result: 'saved', amount, months }` · `{ result: 'cost', amount, months }` ·
  `{ result: 'none' }`. `saved` = the rule would have stopped losses; `cost` = it would have stopped trades that ended in
  profit (DASH calls the rule weak); `none` = not enough history.
- `SavedRule { id, title, summary, on, activity: { text, strong?, after? } }` — the Active rules list. `activity` is the
  footer line ("Stepped in **3 times** this month"), `strong` the bold part.
- `PastChat { id, kind: 'rule' | 'indicator', title, day, time, saved, edited? }` — chat history (Past chats, dash-30).
  `saved` = the rule / indicator the chat built was saved. Newest first.
- **Pick up where you left off** (home, setting "Resume chats") = `pastChats` where `saved === false` only
  (`homeDrafts` is derived from them). A chat whose creation was saved is **never** shown upfront: the creation is in
  Your creations and the chat stays in Past chats. No unsaved chats → no section (the home's centre-stage layout).
- First name for greetings comes from the app's user (`Rohan` — fictional; Figma's "Samaira" isn't used).

| Rule card | DASH `RuleCard` + `BacktestStrip` | Orb sm + name, dashed line, value chip (preview) or 2-line description + chevron (→ read more); strip tinted by result |

### Rules and edge cases

- The chat dock shows the input, **or** DASH's question card instead of it while DASH waits for an answer.
- Once DASH has a draft, the rule card stays pinned under the top bar; only DASH's latest turn shows below it.
- The backtest strip: saved → green (trending up, amount in success green); cost → red (trending down, amount in error
  red) and the whole page glow turns red; none → grey (! icon), and the read-more sheet has no backtest line.
- A long rule summary on Active rules wraps to 2 lines, then "…".
- Switch changes are instant (no confirm). Delete always asks first.
- Create Custom Strategy (landing) is another DASH flow — not designed yet.
- **Top bar actions.** On the home and in an empty chat: two Tertiary actions — history (→ Past chats) then widgets
  (→ Your creations). As soon as a chat has started (a message sent, or a past chat / draft opened): **one ⋮ menu**
  instead, a small dropdown that opens over it (`components/ChatMenu`) with Past chats · Your creations · Delete this chat.
- **Delete this chat** asks first (large header + bin): "Delete this chat?" with a checkbox **"Also delete what this
  chat created" — off by default**. One chat can create several things of any kind (rules, indicators, strategies — the
  field's Rule · Indicator · Strategy pills only hint DASH, they don't limit the chat), so the checkbox covers all of
  them. Off: only the conversation goes, its creations stay in Your creations. On: they're deleted too. Then back to
  the home.
- Drafts on the home: tap opens the chat; the compact card's press-and-hold (0.5 s) asks "Delete this draft?".
- The custom-indicator preview has a secondary **Modify** button with an edit icon and a primary **Save indicator** button.
  Modify opens a manual text prompt in the chat. Its submitted reply keeps the illustrative preview and returns to the
  same actions. Saving removes the preview card and adds DASH's saved confirmation with **View indicator**, which opens
  Scalper.

### Differences from Figma

- **L3 parts replace the old ones:** Actionbar (its Tertiary action instead of the grey 32 circles), L3 coach mark
  (light, with its own button) instead of the black tooltip, L3 bottom sheets and button docks, L3 Switch / Avatar
  (neutral initials — Figma's coloured discs aren't an L3 Avatar option).
- **Sheets over the current screens:** Figma's "Rule saved", "Delete rule" and "Rule deleted" sit over older versions
  (a checklist card; an Active / Paused list with Edit buttons). Here they sit over the current screens.
- **Copy fixes:** "No, I want refine" → "No, I want to refine"; the card's garbled "once your daily reach daily
  limit…" → the full sentence (cut at 2 lines); "I would suggest you to improve" → "I would suggest you improve";
  "Let me know what would you like…" → "what you would like…".
- **One loss number:** the card says ₹22,390, Figma's sheet ₹22,300 → ₹22,390 in both.
- **Entry:** the DASH pill and its first-visit coach mark live on the Stocks home (`stocks-01`, `stocks-08`), not in this flow; `dash-01` was removed (2026-10-22). Ids start at `dash-02`.
- **Status bar:** takes L3 brand-light on pages with the glow at the top (the nearest surface to the glow); Figma draws
  the glow under the status bar.
- The white 10% blur glass layer over the glow is left out (no visible difference).

### L3 gaps

- An **AI accent family** (DASH green `#50c83e`, glow lime / yellow / green) — local tokens `--app-dash-*`.
- No **menu / dropdown** component — the chat's ⋮ dropdown is L3 ListCell rows on a raised surface (`components/ChatMenu`, local token `--app-dash-menu-width`).
- SectionHeader: no **icon** slot before the title (“Your creations” puts the icon in the title).
- ListCell: a tappable card has no **flat** option (no drop shadow) — Past chats overrides it locally.
- Actionbar: no **see-through** option for decorative backgrounds (`DashBar` clears its surface and hairline).
- **Chat** components: chat input, message, quick-reply chip, prompt chip, question card.
- A **tracked caps** label style (Figma 1.92 = 16%) · a float shadow `0 4 6 / 6% + 0 1 1 / 4%`.
- Avatar with **coloured initials** (Figma: teal, indigo, yellow, purple).

### Structure (Figma "DASH AI - better layout & structure", file 9r61YQp7QQZAQovDyz8hLF, 6499:1405)

DASH is **one screen** (`screens/DashAI.tsx`) — like ChatGPT or Claude, nothing inside it is a new page:

| Layer | What | Changes? |
|---|---|---|
| Background (`components/DashScreen`) | rotating lime gradient (one turn / 3.08 s), white blurred disc, grid at the top | Never moves between scenes (Figma annotation). Ends above the keyboard while typing; turns red on a costly backtest |
| Top bar (`DashBar`) | back · your rules (Tertiary Small, `fact_check`) — no title | Never moves |
| Scene (`components/SceneSwap`) | landing · Trading rules chat · Custom indicator chat | Landing ↔ chat: the body pushes (300 ms, ease in and out — Figma Push + match layers) |

Inside a chat scene (`RuleScene`, `IndicatorScene`): pinned card · scrolling conversation · input dock · keyboard.
- **Empty → typing** (tap the input, `dash-26`): heading and examples fold away, the orb glides to the middle, the input
  edge turns DASH green and Send turns on, the keyboard rises and the background shrinks above it (300 ms). Tap the
  body to go back.
- **Empty → conversation** (a chip, or typed text): the intro dissolves while the conversation panel (white fading
  down, top corners 32) dissolves in (300 ms); the message flies up into its bubble.
- Example prompts drift sideways endlessly (row 1 left, row 2 right, 40 s per loop), pausing under a finger.
- Input states: default (border-light, Send off until there's text) · typing (DASH green edge, Send on).
- **Indicator card → mini** (ready / on chart): the user scrolls the chat down → chart, chips, notes and button fold
  away and an 80 × 40 chart preview slides in beside the name (300 ms, ease in and out). Back at the top (scroll up)
  or a tap on it → it opens again. Programmatic scrolling (to the newest message) never folds it.

### Motion (from the live app's recording, 2026-10-23, measured at 360 dp)

| Moment | What moves | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Send (`dash-03 → 04`, one screen) | The tapped chip — or the typed text — flies up and becomes the user's message; the greeting, orb and examples lift and fade; the panel and the title fade in; the glow glides from the bottom to the header | fly 450 ms; intro out 300 ms; glow + panel 600 ms; the thinking dots wait for the message to land |
| Chat steps (`dash-03 … 13`) | ONE screen in different states, like ChatGPT / Claude (preview `group: 'chat'`): the empty state, the conversation, the pinned rule preview and the result all change in place — nothing is pushed in | — |
| A new message | Fades up 8 into place; earlier messages stay (the conversation builds up) and the panel scrolls to the newest | 250 ms, decelerate |
| DASH thinks | Three dots pulse in turn, after the request and after every answer / Proceed | ~1.6 s in the prototype (live 1.5–3 s) |
| DASH's question | The card rises 24 out of the input's place | 250 ms, decelerate |
| Answered | The question and the answer join the chat; the input drops back from where the card was | 150 ms |
| Draft ready | The rule card opens in the top bar's bottom slot and pushes the chat down | 300 ms (grid rows 0 → 1, fade) |
| Backtest back | The strip unfolds under the card; the description fades in | 300 ms / 250 ms |
| Rule created | Sheet up; green disc pops in (slight overshoot), the tick draws itself, confetti (green · yellow · white/lime) bursts out and drifts down | pop 400 ms from 150 ms; tick 250 ms from 350 ms; confetti 1.6 s |
| View Rules | The tick turns away like a coin, then the rules list cross-fades in (`enter: 'fade'`) | 150 ms + 250 ms |
| The orb (everywhere) | The ring's highlight goes round clockwise, steady; the leaves stay | 1 s per turn, linear |
| The glow | Turns once every 3.08 s (Figma motion on "Gradient") | ease-in, then a pause |

All of it is off with reduced motion. Values L3 doesn't have are local tokens (`--app-dash-*-duration`, …).
Not built yet: the live app's DASH mascot with a face and its "Checking 4 rules for you" bubble on the trading
screen (needs the mascot artwork), and the live landing's active-rules carousel.

## Build checklist (CHECKLIST.md) — tick every line


DASH has many small design decisions that are easy to miss if you only skim the screenshots. Every line below is
deliberate. Exact values live in the file named on each line (all of it is also in this flow's `flows/dash.md`). Values
that aren't L3 tokens are local tokens `--app-dash-*` in `src/local-tokens.css`: carry them over as named theme values,
never as magic numbers.

### 0. Which version to build
The prototype shows several versions behind settings (`index.tsx` → `options`). **Build each setting's default** unless
the product team tells you otherwise; the other values are experiments.

| Setting | Build (default) | Other values (don't build unless asked) |
|---|---|---|
| DASH version | V7 · Pills, id 11 (new user: Landing, big cards; returning: Returning home V2 with the Create pills over the dock) | V3 Dock (id 7) · V4 Floating (id 8) · V5 Cards (id 9) · V6 Creations (id 10) · V8 Tabs (id 12, returning user: kind tabs in the top bar) · V9 Switch (id 13) · V10 Heading (id 14) · V11 Ribbon (id 15) · V12 Center (id 16) · V13 Center pills (id 17) · (archived: V1 Classic, id 1 · V2 Pills, id 2) |
| User | Both states: New user and Returning user (the app knows which) | — |
| Made so far | Build every case: Rules / Indicators / Both — a made kind shows its cards, the others are promoted | — |
| Resume chats | Hide | Show |

The version list is `components/dashVersion.ts` (each version's chat input) + `screens/homes.tsx` (its homes).

### 1. Background (`components/DashScreen.tsx` + `DashScreen.module.css`)
- [ ] One background for the whole DASH screen. It stays put while scenes change on top of it; it is never redrawn per screen.
- [ ] Layers, bottom to top: white surface → **rotating gradient** (image `assets/`, a square 125% of the box tall, centred, drawn turned 180° and mirrored, 120% of its box) → **white blurred disc** (10% from the top to 3% from the bottom, blur `--app-dash-glow-blur`) → **fine grid lines** across the top.
- [ ] Gradient motion: −164° → 196°, ease-in, over the first 75% of a 3.08 s loop, then still until the loop restarts.
- [ ] Geometry is in fractions of the background box, so it scales with the screen and **shrinks when the keyboard is up** (the box's bottom = keyboard height, 300 ms `--app-dash-scene-easing`).
- [ ] While chatting (Chat V2): the round disc crossfades (300 ms) to a straight **white veil**, so the glow at the bottom is a level band rising from the input's bottom edge (band `--app-dash-veil-band`).
- [ ] Loss tone: the same gradient hue-rotated to reds.
- [ ] Edge to edge: the background runs under the status bar and the OS nav bar; the content is inset by them.
- [ ] Top bar = L3 Actionbar, **transparent, no hairline**.
- [ ] Reduced motion: no gradient turn, no transitions.

### 2. Orb (`src/shared/ui/dash/DashOrb.*`)
- [ ] Artwork drawn at 100 and scaled. Ring = angular gradient (`--app-dash-glow-1/2/3`), its highlight turns clockwise, 1 s per turn, linear; the leaves don't move.
- [ ] Halo copy offset 8 right / 10 down, blur `--app-dash-orb-halo-blur`. On homes V2 / V3 / V4 the orb is nudged 8 right (`orbNudge`).

### 3. Scenes and motion (`components/SceneSwap.*`, `screens/DashAI.tsx`, README → Motion)
- [ ] Landing, rules chat and indicator chat are **one screen whose scenes change in place**. Nothing is pushed between chat steps.
- [ ] Scene change: push, back or fade, 300 ms. A send from a home **cross-fades**; it doesn't push. The typed text flies up and becomes the first user message (`components/flyMessage.ts`, `pendingMessage.ts`, 450 ms).
- [ ] New message: fades up 8, 250 ms decelerate. Thinking: three pulsing dots. Question card: rises 24 from the input's place.
- [ ] Rule created / indicator saved: green disc pops in with overshoot (`--app-dash-pop-*`), the tick draws itself, then confetti (1.6 s).
- [ ] Every timing in README → Motion table. All motion off with reduced motion.

### 4. Chat input and messages (`components/Chat.*`, `SlidingPills.*`)
- [ ] One fixed input for every scene. Send = 40 circle. A green typing caret.
- [ ] Animated placeholder: the word slides up into place.
- [ ] **Pills** kind switch (Rule · Indicator · Strategy): grey track, pills without fill, a **black raised thumb that glides** under the picked one (250 ms). Switching kind in an empty chat flips the chat.
- [ ] **+** (Pine Script) shows only for Indicator, next to Send, and pops in. A picked file = small grey pill before the text (file icon, name, ✕).
- [ ] **User message bubble**: min height 48, radius 24, padding 12 / 16, `surface-secondary`, Label/14, hugs its text.
- [ ] Typing state: the drawn keyboard is up and the home's sections fold away (`sectionsFold`); the greeting glides. It reverses on close.

### 5. Cards
- [ ] Indicator card (`IndicatorCard.*`): border-light, **radius 16**, 12 inside; builds live (wave → candles → lines), part tags pop in one by one, 3 build steps (spinner / tick / ring). Ready = DASH-green edge. A change sweeps a band of light across it once (1.2 s) and shows "Indicator updated" for 2.8 s. An earlier version folds to a dimmed mini card.
- [ ] The chat pins the card on top and shrinks it to a mini card (80 × 40 chart) on scroll.
- [ ] No shadows on DASH or home cards. Hover / press tint on landing cards = orb green at 10%.
- [ ] Dashed "Create" cards: 1px `border-intense`, **6 on / 4 off dashes** (drawn as an SVG rect inside the card, not a CSS dashed border), radius 12, + on a light DASH-green disc.

### 6. Home (`screens/ReturningV2.*`)
- [ ] "Your creations": one sideways row, edge to edge (16 in at both ends), snap, small two-line cards; the active status shows in green.
- [ ] The field's switch **reorders** the row (picked kind first). Strategy picked → "+ Create strategy" leads (not on V6). Cards on show slide down and fade one by one; new ones rise in one by one (~0.35 s).

### 7. History, sheets, Pine Script
- [ ] History ("Created with DASH", `screens/Creations.tsx`): pill tabs All / Rules / Indicators / Strategies; card V3 = status + name left, switch right; on items bold heading text, off items medium label text.
- [ ] Confirm and simple-action sheets use the **large header with an icon** (e.g. delete = bin in a red circle, 64).
- [ ] Pine Script: upload sheet with 3 steps; the first-time tip loops a 3-step story in the chat; Copy / Share / Download live only in the saved and details sheets, never on the chat card.

### 8. Copy
- [ ] Every string comes from `copy.json`, word for word ("Ai" is spelled Ai on purpose; line breaks in copy, e.g. `Create\nindicator`, are intended).

When a line here and the code disagree, the code is newer: follow the code and tell the designer.

### `src/flows/dash/components/BuildOption.module.css`

```css
/* An L3 clickable Card (12 padding) as Figma's "Option card": radius 16, a 1px DASH green edge, no drop shadow
   (designer's call, 2026-10-23 — the green edge is enough on the DASH background). */
.option.option {
  --card-border: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--app-dash-green); /* 1px: Figma stroke */
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16);
  box-shadow: var(--card-border);
}

/* Icon tile: 56, radius 8, a light DASH green (Figma rgba(104, 218, 111, 0.15)), the glyph 32 in success green. */
.tile {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: none;
  width: var(--l3-size-56);
  height: var(--l3-size-56);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08);
  background: var(--app-dash-tile);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

.glyph.glyph {
  width: var(--l3-size-32);
  height: var(--l3-size-32);
}

.text {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  text-align: start;
}

.title {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.description {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.chevron {
  flex: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* DASH: hover and press tint the card with the DASH orb green at 10% instead of L3's grey state layer (designer's call,
   2026-10-23). The card keeps its press scale. */
@media (hover: hover) {
  .option.option:hover {
    /* the DASH orb green at 10%, laid over the card's own surface */
    background-image: linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-glow-1) 10%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-glow-1) 10%, transparent));
  }
}

.option.option:active {
  /* the DASH orb green at 10%, laid over the card's own surface */
  background-image: linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-glow-1) 10%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-glow-1) 10%, transparent));
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/BuildOption.tsx`

```tsx
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msChevronRight } from '@l3/icons/material'
import styles from './BuildOption.module.css'

type BuildOptionProps = {
  icon: string
  title: string
  description: string
  onClick?: () => void
}

/**
 * "Choose what to build" on the DASH landing: one option per L3 clickable Card — an icon tile, the name, one line on
 * what it does, a chevron. DASH style on the card: its edge in the DASH green at 50% (Figma: lime 1px stroke).
 */
export function BuildOption({ icon, title, description, onClick }: BuildOptionProps) {
  return (
    <Card onClick={onClick} className={styles.option}>
      <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="12">
        <span className={styles.tile} aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon icon={icon} size={24} className={styles.glyph} />
        </span>
        <Stack gap="04" className={styles.text}>
          <span className={styles.title}>{title}</span>
          <span className={styles.description}>{description}</span>
        </Stack>
        <Icon icon={msChevronRight} size={24} className={styles.chevron} />
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```css
/* DASH chat parts. Layout is L3 Stacks; this file holds the DASH look (edges, pills, motion). */

/* ---- Chat input: Figma "L3: DASH chat field" — 56 min, 16 / 8 inside, radius 28 (full), float shadow.
   Default: border-light edge; Typing: the DASH green edge. The edge changes with the screen (300 ms). */
.input {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  min-height: var(--l3-size-56);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-16);
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--app-dash-float-shadow);
  transition: border-color var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

/* With the attach button: it mirrors Send — a 40 round button 8 in from the edge, centred in the 56 field — and the
   text starts 4 after it. */
.input[data-attach] {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  padding-left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

/* The +. While the Pine Script highlight is up: a soft DASH-green fill and a green ring pulsing out from it. */
.attachWrap {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
}

.attachWrap[data-glow]::before {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 55%, transparent);
  content: '';
  animation: attach-glow 1.6s var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.attachWrap[data-glow] .attach.attach {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 16%, transparent);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

@keyframes attach-glow {
  to {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--l3-spacing-12) color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 0%, transparent);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .attachWrap[data-glow]::before {
    animation: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--l3-spacing-04) color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 35%, transparent);
  }
}

/*
 * The Pine Script FTUX card (custom, designer's call): dark, a DASH green gradient edge that slowly turns, the Pine
 * Script mark, a title and a line, ✕. It pops out of the + (spring, 450 ms), then floats — a slow
 * up-and-down bob with a small wiggle every few seconds — and a tail points down at the +. The form is its box.
 */
@property --ftux-angle {
  syntax: '<angle>';
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: 0deg;
}

.ftux {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(100% + var(--l3-spacing-12));
  left: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  width: min(100%, var(--app-dash-ftux-width));
  transform-origin: var(--l3-spacing-28) 100%;
  animation:
    ftux-pop var(--app-dash-pop-duration) var(--app-dash-pop-easing) both,
    ftux-float 3.2s ease-in-out var(--app-dash-pop-duration) infinite;
}

/* The animated tip is wider (its story window), and floats less (it's busy enough inside). */
.ftux[data-story] {
  width: min(100%, var(--app-dash-story-card));
  animation: ftux-pop var(--app-dash-pop-duration) var(--app-dash-pop-easing) both;
}

/* The gradient edge: a turning conic gradient behind the card, 1.5 of it showing around. */
.ftux::before {
  position: absolute;
  inset: calc(-1 * var(--app-dash-ftux-edge));
  border-radius: calc(var(--l3-radius-20) + var(--app-dash-ftux-edge));
  background: conic-gradient(from var(--ftux-angle), var(--app-dash-glow-1), var(--app-dash-green), var(--app-dash-glow-3), var(--app-dash-glow-1));
  content: '';
  animation: ftux-turn 4s linear infinite;
}

/* The tail: a small turned square under the card, over the +'s middle, in the card's colour, edged like it. */
.ftux::after {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-06));
  left: calc(var(--l3-spacing-28) - var(--l3-spacing-06));
  width: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-right: var(--app-dash-ftux-edge) solid var(--app-dash-glow-1);
  border-bottom: var(--app-dash-ftux-edge) solid var(--app-dash-glow-1);
  background: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
  content: '';
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

@keyframes ftux-pop {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(var(--l3-spacing-12)) scale(0.5);
  }
}

/* Floating: up and down, with a small wiggle in the middle of each lap. */
@keyframes ftux-float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  35% { transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-06))) rotate(0deg); }
  45% { transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-06))) rotate(-1.5deg); }
  52% { transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-06))) rotate(1.5deg); }
  60% { transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-04))) rotate(0deg); }
}

@keyframes ftux-turn {
  to { --ftux-angle: 360deg; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ftux,
  .ftux::before {
    animation: none;
  }
}

.attach.attach {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 16%, transparent);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

@keyframes attach-glow {
  to {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--l3-spacing-12) color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 0%, transparent);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .attachWrap[data-glow]::before {
    animation: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--l3-spacing-04) color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 35%, transparent);
  }
}

/* The tooltip's anchor hugs the + (inline). */
.attachTip {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
}

.attach.attach {
  background: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted);
}

/* The Pine Script bubble: a dark speech bubble above the field's left end, joined to the + by a stem (the + is its
   foot), so bubble, stem and + read as one shape (designer's reference). It grows out of the + (scale from its corner,
   250 ms). The form is its positioning box. */
.tip {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.tipBubble {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(100% - var(--l3-spacing-04));
  left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-width: calc(100% - 2 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-16);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24) var(--l3-radius-24) var(--l3-radius-24) 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform-origin: bottom left;
  animation: tip-grow var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

/* The stem: from under the bubble down to the +'s middle, the +'s width; a curve where it meets the bubble's edge. */
.tipStem {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-04));
  left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  width: var(--l3-size-40);
  height: calc(var(--l3-size-56) / 2 + var(--l3-spacing-04));
  background: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
  animation: tip-fade var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard) both;
}

.tipStem::after {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  left: 100%;
  width: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%, transparent var(--l3-spacing-12), var(--l3-surface-inverted) calc(var(--l3-spacing-12) + 0.5px));
  content: '';
}

.tipText {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tipClose {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-32);
  height: var(--l3-size-32);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
}

@keyframes tip-grow {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.6);
  }
}

@keyframes tip-fade {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .tipBubble,
  .tipStem {
    animation: none;
  }
}

.attach.attach {

}

@keyframes attach-glow {

  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .attachWrap[data-glow]::before {
    animation: none;

  }
}

/* The coach mark's anchor wraps the + only (it hugs it, inline). */
.attachTip {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
}

.attach.attach {
  flex: none;
  width: var(--l3-size-40);
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

/* The attachment chip sits 4 from the paperclip, the text 8 after the chip. */
.attachment + .field {
  margin-left: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

/* A picked file, in the field before the text: a small grey pill — file icon, name, ✕. */
.attachment {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  max-width: 50%;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

.attachmentName {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.attachmentRemove {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.input[data-typing],
.input:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--app-dash-green);
}

.fieldWrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* The animated placeholder sits over the empty field, in its placeholder colour; the word slides up into place. */
.rotating {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: pre;
  color: var(--l3-content-tertiary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14); /* same as the field's text and placeholder */
  pointer-events: none;
}

.rotatingWord {
  display: inline-flex;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rotatingIn {
  animation: placeholder-word var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

@keyframes placeholder-word {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(60%);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .rotatingIn {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* A text area that grows with its text: one line, up to three, then it scrolls (ChatInput sets the height). */
.field {
  display: block;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  max-height: 3lh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: none;
  resize: none;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14); /* typed text is Label (L3: input field text) */
  outline: none;
  caret-color: var(--app-dash-green); /* Figma "Typing-indicator": a green caret */
}

.field::placeholder {
  color: var(--l3-content-tertiary);
}

/* Figma "Send Button": a 40 circle. */
.send.send {
  flex: none;
  width: var(--l3-size-40);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
}

/* ---- "✦ CHOOSE WHAT TO BUILD ✦" */
.sparkleHeading {
  color: var(--l3-content-tertiary);
}

.sparkle {
  width: var(--l3-size-12);
  height: var(--l3-size-12);
}

.caps {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  letter-spacing: var(--app-dash-caps-tracking);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ---- Example prompts: full-width rows, 16 apart, each drifting endlessly (Figma "Slowly infinite scrolling").
   The track holds the row twice; moving it by half its width loops without a seam. */
.chipRows {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  width: 100%;
}

.marquee {
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
}

.track {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  width: max-content;
  animation: dash-marquee var(--app-dash-marquee) linear infinite;
}

.marquee[data-row='1'] .track {
  animation-direction: reverse;
}

.marquee:hover .track,
.marquee:active .track,
.marquee:focus-within .track {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

.chipRow {
  width: max-content;
}

@keyframes dash-marquee {
  to {
    transform: translateX(calc(-50% - var(--l3-spacing-04))); /* half the track, plus half the gap between copies */
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .marquee {
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }

  .track {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* Figma 36 tall (L3 has 36 only as a spacing step). */
.promptChip {
  flex: none;
  min-height: var(--l3-size-40);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--app-dash-green);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

/* In the vertical suggestions list: 40 tall, size 14 (designer's One Canvas edit) on L3's 14 line height (20), the text
   centred in the chip, so one line stays 40 and wrapped lines breathe. A wrapped chip hugs its longest line (Chat.tsx). Never wider than the list (the screen's 16 margins stay): a long suggestion wraps onto a second line and the
   chip grows taller, keeping a 20 corner (half its one-line height) instead of a full pill. */
.promptChip[data-size='lg'] {
  max-width: 100%;
  min-height: var(--l3-size-40);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-16);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-20);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-16);
  font-size: var(--l3-font-size-200);
  line-height: var(--l3-line-height-200);
  white-space: normal;
  text-align: start;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* "Top 3 suggestions ✦": Heading/16 in the success green, the DASH sparkle after it. */
.topLabel {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-16);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  font-size: var(--l3-font-size-200);
}

.topSparkle {
  width: var(--l3-size-16);
  height: var(--l3-size-16);
}

/* An action after the suggestions (Upload a Pine Script): a dashed edge and its icon before the label. */
.promptChip[data-action] {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border-style: dashed;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.promptChip:active {
  transform: scale(var(--l3-motion-scale-press-default));
}

.promptChip:focus-visible,
.reply:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--l3-content-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ---- Messages */
/* A sent file: the user's bubble, with a file tile (40, white) before its name and caption. */
.userFile {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  max-width: 80%;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-16) var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24);
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

.userFileIcon {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-40);
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  color: var(--app-dash-green);
}

.userFileText {
  min-width: 0;
}

.userFileName {
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.userFileCaption {
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
}

.userMessage {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 80%;
  min-height: var(--l3-size-48); /* Figma "user message buble": 48 min, radius 24 */
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-16);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24);
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}

.assistant p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.assistantTitle {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
}

.assistantText {
  font: var(--l3-text-description-14);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* An earlier message scrolled up under the pinned rule card (Figma: faded). */
/* Message style "Bubbles": DASH's reply in a bubble on the left — the user's bubble's shape (radius 24, 12 / 16
   inside), on the plain surface with a hairline so it reads on DASH's background. */
.assistant[data-bubble] {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: fit-content; /* hugs its text, like the user's bubble */
  max-width: 85%;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-16);
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

/* Back-to-back replies sit a little closer: 12 apart instead of the chat's 20. Each turn is its own wrapper in the
   chat's list, so the pairs are found through them. (Corners stay as they are: designer's call.) */
:global(div):has(> .assistant[data-bubble]) + :global(div) > .assistant[data-bubble] {
  margin-top: calc(var(--l3-spacing-12) - var(--l3-spacing-20));
}

.assistant[data-faded] {
  opacity: var(--l3-opacity-40);
}

/* ---- Thinking */
.thinking {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
}

.dots {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.dots span {
  width: var(--l3-spacing-06); /* Figma: 6 dots, 4 apart */
  height: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-content-primary);
  animation: pulse var(--l3-motion-duration-spin) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard) infinite;
}

.dots span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 150ms; }
.dots span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 300ms; }

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: var(--l3-opacity-30); }
  50% { opacity: var(--l3-opacity-100); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .dots span { animation: none; }
}

/* ---- Quick replies: Figma 12 / 8 padding, Label/12, border-light; DASH's suggestion has the green edge + lift */
.reply {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.reply[data-suggested] {
  border-color: var(--app-dash-green);
  box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-sm);
}

/* Suggestions (a ready indicator's changes): the same DASH green edge as the empty chat's suggestions. */
.reply[data-glow] {
  border-color: var(--app-dash-green);
}

.reply:active {
  transform: scale(var(--l3-motion-scale-press-default));
}

/*
 * The field with a "what to build" switch (DASH home): two rows in a rounded box — the text across the top, then + on
 * the left, the switch after it and Send on the right (like Claude Desktop's field).
 */
.input[data-modes] {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  row-gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24);
}

.input[data-modes] .fieldWrap {
  order: -1;
  flex-basis: 100%;
  min-height: var(--l3-size-32);
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.modes {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* A picked file (with the switch): its own row at the top, above the text — the lower row stays switch · + · Send. */
.input[data-modes] .attachment {
  order: -2;
  margin-left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

/* Lower row: the switch first (left), then the + (only for indicators) right beside Send. */
.input[data-modes] .modes { order: 1; }
.input[data-modes] .attachWrap { order: 2; }
.input[data-modes] .send.send { order: 3; }

/* The Pine Script tip, when the + sits next to Send: the card lines up with the field's right edge and its tail points
   down at the + (8 field padding + Send 40 + 8 gap + half the + 20 from the right). */
.input[data-modes] .ftux {
  right: 0;
  left: auto;
  transform-origin: calc(100% - var(--l3-spacing-08) - var(--l3-size-40) - var(--l3-spacing-08) - var(--l3-spacing-20)) 100%;
}

.input[data-modes] .ftux::after {
  right: calc(var(--l3-spacing-08) + var(--l3-size-40) + var(--l3-spacing-08) + var(--l3-spacing-20) - var(--l3-spacing-06));
  left: auto;
}

/* With the switch: Indicator picked → the + pops in beside Send (grows from nothing with a slight overshoot, 250 ms). */
.input[data-modes] .attachWrap {
  animation: attach-pop var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
}

@keyframes attach-pop {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    scale: 0.4;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

    animation: none;
  }
}

/* Chat input "Pills above": the switch row over the field, 8 above it. */
/* "Pills above" (DASH V3): the switch and, to its right, the + fill the field's top row; the text and Send share the
   row under it. */
.input[data-pills-top] {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24);
}

.modesTop {
  display: flex;
  order: -2;
  /* the row minus the + (40) and the gap, so the text can't join this row */
  flex: 1 0 calc(100% - var(--l3-size-40) - var(--l3-spacing-08));
  min-width: 0;
}

.input[data-pills-top] .attachWrap {
  order: -1;
}

.input[data-pills-top]:not(:has(.attachWrap)) .modesTop {
  flex-basis: 100%;
}

.input[data-pills-top] .fieldWrap {
  padding-left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

/* V9 · Switch: the toggle takes the whole top row; the + goes back to the start of the row under it (+ · text · Send). */
.input[data-pills-full] .modesTop {
  flex-basis: 100%;
}

.input[data-pills-full] .attachWrap {
  order: 0;
}

/* V11 · Ribbon: the form is see-through; RibbonTabs draws the field + picked tab as one union shape behind it. */
.input[data-ribbon] {
  isolation: isolate;
  padding-top: 0;
  border-color: transparent;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.input[data-ribbon][data-typing],
.input[data-ribbon]:focus-within {
  border-color: transparent;
}

.input[data-ribbon] .modesTop {
  /* always its own line (edge to edge, never shrinking), so + · text · Send keep the line under it — also once the
     tabs have sunk and the row is closed (the 8 row gap is then the field's top padding) */
  flex: 0 0 calc(100% + 2 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
  margin: 0 calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
}

/* V12 · Center: the edge is a gradient (as V11's union: green → lime → yellow) turning slowly round the field — a
   conic border (white padding-box over the turning gradient border-box). */
@property --dash-edge-angle {
  syntax: '<angle>';
  inherits: false;
  initial-value: 0deg;
}

@keyframes dash-edge-turn {
  to {
    --dash-edge-angle: 360deg;
  }
}

.input[data-edge-turn] {
  border-color: transparent;
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--l3-surface-primary), var(--l3-surface-primary)) padding-box,
    conic-gradient(from var(--dash-edge-angle), var(--app-dash-union-edge-1), var(--app-dash-union-edge-2), var(--app-dash-union-edge-3), var(--app-dash-union-edge-1)) border-box;
  animation: dash-edge-turn 4s linear infinite;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

    animation: none;
  }
}

/* The + right beside Send (with the switch, or the one-row field): 12 between them (the row's 4 gap + 8). */
.input[data-modes] .attachWrap,
.input[data-inline] .attachWrap {
  margin-right: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

/*
 * Dock field (DASH V7, like Gemini): the field runs edge to edge at the bottom of the screen, rounded top corners only,
 * flat against the keyboard. Text on the top row; the controls (pills, +, Send) on the row under it. It cancels the
 * dock area's 16 inset (left, right, bottom) so it touches the screen edges and the keyboard.
 */
.input[data-dock] {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  row-gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  margin: 0 calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16)) calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16));
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-16) var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-width: 1px 0 0; /* 1px: only the top edge — the sides and bottom are the screen's */
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-24) var(--l3-radius-24) 0 0;
  /* See-through, so DASH's glow shows behind it. No backdrop blur: it smudged the screen's rounded bottom corners. */
  background: rgb(from var(--l3-surface-primary) r g b / var(--l3-opacity-80)); /* glass: 80% */
  box-shadow: none;

  --pills-track: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  --pills-track-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-low); /* so the white track lifts off the see-through dock */
}

.input[data-dock] .fieldWrap {
  order: -1;
  flex-basis: 100%;
  min-height: var(--l3-size-32);
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

/* Keyboard down: the dock's white carries on under the OS navigation bar to the screen's bottom edge. With the keyboard
   up the dock sits flat on it instead. */
.input[data-dock]:not([data-typing]) {
  margin-bottom: calc(-1 * (var(--l3-spacing-16) + var(--os-inset-bottom, 0px)));
  padding-bottom: calc(var(--l3-spacing-12) + var(--os-inset-bottom, 0px));
}

/* Without the pills the controls still sit on the lower row: the + on the left, Send on the right. */
.input[data-dock]:not([data-modes]) .send.send {
  margin-left: auto;
}

/*
 * DASH V8 · first message: while it's typed the field has an edge in DASH's light (teal → green → yellow); the glow
 * itself comes up from the bottom of the screen (DashScreen 'rise').
 */
.input[data-first-glow] {
  border-color: transparent;
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--l3-surface-primary), var(--l3-surface-primary)) padding-box,
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--app-dash-glow-3), var(--app-dash-glow-1), var(--app-dash-glow-2)) border-box;
  border-width: var(--app-dash-ftux-edge);
  box-shadow: none;
}


/* A top row inside the field (DASH V7 · Pills: the Create pills); under it one row — the +, the text filling the rest,
   Send. Wins over the dock's text-on-top layout. */
.input[data-top] {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  row-gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

.topRow {
  order: -1;
  flex-basis: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}

.input[data-top] .fieldWrap.fieldWrap {
  order: 0;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.input[data-top] .send.send {
  margin-left: 0;
}

/* One row (DASH V7 · Pills): the text across, then the + beside Send — over the dock's text-on-top layout. The + is
   white (surface/primary) with the light outline, like the other 40 controls. */
.input[data-inline] {
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16); /* 16 from the screen edge on both sides */
}

/* No inner padding: the text, its caret and the animated placeholder all start at the same x. */
.input[data-inline] .fieldWrap.fieldWrap {
  order: 0;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  padding-inline: 0;
}

.input[data-inline] .attachWrap {
  order: 1;
}

.input[data-inline] .send.send {
  order: 2;
  margin-left: 0;
}


/* DASH V7 · Pills: the dock is solid (surface/primary, not see-through) and lifts off the page with a low shadow. */
.input[data-inline][data-dock] {
  padding-bottom: calc(var(--l3-spacing-16) + var(--os-inset-bottom, 0px)); /* 16 under the row (the dock's 12 + 4) */
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-low);
}

/* A taller (wrapped) text: the + and Send stay at the bottom of the row, beside the last line, like other chat boxes.
   The text area is at least the buttons' 40, so a single line sits on their centre line. */
.input[data-inline] {

}

.input[data-inline] .fieldWrap.fieldWrap {
  min-height: var(--l3-size-40);
}

  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* The plain floating field (+ on the left, then the text): 8 between the + and the text (the row's 4 + 4). */
.input[data-attach]:not([data-dock]):not([data-inline]):not([data-modes]) .attachWrap {
  margin-right: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode, type RefObject } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msAdd, msArrowUpward, msChevronRight, msClose, msDescription, msUploadFile } from '@l3/icons/material'
import sparkle from '../assets/sparkle.svg'
import { useFlowOption, useSystemKeyboard } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { ModeMenu } from './ModeMenu'
import { useDashVersion } from './dashVersion'
import { SlidingPills, usePillCount, usePillIcon } from './SlidingPills'
import { RibbonTabs } from './RibbonTabs'
import { PineStory } from './PineStory'
import styles from './Chat.module.css'

/**
 * DASH's chat parts — its own look (designer's call): pills with the DASH green edge, plain assistant text, a grey
 * pill for what the user said. Text styles, spacing and surfaces are L3; only the DASH green and the float shadow are
 * local tokens.
 */

type ChatInputProps = {
  /** A row at the top inside the field; the + · text · Send row sits under it. */
  top?: ReactNode
  /** One row: the text across, then the + beside Send (DASH V7 · Pills; overrides the dock's two rows). */
  inline?: boolean
  /** This is the chat's first message (a home, or an empty chat): DASH V8 makes the field glow while it's typed. */
  firstMessage?: boolean
  /** `from`: where the text was typed — the sent message flies up from there. */
  onSend?: (text: string, from: HTMLElement) => void
  /** Controlled text (the prototype's on-screen keyboard types into it); leave out to let the field keep its own. */
  value?: string
  onChange?: (value: string) => void
  /** Typing state (Figma "3.1 Manual typing"): the DASH green edge and a live Send. */
  typing?: boolean
  onFocus?: () => void
  autoFocus?: boolean
  /** The field itself — to focus it in a tap (on a phone, focusing inside the tap is what opens the keyboard). */
  inputRef?: RefObject<HTMLTextAreaElement | null>
  /** Attach (Pine Script): the + at the start of the field; the screen opens its file picker. */
  onAttach?: () => void
  /** A picked file, shown as a chip in the field (sendable without text); ✕ takes it off. */
  attachment?: { name: string } | null
  onRemoveAttachment?: () => void
  /** An animated placeholder while the field is empty: the prefix stays, the last word cycles (slides up), e.g.
   *  "Create a new" + indicator / rule / strategy. */
  rotatingPlaceholder?: { prefix: string; words: string[] }
  /** What the empty field invites, for where the chat is (default "Type here"), e.g. "Describe a change to your indicator". */
  placeholder?: string
  /** The Pine Script highlight (first time): the + glows green, a floating card above it; ✕ (or using the +)
   *  puts it away. */
  attachTip?: { title: string; text: string; onDone: () => void } | null
  /**
   * What to build, chosen in the field itself (DASH home, setting "Ask field: With switch"; like Claude Desktop's
   * Chat / Cowork): the field grows to two rows — the text on top, then + · the switch (L3 Tabs pill-group, md: the 40 of the + and Send) · Send.
   */
  modes?: { value: string; items: { value: string; label: string; /** Just launched: a New dot (pills) / New after the name (dropdown). */ isNew?: boolean }[]; onChange: (value: string) => void; label: string; /** pills: the L3 pill group inside the field; menu: one pill that opens a dropdown (room for more); above: the pill group outside, full width over the field. */ display?: 'pills' | 'menu' | 'above'; /** V11 · Ribbon: the conversation has started — the tabs sink back into the field. */ sunk?: boolean }
}

/**
 * The message field at the bottom of every DASH chat (Figma "L3: DASH chat field"): a white pill, 56 tall, 16 / 8
 * inside, the float shadow and a round Send (40).
 * - Default: border-light edge, placeholder in content/tertiary, Send off (L3 disabled) until there's text.
 * - Typing: the DASH green edge, the text in content/primary, Send on (L3 primary, black).
 */
export function ChatInput({ top, inline = false, firstMessage = false, onSend, value: controlled, onChange, typing = false, onFocus, autoFocus, inputRef, onAttach, attachment, onRemoveAttachment, rotatingPlaceholder, attachTip, placeholder, modes }: ChatInputProps) {
  const [own, setOwn] = useState('')
  const value = controlled ?? own
  const setValue = (v: string) => (onChange ? onChange(v) : setOwn(v))
  const ownField = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null)
  const field = inputRef ?? ownField
  // A phone (touch) types on the prototype's drawn keyboard: its own keyboard stays closed (inputMode none). A laptop
  // types on its keyboard too.
  const touch = useSystemKeyboard()
  // Typing state = the field has focus, so its green caret is always there, blinking — also when typing was turned on
  // from elsewhere (a Create pill, a suggestion, a card) or the text changed from outside. The end of the text.
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = field.current
    if (!typing || !el || document.activeElement === el) return
    el.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length)
  }, [typing, value, field])
  // DASH version with a dock field (V7): edge to edge, text on top, controls under it.
  const dashVersion = useDashVersion()
  const pillIcon = usePillIcon()
  const pillCount = usePillCount()
  const dock = dashVersion.dock
  // DASH V8: the first message's field glows while it's being typed.
  const firstGlow = !!dashVersion.firstMessageFocus && firstMessage && typing
  // The field grows with its text, like other chat boxes: one line, up to three (CSS max-height), then it scrolls.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = field.current
    if (!el) return
    el.style.height = 'auto'
    el.style.height = `${el.scrollHeight}px`
  }, [value, field])
  const send = () => {
    const text = value.trim()
    if ((!text && !attachment) || !field.current) return
    onSend?.(text, field.current)
    setValue('')
  }
  return (
    <>
    <form
      className={styles.input}
      data-typing={typing || undefined}
      data-attach={onAttach ? '' : undefined}
      data-modes={modes && modes.display !== 'above' ? '' : undefined}
      data-pills-top={modes?.display === 'above' || undefined}
      data-pills-full={(modes?.display === 'above' && dashVersion.switchFullTop) || undefined}
      data-ribbon={(modes?.display === 'above' && dashVersion.ribbonTabs) || undefined}
      data-edge-turn={dashVersion.edgeTurn || undefined}
      data-top={top ? '' : undefined}
      data-inline={inline || undefined}
      data-dock={dock || undefined}
      data-first-glow={firstGlow || undefined}
      data-surface={dock ? 'primary' : undefined}
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        send()
      }}
    >
      {top && <div className={styles.topRow}>{top}</div>}
      {/* "Pills above" (DASH V3): the switch is the field's top row, full width (equal pills); text and Send under it. */}
      {modes?.display === 'above' && (
        <span className={styles.modesTop}>
          {dashVersion.ribbonTabs ? (
            // V11 · Ribbon: folder tabs growing out of the field; the white one slides to the pick.
            <RibbonTabs sunk={modes.sunk} label={modes.label} items={modes.items.map(({ value, label }) => ({ value, label, iconLeft: pillIcon(value), badge: pillCount(value, value === modes.value) }))} value={modes.value} onChange={modes.onChange} />
          ) : (
            <SlidingPills value={modes.value} items={modes.items} onChange={modes.onChange} label={modes.label} newLabel={t('askModes.new')} fill />
          )}
        </span>
      )}
      {onAttach && (() => {
        const add = (
          <span className={styles.attachWrap} data-glow={attachTip ? '' : undefined}>
            <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="md" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msAdd} />} aria-label={t('input.attach')} onClick={() => { attachTip?.onDone(); onAttach() }} className={styles.attach} />
          </span>
        )
        // The Pine Script highlight: the + glows green, and the animated story floats above it, saying what it's for.
        return (
          <>
            {add}
            {attachTip && (
              <span className={styles.ftux} data-story="">
                <PineStory title={attachTip.title} onClose={attachTip.onDone} />
              </span>
            )}
          </>
        )
      })()}
      {attachment && (
        <span className={styles.attachment}>
          <Icon icon={msDescription} size={16} />
          <span className={styles.attachmentName}>{attachment.name}</span>
          <button type="button" className={styles.attachmentRemove} aria-label={t('input.removeAttachment', { name: attachment.name })} onClick={onRemoveAttachment}>
            <Icon icon={msClose} size={12} />
          </button>
        </span>
      )}
      <span className={styles.fieldWrap}>
      {rotatingPlaceholder && !value && !attachment && <RotatingPlaceholder {...rotatingPlaceholder} />}
      <textarea
        ref={field}
        rows={1}
        className={styles.field}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
        // Enter sends (as before); Shift + Enter starts a new line.
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
            e.preventDefault()
            send()
          }
        }}
        onFocus={onFocus}
        autoFocus={autoFocus}
        placeholder={rotatingPlaceholder ? '' : attachment ? t('input.attachmentPlaceholder') : (placeholder ?? t('input.placeholder'))}
        aria-label={t('input.label')}
        enterKeyHint="send"
        inputMode={touch ? 'none' : undefined}
      />
      </span>
      {modes && modes.display !== 'above' && (
        <span className={styles.modes}>
          {modes.display === 'menu' ? (
            <ModeMenu value={modes.value} items={modes.items} onChange={modes.onChange} label={modes.label} />
          ) : (
            <SlidingPills value={modes.value} items={modes.items} onChange={modes.onChange} label={modes.label} newLabel={t('askModes.new')} />
          )}
        </span>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="md" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msArrowUpward} />} aria-label={t('input.send')} disabled={!onSend || (!value.trim() && !attachment)} className={styles.send} />
    </form>
    </>
  )
}

/** The field's animated placeholder: the prefix, then a word that slides up and changes every 2.4 s (still with reduced motion: the first word). */
function RotatingPlaceholder({ prefix, words }: { prefix: string; words: string[] }) {
  const [i, setI] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setI((n) => (n + 1) % words.length), ROTATE_MS)
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer)
  }, [words.length])
  return (
    <span className={styles.rotating} aria-hidden="true">
      {prefix}{' '}
      <span className={styles.rotatingWord}>
        <span key={i} className={styles.rotatingIn}>{words[i]}</span>
      </span>
    </span>
  )
}
const ROTATE_MS = 2400

/** "✦ HERE ARE SOME EXAMPLES ✦": a small caps heading between two DASH sparkles. */
export function SparkleHeading({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Stack as="header" direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="center" gap="12" className={styles.sparkleHeading}>
      <img src={sparkle} alt="" className={styles.sparkle} />
      <h2 className={styles.caps}>{children}</h2>
      <img src={sparkle} alt="" className={styles.sparkle} />
    </Stack>
  )
}

/**
 * Example prompts (Figma "Slowly infinite scrolling suggestion list"): each row drifts sideways on its own, endlessly —
 * the first to the left, the second to the right — and stops while a finger or pointer is on it. Each row is drawn
 * twice, side by side, so the loop has no seam. With reduced motion the rows stay still and scroll by hand.
 */
export function PromptChips({ rows, onPick }: { rows: string[][]; onPick?: (prompt: string, from: HTMLElement) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.chipRows} role="group" aria-label={t('examples.label')}>
      {rows.map((row, i) => (
        <div key={i} className={styles.marquee} data-row={i}>
          <div className={styles.track}>
            {[0, 1].map((copy) => (
              <Stack key={copy} direction="horizontal" gap="08" className={styles.chipRow} aria-hidden={copy === 1 || undefined}>
                {row.map((prompt) => (
                  <button key={prompt} type="button" className={styles.promptChip} tabIndex={copy === 1 ? -1 : undefined} onClick={(e) => onPick?.(prompt, e.currentTarget)}>
                    {prompt}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </Stack>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * Top suggestions as a vertical list just above the input (primary layout of the empty chat): a green "Top N
 * suggestions ✦" label, then one DASH chip per line, left-aligned. A chip sends itself.
 */
export function SuggestionList({ items, onPick, action }: { items: string[]; onPick?: (prompt: string, from: HTMLElement) => void; /** An extra action after the suggestions (Upload a Pine Script): a dashed chip with its icon; not counted in "Top N". */ action?: { label: string; onPick: () => void } }) {
  const list = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = list.current
    if (!el) return
    const fit = () => hugWrappedChips(el)
    fit()
    document.fonts?.ready.then(fit)
    window.addEventListener('resize', fit)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', fit)
  }, [items])
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="16" align="start" aria-label={t('examples.label')}>
      <h2 className={styles.topLabel}>
        {t('rulesHome.topSuggestions', { count: items.length })}
        <img src={sparkle} alt="" className={styles.topSparkle} />
      </h2>
      <Stack gap="12" align="start" ref={list}>
        {items.map((prompt) => (
          <button key={prompt} type="button" className={styles.promptChip} data-size="lg" onClick={(e) => onPick?.(prompt, e.currentTarget)}>
            <span>{prompt}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
        {action && (
          <button type="button" className={styles.promptChip} data-size="lg" data-action="" onClick={action.onPick}>
            <Icon icon={msUploadFile} size={20} />
            <span>{action.label}</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  )
}

/**
 * A suggestion that wraps onto a second line would keep the full width, leaving a gap after its longest line. This
 * hugs each wrapped chip to its longest line (+ its padding and edge); one-line chips are left as they are. Measured
 * from the text's line boxes after resetting every chip, so it settles in one pass (and again on resize / font load).
 */
function hugWrappedChips(list: HTMLElement) {
  const chips = [...list.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button')]
  chips.forEach((chip) => (chip.style.width = ''))
  // One pass only: measured at the full width, then hugged. Measuring again would let balanced lines re-break
  // narrower each time and squeeze the chip into a thin column. If hugging ever adds a line, it's undone.
  const measured = chips.map((chip) => ({ width: longestLineWidth(chip), lines: lineCount(chip) }))
  chips.forEach((chip, i) => {
    const { width, lines } = measured[i]
    if (width === null || width >= chip.offsetWidth) return
    chip.style.width = `${width}px`
    if (lineCount(chip) > lines) chip.style.width = ''
  })
}

/** How many lines a chip's text runs to. */
function lineCount(chip: HTMLElement): number {
  const range = document.createRange()
  range.selectNodeContents(chip.firstElementChild ?? chip)
  return new Set([...range.getClientRects()].map((r) => Math.round(r.top))).size
}

/** A wrapped chip's width hugging its longest line (+ padding and edge); null for a chip on one line. */
function longestLineWidth(chip: HTMLElement): number | null {
  const range = document.createRange()
  range.selectNodeContents(chip.firstElementChild ?? chip)
  const lines = [...range.getClientRects()]
  const tops = new Set(lines.map((r) => Math.round(r.top)))
  if (tops.size < 2) return null // one line: nothing to hug
  const longest = Math.max(...lines.map((r) => r.right)) - Math.min(...lines.map((r) => r.left))
  const cs = getComputedStyle(chip)
  const sides = ['paddingLeft', 'paddingRight', 'borderLeftWidth', 'borderRightWidth'] as const
  return Math.ceil(longest + sides.reduce((sum, side) => sum + parseFloat(cs[side]), 0))
}

/** What the user sent: a grey pill on the right. */
export function UserMessage({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="end">
      <p className={styles.userMessage}>{children}</p>
    </Stack>
  )
}

/** What the user sent as a file (Pine Script): a grey bubble on the right with a file icon, its name and a caption. */
export function UserFile({ name, caption }: { name: string; caption?: string }) {
  return (
    <Stack direction="horizontal" justify="end">
      <div className={styles.userFile}>
        <span className={styles.userFileIcon} aria-hidden="true"><Icon icon={msDescription} size={20} /></span>
        <Stack gap="00" className={styles.userFileText}>
          <p className={styles.userFileName}>{name}</p>
          {caption && <span className={styles.userFileCaption}>{caption}</span>}
        </Stack>
      </div>
    </Stack>
  )
}

/**
 * DASH's reply: a bold first line (Heading/14) and the text under it (Description/14). Prototype setting "Message
 * style" (A/B): Plain = no bubble (default); Bubbles = in a bubble on the left, like the user's on the right.
 */
export function AssistantMessage({ title, children, faded }: { title?: ReactNode; children?: ReactNode; faded?: boolean }) {
  const bubble = useFlowOption('dash', 'messageStyle', 'bubbles') === 'bubbles'
  return (
    <Stack gap="08" className={styles.assistant} data-faded={faded || undefined} data-bubble={bubble || undefined}>
      {title && <p className={styles.assistantTitle}>{title}</p>}
      {children && <p className={styles.assistantText}>{children}</p>}
    </Stack>
  )
}

/** DASH is working: three pulsing dots and what it's doing. */
export function Thinking({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="12" role="status">
      <span className={styles.dots} aria-hidden="true">
        <span />
        <span />
        <span />
      </span>
      <p className={styles.thinking}>{children}</p>
    </Stack>
  )
}

export type ReplyOption = { label: string; onClick?: () => void; suggested?: boolean }

/** Quick replies under DASH's question: pill chips; the one DASH suggests has the green edge. */
export function ReplyChips({ options, asButtons = false, glow = false }: { options: ReplyOption[]; /** Version 2: real L3 buttons — the suggested reply primary with ›, the others tertiary — so they read as actions. */ asButtons?: boolean; /** Suggestions (a ready indicator's changes): the DASH green edge, like the empty chat's suggestions. */ glow?: boolean }) {
  if (asButtons) {
    return (
      <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" wrap role="group" aria-label={t('replies.label')}>
        {options.map((o) => (
          <Button key={o.label} variant={o.suggested ? 'primary' : 'tertiary'} size="md" iconRight={o.suggested ? <Icon icon={msChevronRight} /> : undefined} onClick={o.onClick}>
            {o.label}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </Stack>
    )
  }
  return (
    <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" wrap role="group" aria-label={t('replies.label')}>
      {options.map((o) => (
        <button key={o.label} type="button" className={styles.reply} data-suggested={o.suggested || undefined} data-glow={glow || undefined} onClick={o.onClick}>
          {o.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/ChatMenu.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ActionbarAction } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { msDelete, msHistory, msMoreVert, msWidgets } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import styles from './ChatMenu.module.css'

/**
 * A started chat's ⋮ in the top bar: a small dropdown that opens over it (three options don't need a sheet) — Past chats,
 * Your creations, Delete this chat. A tap outside or Esc closes it. L3 gap: no menu / popover component, so this is
 * L3 list rows on a raised surface.
 */
export function ChatMenu({ onPastChats, onCreations, onDelete, icon = msMoreVert, label = t('chatMenu.button') }: {
  onPastChats?: () => void
  onCreations?: () => void
  /** Leave out for a menu without Delete this chat (V8 · Tabs' home: ☰ with Past chats and Your creations). */
  onDelete?: () => void
  icon?: string
  label?: string
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const outside = (e: PointerEvent) => { if (!wrap.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false) }
    const esc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false) }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', outside)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', esc)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', outside)
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', esc)
    }
  }, [open])
  const pick = (go?: () => void) => () => { setOpen(false); go?.() }
  return (
    <span ref={wrap} className={styles.wrap}>
      <ActionbarAction icon={icon} label={label} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} />
      {open && (
        <div className={styles.menu} role="group" aria-label={label}>
          <ListCell as="button" size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msHistory} />} label={t('landing.pastChats')} onClick={pick(onPastChats)} />
          <ListCell as="button" size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msWidgets} />} label={t('landing.menu')} onClick={pick(onCreations)} />
          {onDelete && <ListCell as="button" size="sm" className={styles.danger} iconLeft={<Icon icon={msDelete} />} label={t('chatMenu.delete')} onClick={pick(onDelete)} />}
        </div>
      )}
    </span>
  )
}
```
