### `src/flows/dash/components/DashDock.tsx`

```tsx
import { createContext, useContext, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'

/**
 * One place for the DASH input (and the drawn keyboard): a fixed area at the bottom of the DASH screen, outside the
 * part that changes. Every scene (homes, chats) renders its field into it through <DashDock>, so moving between
 * scenes never slides or fades the input — only the body above it changes. A scene that's on its way out (SceneSwap's
 * leaving layer) renders none, so there's only ever one.
 */
export const DockHost = createContext<HTMLElement | null>(null)
/** Set by SceneSwap on each layer: the leaving one doesn't render its dock. */
export const SceneRole = createContext<'enter' | 'exit' | 'current'>('current')

export function DashDock({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const host = useContext(DockHost)
  const role = useContext(SceneRole)
  if (role === 'exit') return null
  // No host (a scene shown on its own): render in place, as before.
  return host ? createPortal(children, host) : <>{children}</>
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/DashScreen.module.css`

```css
/*
 * DASH background (Figma 6499:1405, frame 360 × 800). Geometry is artwork, as fractions of the background box, so it
 * keeps its place at any screen size and shrinks with the box when the keyboard comes up.
 */
.frame {
  --dash-kb: 0px; /* the keyboard's height while it's up (set by the chat) */
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: clip;
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

.background {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  container-type: size;
  transition: bottom var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

.frame[data-keyboard] .background {
  bottom: var(--dash-kb);
}

/* "bg rotating gradient": a square 125% of the box tall, centred (Figma: top −99.67, bottom −100.33 on 800). */
.gradientBox {
  position: absolute;
  top: -12.5cqh;
  left: 50%;
  width: 125cqh;
  height: 125cqh;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  animation: dash-bg-turn 3.08s infinite;
}

/* The image is drawn turned 180° and mirrored, 120% of its box (Figma inset −10%). */
.gradient {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -10%;
  width: 120%;
  height: 120%;
  max-width: none;
  transform: rotate(180deg) scaleX(-1);
}

/* Figma motion: −164° → 196° over 75% of 3.08 s (ease-in), then still until the loop starts again. */
@keyframes dash-bg-turn {
  0% {
    transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-164deg);
    animation-timing-function: ease-in;
  }
  75.38%,
  100% {
    transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(196deg);
  }
}

/* "white overlay — center to body": a white disc from 80 below the top to 24 above the bottom, blurred 50. */
.overlay {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10cqh;
  bottom: 3cqh;
  left: 50%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  filter: blur(var(--app-dash-glow-blur));
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  transition:
    top var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing),
    bottom var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing),
    opacity var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

/* DASH V8 · typing the first message: a white wash over the whole background (fades in with the keyboard), so the
   field's glow is what stands out. */
.background::after {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  opacity: 0;
  content: '';
  transition: opacity var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

.frame[data-first-focus] .background::after {
  opacity: var(--l3-opacity-80);
}

/* V8: the wash clears towards the bottom and the white disc ends higher, so the glow climbs up from the bottom behind
   the field and the suggestions stacked over it. */
.frame[data-first-focus='rise'] .background::after {
  background: linear-gradient(to top, transparent var(--app-dash-first-rise-clear), var(--l3-surface-default) var(--app-dash-first-rise-white));
}

.frame[data-first-focus='rise'] .overlay {
  bottom: var(--app-dash-first-rise-glow);
}

/* V9 (cards over the field): the clear part and the glow reach higher, up behind the cards. */
.frame[data-glow-rise='cards'][data-first-focus='rise'] .background::after {
  background: linear-gradient(to top, transparent var(--app-dash-cards-rise-clear), var(--l3-surface-default) var(--app-dash-cards-rise-white));
}

.frame[data-glow-rise='cards'][data-first-focus='rise'] .overlay {
  bottom: var(--app-dash-cards-rise-glow);
}

/* Some versions raise the glow — the white disc ends higher: behind the see-through dock (V7), or up behind the cards
   above the field as well (V9). */
.frame[data-glow-rise='dock'] .overlay {
  bottom: var(--app-dash-dock-glow-rise);
}

.frame[data-glow-rise='cards'] .overlay {
  bottom: var(--app-dash-cards-glow-rise);
}

/* Chatting (Version 2): the round disc gives way to a straight white veil (crossfade, 300 ms), so the glow at the bottom
   is a level band rising from the input's bottom edge — not the disc's curve. The conversation sits on the calm
   middle and fades into the band as it scrolls under the input. */
.frame[data-chatting] .overlay {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* The veil: white across the box, fading out linearly at the top (the glow behind the top bar) and towards the bottom:
   clear from the input's bottom edge (the dock's 16 + the OS bar), white again a band higher. */
.veil {
  --dash-veil-clear: calc(var(--os-inset-bottom, 0px) + var(--l3-spacing-16));
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  /* Drawn as the gradient itself (not a mask) so every browser shows it the same. */
  background: linear-gradient(
    to top,
    transparent var(--dash-veil-clear),
    var(--l3-surface-default) calc(var(--dash-veil-clear) + var(--app-dash-veil-band)),
    var(--l3-surface-default) 86%,
    transparent
  );
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

.frame[data-chatting] .veil {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* "grids": fine lines across the top, 360 × 116.8 on the 360 frame. */
.grids {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

/* Loss: the same gradient turned to the reds. */
.frame[data-tone='loss'] .gradient {
  filter: hue-rotate(-115deg) saturate(1.2);
}

/* The screen is see-through so the background shows; its parts bring their own surfaces. Edge to edge: the background
   runs under the OS bars, the screen's content stays clear of them (insets from the preview / the phone). */
.screen.screen {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding-top: var(--os-inset-top, 0px);
  padding-bottom: var(--os-inset-bottom, 0px);
  background: transparent;
}

/* DASH top bar: L3 Actionbar, see-through, no hairline (L3 gap: the Actionbar has no transparent option). */
.bar.bar {
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* V8 · Tabs: the kind tabs centred on the bar's 48 row (under the status-bar space), between back and the actions. */
.barWrap {
  position: relative;
}

/* The tabs' track on surface/primary (L3's pill group is surface/secondary): it sits on DASH's glow, not a white bar. */
.barCenter.barCenter {
  --pills-track: var(--l3-surface-primary);
}

.barCenter {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: var(--l3-size-48);
  translate: -50% 0;
}

/* DASH's top bar: its action buttons are always round (history, Your creations, the chat ⋮) — L3's small Tertiary
   button is a rounded square (radius 8). */
.bar.bar button {
  --btn-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .gradientBox {
    animation: none;
  }

  .background,
  .overlay,
  .veil {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/DashScreen.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, type ComponentProps, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Actionbar, type ActionbarProps } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Screen } from '../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import gradient from '../assets/bg-gradient.png'
import grids from '../assets/grids.svg'
import styles from './DashScreen.module.css'
import { useDashVersion } from './dashVersion'

/** brand = lime-green (every page); loss = the same gradient turned red, when the backtest says the rule would cost money. */
export type DashTone = 'brand' | 'loss'

type DashScreenProps = ComponentProps<typeof Screen> & {
  tone?: DashTone
  /** The keyboard is up: the background ends above it (Figma "3.1 Manual typing" — bg 516 tall on 800). */
  keyboard?: boolean
  /** Version 2, a conversation on screen: the soft dark disc stretches taller so the chat reads well on it. */
  chatting?: boolean
  /** The chat's first message is being typed: 'wash' — a white wash over the background (V9); 'rise' — the wash
   *  clears at the bottom and the glow climbs up behind the suggestions (V8). */
  firstFocus?: false | 'wash' | 'rise'
}

/**
 * A DASH AI page on DASH's background (Figma "DASH AI - better layout & structure", 6499:1405). The background is the
 * same on every DASH page and never moves between them (annotated: "remains consistent across the flow"):
 * - a rotating lime gradient (one turn every 3.08 s, ease-in then a pause — Figma motion);
 * - a soft white disc over it, blurred, so the middle of the page stays calm;
 * - a fine grid at the top.
 * Everything on it is a normal screen (top bar, body, bottom, sheet). With the keyboard up the background shrinks to
 * end above it (300 ms, ease-in-out). The page is edge to edge (data-edge-to-edge): it draws under the OS status and
 * navigation bars, which have no fill on DASH pages, so the gradient and its motion show behind them too.
 */
export function DashScreen({ tone = 'brand', keyboard = false, chatting = false, firstFocus = false, className, ...screen }: DashScreenProps) {
  // Some DASH versions raise the glow: behind the see-through dock (V7), or up behind the cards too (V9).
  const glowRise = useDashVersion().glowRise
  // The turning colour glow: normal speed for the first 5 s on DASH, then half speed (it slows from where it is — the
  // running animation's playback rate, so nothing jumps). The frame stays mounted across DASH screens, so this is
  // once per visit to DASH.
  const glow = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => glow.current?.getAnimations().forEach((a) => { a.playbackRate = GLOW_SLOW_RATE }), GLOW_FULL_SPEED_MS)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [])
  return (
    <div className={styles.frame} data-tone={tone} data-keyboard={keyboard || undefined} data-chatting={chatting || undefined} data-glow-rise={glowRise} data-first-focus={firstFocus || undefined} data-edge-to-edge="" data-dash="">
      <div className={styles.background} aria-hidden="true">
        <div ref={glow} className={styles.gradientBox}>
          <img src={gradient} alt="" className={styles.gradient} />
        </div>
        <span className={styles.overlay} />
        <span className={styles.veil} />
        <img src={grids} alt="" className={styles.grids} />
      </div>
      <Screen {...screen} className={[styles.screen, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} />
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * The L3 Actionbar on DASH's background: see-through (the gradient runs under it) and without the hairline. The DASH
 * pages carry no title (Figma): back on the left, one Tertiary action on the right.
 */
export function DashBar({ center, ...props }: ActionbarProps & { /** Something in the middle of the bar's row (V8 · Tabs: the kind tabs). */ center?: ReactNode }) {
  if (!center) return <Actionbar {...props} className={styles.bar} />
  return (
    <div className={styles.barWrap}>
      <Actionbar {...props} className={styles.bar} />
      <div className={styles.barCenter}>{center}</div>
    </div>
  )
}

/** The background glow turns at full speed this long after arriving on DASH, then at GLOW_SLOW_RATE. */
const GLOW_FULL_SPEED_MS = 5000
const GLOW_SLOW_RATE = 0.5
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/FirstAsk.tsx`

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { msFunction, msMonitoring, msRule } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { dashRules, savedIndicators } from '../data'
import { useDashUser, useDashVersion, type CreationKind } from './dashVersion'
import styles from './FirstAsk.module.css'

export type FirstAskKind = 'home' | 'rule' | 'indicator' | 'strategy'

const NUMBERS = ['1', '2', '3', '4'] as const

/**
 * DASH V7 / V8 / V10 · first message: while someone types the first message of a chat (on a home or in an empty chat),
 * suggestions stack up just above the field — for the picked kind (they flip with the field's pills), and once
 * something is typed, ones that finish it (they change with every key). A tap puts the text in the field. Gone once
 * the chat has started (the next messages type as usual, with the conversation in view).
 */
export function FirstAsk({ kind: place, mode, text = '', onPick, onKind }: {
  kind: FirstAskKind
  /** The field's picked pill (a home): the suggestions are for that kind and flip when it changes. */
  mode?: CreationKind
  /** What's in the field: once something is typed, the suggestions follow it (live, with every key). */
  text?: string
  onPick: (text: string) => void
  /** V10 Create: the kind picked (the field's pill follows). */
  onKind?: (kind: CreationKind) => void
}) {
  const firstCard = !!useDashVersion().firstCard
  const kind: FirstAskKind = place === 'home' && mode ? mode : place
  // Something typed: suggestions that finish it (V7, V8, V10).
  if (text.trim()) return <LiveAsk kind={kind} text={text} onPick={onPick} />
  // V10, nothing typed yet: one card — what they have of each kind, and Create.
  if (firstCard) return <FirstCreations onCreate={(k) => { onPick(t(`home9.start.${k}`)); onKind?.(k) }} />
  const items = NUMBERS.map((n) => t(`firstAsk.${kind}.${n}`))
  return (
    <div className={styles.list} role="group" aria-label={t('firstAsk.label')}>
      {items.map((text, i) => (
        <button key={text} type="button" className={styles.chip} style={{ '--i': i } as CSSProperties} onClick={() => onPick(text)}>
          {text}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

const ROWS: { kind: CreationKind; icon: typeof msRule }[] = [
  { kind: 'rule', icon: msRule },
  { kind: 'strategy', icon: msFunction },
  { kind: 'indicator', icon: msMonitoring },
]

/** What exists of each kind (sample data): how many, how many on. Strategies can't be made yet. */
const counts = (kind: CreationKind) =>
  kind === 'rule'
    ? { total: dashRules.length, active: dashRules.filter((r) => r.on).length }
    : kind === 'indicator'
      ? { total: savedIndicators.length, active: savedIndicators.filter((x) => x.on).length }
      : { total: 0, active: 0 }

/**
 * DASH V10 · first message: over the field, ONE glass card with a row per kind (no card look per row, like a list of
 * connectors): the kind's tile, its name, what they have — "3 of 8 rules active" (all on: "8 rules active"; none
 * made: "None yet") — and Create on the right; the whole row taps and puts the opening words in the field.
 */
export function FirstCreations({ onCreate }: { onCreate: (kind: CreationKind) => void }) {
  const { made } = useDashUser()
  const status = (kind: CreationKind) => {
    const { total, active } = counts(kind)
    if (!made[kind] || total === 0) return t(`firstCard.none.${kind}`)
    return active === total ? t(`firstCard.allActive.${kind}`, { count: total }) : t(`firstCard.someActive.${kind}`, { active, total })
  }
  return (
    <div className={styles.card} role="group" aria-label={t('firstCard.label')}>
      {ROWS.map(({ kind, icon }) => (
        <ListCell
          key={kind}
          className={styles.row}
          label={t(`firstCard.name.${kind}`)}
          description={status(kind)}
          iconLeft={<span className={styles.tile}><Icon icon={icon} size={20} /></span>}
          // The whole row taps (a tappable div, so the real Create button can sit inside it — keyboard and screen
          // readers use the button).
          as="div"
          onClick={() => onCreate(kind)}
          trailing={<Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" className={styles.create} aria-label={t(`firstCard.createLabel.${kind}`)} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onCreate(kind) }}>{t('firstCard.create')}</Button>}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

const TAILS = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6'] as const
const KINDS: CreationKind[] = ['rule', 'indicator', 'strategy']
/** Words that say nothing about what they want (and the opening words Create types). */
const STOP = new Set(['build', 'an', 'a', 'ai', 'that', 'the', 'me', 'my', 'i', 'to', 'of', 'on', 'for', 'and', 'with', 'when', 'in', 'it', 'is'])
const words = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9₹%\s]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)

/**
 * DASH V10 · as the first message is typed: suggestion pills that finish it, changing with every key — each shows a
 * request's ending (the typed words in bold) and a tap puts the whole request in the field ("Build an Ai rule that
 * caps my daily loss at ₹5,000"). The kind
 * comes from the opening words (Create typed them), the chat's kind, or — on the home — whichever match best.
 */
function LiveAsk({ kind, text, onPick }: { kind: FirstAskKind; text: string; onPick: (text: string) => void }) {
  // The opening words a Create typed ("Build an Ai rule that", or the row's "Build a rule that"): they set the kind.
  const openings = (k: CreationKind) => [t(`home9.start.${k}`), t(`home3.start.${k}`)].map((o) => o.trim())
  const opening = KINDS.flatMap((k) => openings(k).map((o) => ({ k, o }))).find(({ o }) => text.toLowerCase().startsWith(o.toLowerCase()))
  const started = opening?.k
  const kinds = started ? [started] : kind === 'home' ? KINDS : [kind]
  const typed = words(opening ? text.slice(opening.o.length) : text).filter((w) => !STOP.has(w))
  const pool = kinds.flatMap((k) => TAILS.map((n) => ({ kind: k, tail: t(`liveAsk.${k}.${n}`) })))
  const score = (tail: string) => {
    const ws = words(tail)
    return typed.filter((w) => ws.some((x) => x.startsWith(w))).length
  }
  const ranked = typed.length ? pool.map((p) => ({ ...p, score: score(p.tail) })).filter((p) => p.score > 0).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score) : pool
  const shown = (ranked.length ? ranked : pool).slice(0, 4)
  const bold = (tail: string) =>
    tail.split(/(\s+)/).map((part, i) => (typed.some((w) => part.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9₹%]/g, '').startsWith(w)) ? <strong key={i}>{part}</strong> : part))
  // The same pills as V8's suggestions (stacked, left-aligned): the request's ending, typed words in bold; a tap puts
  // the whole request in the field.
  return (
    <div className={styles.list} role="group" aria-label={t('liveAsk.label')}>
      {shown.map(({ kind: k, tail }, i) => (
        <button key={`${k}${tail}`} type="button" className={styles.chip} style={{ '--i': i } as CSSProperties} onClick={() => onPick(`${opening && opening.k === k ? `${opening.o} ` : t(`home9.start.${k}`)}${tail}`)}>
          {bold(tail)}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/IndicatorCard.module.css`

```css
/* Indicator card — border-light, radius 16 (designer's call, 2026-10-27), 12 inside, with the mini chart. */
.card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: clip;
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

/* Ready: the DASH green edge (wireframe: the ready card is outlined in lime). */
.card:not([data-state='building']) {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 60%, transparent);
}

.body {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-12) 0;
  transition: padding-bottom var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

/* Everything under the header folds away in the mini card (its height closes, 300 ms ease in and out). The 12 under
   the content lives inside the fold, so a raised button's shadow isn't clipped; the mini card brings its own 12. */
.fold {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  transition:
    grid-template-rows var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing),
    opacity var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

.foldBody {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* The padding sits one level in: a folded grid row can't shrink below its own child's padding. */
.foldContent {
  padding-block: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

.card[data-compact] .fold {
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  opacity: 0;
}

.card[data-compact] .body {
  padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-12);
}

/* Mini card: a small preview of the chart slides in beside the name (80 × 40, the card's corner language). */
.thumb {
  flex: none;
  width: 0;
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  margin-inline-end: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-12)); /* no gap while it's closed */
  overflow: clip;
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    width var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing),
    margin var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing),
    opacity var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

.thumbChart {
  display: grid;
  align-items: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: var(--l3-size-80);
  height: 100%;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08);
}

.card[data-compact] {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.card[data-compact] .thumb {
  width: var(--l3-size-80);
  margin-inline-end: 0;
  opacity: 1;
}

.card[data-compact] .title,
.card[data-compact] .meta {
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.card:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--l3-content-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.heading {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.eyebrow {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-10);
  letter-spacing: var(--app-dash-caps-tracking);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--l3-content-tertiary);
}

.title {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  animation: card-fade var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

.meta {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-tertiary);
}

.market {
  display: flex;
  margin-top: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.tag {
  flex: none;
  animation: card-pop var(--app-dash-pop-duration) var(--app-dash-pop-easing) both;
}

.chart {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.chart[data-openable] {
  cursor: zoom-in;
}

/* Expanded: the card has grown into the floating card (it shrinks back here on close). */
.card[data-lifted] {
  visibility: hidden;
}

/* A change was made: a soft band of DASH light sweeps across the card once (left to right, 1.2 s). */
.shimmer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(
    105deg,
    transparent 30%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-glow-1) 35%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 70%
  );
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  animation: card-shimmer var(--app-dash-shimmer) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard) var(--l3-motion-duration-short) both;
}

@keyframes card-shimmer {
  to { transform: translateX(100%); }
}

/* "Indicator updated", above the card for a moment: it opens and fades in, stays, then fades and closes (2.8 s). */
.updatedNote {
  display: grid;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--app-dash-green);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  animation: updated-note var(--app-dash-updated-note) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard) both;
}

.updatedNote > p {
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

@keyframes updated-note {
  0% { grid-template-rows: 0fr; opacity: 0; }
  12% { grid-template-rows: 1fr; opacity: 1; padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-08); }
  80% { grid-template-rows: 1fr; opacity: 1; padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-08); }
  100% { grid-template-rows: 0fr; opacity: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .shimmer {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* Parts: small pills tinted by what they are (wireframe: lime lines, blue labels). */
/* Part tags: L3 Tags (tertiary, in their colours); they pop in one after another. */
.part {
  animation: card-pop var(--app-dash-pop-duration) var(--app-dash-pop-easing) both;
}

/* Build steps: a spinner on the current one, a tick when done, a ring for the next ones. */
.steps {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.steps li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-tertiary);
}

.steps li[data-state='now'] {
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.stepMark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: none;
  width: var(--l3-size-16);
  height: var(--l3-size-16);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
}

.steps li[data-state='done'] .stepMark {
  border-color: transparent;
  background: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  color: var(--l3-static-white);
}

.steps li[data-state='now'] .stepMark {
  border-color: var(--app-dash-green) transparent var(--app-dash-green) var(--app-dash-green);
  animation: card-spin var(--l3-motion-duration-spin) linear infinite;
}

/* Notes: a warning row that folds open (wireframe "2 notes on the conversion"). */
.notes {
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--l3-border-light);
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.notesToggle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  width: 100%;
  min-height: var(--l3-size-32);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-warning-default);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.notesText {
  flex: 1;
}

.chevron {
  transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.notesToggle[aria-expanded='true'] .chevron {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.noteList {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 0 0 var(--l3-spacing-24);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  animation: card-fade var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

.noteList li + li {
  margin-top: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

@keyframes card-fade {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(var(--l3-spacing-04));
  }
}

@keyframes card-pop {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.6);
  }
}

@keyframes card-spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(1turn);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .title,
  .tag,
  .part,
  .noteList,
  .steps li[data-state='now'] .stepMark {
    animation: none;
  }

  .body,
  .fold,
  .thumb {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* Version 2: an earlier version, replaced by a newer card below — mini, dimmed, the plain light edge. */
.card[data-superseded] {
  border-color: var(--l3-border-light);
  opacity: var(--l3-opacity-60);
  transition: opacity var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/IndicatorCard.tsx`

```tsx
import { useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msCheck, msEdit, msError, msKeyboardArrowDown, msOpenInFull } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { buildSteps, markets, type IndicatorDraft, type IndicatorSettings, type Market } from '../indicatorData'
import { IndicatorFullView } from './IndicatorFullView'
import { MarketPicker } from './MarketPicker'
import { MiniChart } from './MiniChart'
import styles from './IndicatorCard.module.css'

/** The part tags (L3 Tag, tertiary): each part in its meaning's colour — the trend success, the EMA discover,
 *  BUY profit, SELL loss. */
const PART_COLOR = { trend: 'success', average: 'discover', buy: 'profit', sell: 'loss' } as const

/** Where the indicator is: being built (with the step reached) or ready to save. */
/** Where the indicator is: being built (step reached), ready to review, or saved (Version 2 keeps it in the chat). */
export type IndicatorCardState = { kind: 'building'; step: 0 | 1 | 2 } | { kind: 'ready' } | { kind: 'saved' }

type IndicatorCardProps = {
  draft: IndicatorDraft
  state: IndicatorCardState
  /** Its name is known (shown from step 1 of the build — "taking shape"). */
  named?: boolean
  sellTone?: 'sell' | 'orange'
  onModify?: () => void
  onSave?: () => void
  /** Mini: the user scrolled the chat — only a small preview, the name and the tag stay (the rest folds away). */
  compact?: boolean
  /** Tapping the mini card opens it again. */
  onExpand?: () => void
  /** Version 2: a newer version was shared below — this one folds to its mini form, dimmed, tagged "Earlier version". */
  superseded?: boolean
  /** What the chart is drawn with (timeframe, EMA, Supertrend) — a change in the chat redraws it. */
  settings?: IndicatorSettings
  /** The build's steps (default: from a request; a Pine Script has its own). */
  steps?: readonly string[]
  /** A changed version: the chart plays its build again (and again on each new change), so it reads as recreated. */
  redrawn?: boolean
  /** Counts the changes made so far: each new one shows "Indicator updated" above the card for a moment and runs a
   *  shimmer across it. 0 / unset: nothing. */
  updated?: number
}

/**
 * The indicator being built, pinned above the chat (like the rule card in Trading rules) — but it shows a mini live
 * chart instead of text (wireframe "AI Indicator"):
 * - building: "Your indicator" → its name; a wave → candles with the lines drawing in; the parts appear as chips;
 *   three steps tick through;
 * - ready: Ready tag, BUY / SELL labels on the chart, where it goes, DASH's notes (fold open), Modify and Save indicator;
 * - mini (compact): while the user scrolls the chat, the chart, chips, notes and button fold away
 *   and a small preview slides in beside the name (300 ms, ease in and out) — the chat gets the room. Tap to open.
 */
export function IndicatorCard({ draft, state, named = state.kind !== 'building' || state.step > 0, sellTone, onModify, onSave, compact = false, onExpand, superseded = false, settings, redrawn = false, updated = 0, steps = buildSteps }: IndicatorCardProps) {
  const [notesOpen, setNotesOpen] = useState(false)
  const [fullView, setFullView] = useState(false)
  /** The index the chart is drawn on (the picker; the full view shares it). */
  const [market, setMarket] = useState<Market>(markets[0])
  const card = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
  // The full view covers the DASH screen the card is on.
  const container = fullView ? card.current?.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-dash]') : null
  const showTags = true // the part tags (Supertrend · EMA 20 · BUY · SELL) always show
  const building = state.kind === 'building'
  const stage = building ? (state.step === 0 ? 'sketch' : 'candles') : 'ready'
  const mini = (compact || superseded) && !building

  // The part tags and DASH's notes: on the card and in its full view (the same pieces).
  const parts = showTags && (named || !building) ? (
                <Stack direction="horizontal" gap="08" wrap className={styles.parts}>
                  {draft.parts.map((p, i) => (
                    <Tag key={p.label} variant="tertiary" size="sm" color={PART_COLOR[p.tone]} className={styles.part} style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 90}ms` }}>
                      {p.kind === 'line' && building ? t('indicator.linePart', { name: p.label }) : p.label}
                    </Tag>
                  ))}
                </Stack>
  ) : null
  const notes = (
                  <div className={styles.notes}>
                    <button type="button" className={styles.notesToggle} aria-expanded={notesOpen} onClick={() => setNotesOpen((o) => !o)}>
                      <Icon icon={msError} size={16} />
                      <span className={styles.notesText}>{t('indicator.notes', { count: draft.notes.length })}</span>
                      <Icon icon={msKeyboardArrowDown} size={16} className={styles.chevron} />
                    </button>
                    {notesOpen && (
                      <ul className={styles.noteList}>
                        {draft.notes.map((n) => <li key={n}>{n}</li>)}
                      </ul>
                    )}
                  </div>
  )
  return (
    <>
    {updated > 0 && (
      <div key={`note-${updated}`} className={styles.updatedNote} role="status">
        <p>{t('indicator.updatedNote')}</p>
      </div>
    )}
    <article
      ref={card}
      className={styles.card}
      data-lifted={fullView || undefined}
      data-state={state.kind}
      data-compact={mini || undefined}
      data-superseded={superseded || undefined}
      aria-label={named ? draft.name : t('indicator.yourIndicator')}
      {...(mini && onExpand && { role: 'button', tabIndex: 0, 'aria-expanded': false, onClick: onExpand, onKeyDown: (e: KeyboardEvent) => (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && onExpand?.() })}
    >
      {updated > 0 && <span key={`shimmer-${updated}`} className={styles.shimmer} aria-hidden="true" />}
      <div className={styles.body}>
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align={mini ? 'center' : 'start'} justify="between" gap="12">
          {!building && (
            <div className={styles.thumb} aria-hidden="true">
              <div className={styles.thumbChart}>
                <MiniChart stage="ready" sellTone={sellTone} settings={settings} axes={false} />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <Stack gap="04" className={styles.heading}>
            {building && <span className={styles.eyebrow}>{t('indicator.building')}</span>}
            <h2 key={named ? 'named' : 'unnamed'} className={styles.title}>{named ? draft.name : t('indicator.yourIndicator')}</h2>
            {/* Which index it's drawn on: right under the name (where the description was). Not on the mini card. */}
            {!building && !mini && <span className={styles.market}><MarketPicker market={market} onChange={setMarket} timeframe={settings?.timeframe} /></span>}
          </Stack>
          {/* Top right: the expand button (the full view) where a Ready tag used to be — on the mini card too; Saved still
              shows its tag. An earlier version is tagged so. */}
          {!building && (
            superseded ? (
              <Tag color="neutral" size="sm" className={styles.tag}>{t('indicator.earlierTag')}</Tag>
            ) : (
              <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08" className={styles.tag}>
                {state.kind === 'saved' && <Tag color="success" size="sm">{t('indicator.savedTag')}</Tag>}
                {/* On the mini card too (it folds while the chat scrolls): straight to the full view — the tap stays here,
                    it doesn't also unfold the card. */}
                <Button
                  variant="tertiary"
                  size="sm"
                  iconLeft={<Icon icon={msOpenInFull} />}
                  aria-label={t('indicator.expand')}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation()
                    setFullView(true)
                  }}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                />
              </Stack>
            )
          )}
        </Stack>

        <div className={styles.fold} inert={mini || undefined}>
          <div className={styles.foldBody}>
            <Stack gap="12" className={styles.foldContent}>
              {/* A tap anywhere on the chart opens the full view too (the expand button is its accessible way). */}
              <div className={styles.chart} data-openable={!building || undefined} onClick={building ? undefined : () => setFullView(true)}>
                <MiniChart key={redrawn ? JSON.stringify(settings) : undefined} stage={stage} sellTone={sellTone} settings={settings} redraw={redrawn} market={market} />
              </div>

              {parts}

              {building ? (
                <Stack as="ol" gap="08" className={styles.steps}>
                  {steps.map((label, i) => (
                    <li key={label} data-state={i < state.step ? 'done' : i === state.step ? 'now' : 'next'}>
                      <span className={styles.stepMark} aria-hidden="true">{i < state.step && <Icon icon={msCheck} size={12} />}</span>
                      {label}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </Stack>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {notes}
                  {state.kind === 'ready' && (
                    <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
                      <Button variant="secondary" fullWidth iconLeft={<Icon icon={msEdit} />} onClick={onModify}>{t('indicator.modify')}</Button>
                      <Button variant="primary" fullWidth onClick={onSave}>{t('indicator.save')}</Button>
                    </Stack>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </Stack>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {fullView && container && card.current && (
        <IndicatorFullView
          draft={draft}
          settings={settings}
          market={market}
          onMarket={setMarket}
          sellTone={sellTone}
          container={container}
          cardEl={card.current}
          tag={state.kind === 'saved' ? <Tag color="success" size="sm">{t('indicator.savedTag')}</Tag> : undefined}
          parts={parts}
          notes={notes}
          onClose={() => setFullView(false)}
          onModify={state.kind === 'ready' && onModify ? () => { setFullView(false); onModify() } : undefined}
          onSave={state.kind === 'ready' && onSave ? () => { setFullView(false); onSave() } : undefined}
        />
      )}
    </article>
    </>
  )
}
```

```css
/*
 * The expanded indicator card: a big floating card in the middle of the DASH screen (16 from the sides, ≈ 80 % of
 * the height), styled like the card (radius 16, the DASH green edge, 12 inside), over the scrim. Growing out of the
 * card and back is a Web Animation of its box (IndicatorFullView.tsx).
 */
.layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 5;
}

.scrim {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--l3-surface-overlay);
  animation: full-view-scrim var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--app-dash-scene-easing) both;
}

.layer[data-closing] .scrim {
  animation: full-view-scrim var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--app-dash-scene-easing) reverse both;
}

@keyframes full-view-scrim {
  from { opacity: 0; }
}

.panel {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc((100% - var(--app-dash-full-view-height)) / 2);
  left: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: calc(100% - 2 * var(--l3-spacing-16));
  height: var(--app-dash-full-view-height);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 60%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  box-shadow: var(--l3-shadow-elevation-high);
}

/* The chart takes all the room left, to the card's left edge; drags belong to it (nothing else scrolls here). */
.chart {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-12));
  overflow: hidden;
  touch-action: none;
  cursor: grab;
  user-select: none; /* dragging the chart on a laptop doesn't select its labels */
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.chart:active {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.fit {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/IndicatorFullView.tsx`

```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msCloseFullscreen, msEdit } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import type { IndicatorDraft, IndicatorSettings, Market } from '../indicatorData'
import { MarketPicker } from './MarketPicker'
import { MiniChart } from './MiniChart'
import card from './IndicatorCard.module.css'
import styles from './IndicatorFullView.module.css'

/** The expand / collapse (= motion duration medium, designer: quick): the card grows into the floating card and back. */
const MOVE_MS = 250
const EASE_OPEN = 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)'
const EASE_CLOSE = 'cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15)'

type Box = { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number }

type IndicatorFullViewProps = {
  draft: IndicatorDraft
  settings?: IndicatorSettings
  sellTone?: 'sell' | 'orange'
  /** Where the sheet opens: the DASH screen the card is on. */
  container: HTMLElement
  /** The card itself: the floating card grows out of it and shrinks back into it. */
  cardEl: HTMLElement
  /** The index it's drawn on, and switching it (shared with the card). */
  market: Market
  onMarket: (market: Market) => void
  /** The card's own pieces, the same here: a Saved tag, the part tags and DASH's notes. */
  tag?: ReactNode
  parts?: ReactNode
  notes?: ReactNode
  onClose: () => void
  /** While it's being worked on (ready, not saved yet): the card's Modify and Save indicator. */
  onModify?: () => void
  onSave?: () => void
}

/**
 * The indicator card, expanded: the card itself grows from where it sits into a big floating card in the middle of
 * the screen (16 from the sides, ≈ 80 % of the height), over a scrim — and shrinks back into its place on close. It
 * keeps the card's layout as it is: the name and where it goes (collapse at the top right, where expand was), the chart
 * (filling the room, moving / zooming like Scalper's — no hint: people know these gestures), the part tags, DASH's
 * notes, and Modify / Save indicator. The box's size is what animates (not a stretch), so the chart redraws as it
 * grows. Collapse, a tap on the dark area around it, or Esc closes it (taps on the chart don't); Modify and Save close
 * it and carry on.
 */
export function IndicatorFullView({ draft, settings, sellTone, container, cardEl, market, onMarket, tag, parts, notes, onClose, onModify, onSave }: IndicatorFullViewProps) {
  const panel = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false)
  const reduced = () => matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches

  /** An element's box in the container's own px (the phone mockup may be scaled on screen). */
  const boxOf = (el: Element): Box => {
    const c = container.getBoundingClientRect()
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const scale = c.width / container.offsetWidth || 1
    return { left: (r.left - c.left) / scale, top: (r.top - c.top) / scale, width: r.width / scale, height: r.height / scale }
  }
  const frame = (b: Box) => ({ left: `${b.left}px`, top: `${b.top}px`, width: `${b.width}px`, height: `${b.height}px` })

  // Open: from the card's box to the floating card's (its place at rest, set by CSS).
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const p = panel.current
    if (!p || reduced()) return
    p.getAnimations().forEach((a) => a.cancel()) // dev mode runs this twice
    p.animate([frame(boxOf(cardEl)), frame(boxOf(p))], { duration: MOVE_MS, easing: EASE_OPEN })
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [])

  /** Close: shrink back into the card, then close (`then`: Modify / Save carry on after). */
  const close = (then?: () => void) => {
    if (closing) return
    const done = () => {
      onClose()
      then?.()
    }
    const p = panel.current
    if (!p || reduced()) return done()
    setClosing(true)
    p.animate([frame(boxOf(p)), frame(boxOf(cardEl))], { duration: MOVE_MS, easing: EASE_CLOSE, fill: 'forwards' })
    window.setTimeout(done, MOVE_MS) // on time even where animations don't run (a hidden tab)
  }

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === 'Escape' && close()
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  })

  return createPortal(
    <div className={styles.layer} data-closing={closing || undefined}>
      {/* A tap on the dark area around it closes it (taps on the card and its chart don't). */}
      <div className={styles.scrim} onClick={() => close()} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className={styles.panel} ref={panel} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={draft.name}>
        {/* The card's header, as on the card: name, where it goes, collapse in the expand button's place. */}
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="start" justify="between" gap="12">
          <Stack gap="04" className={card.heading}>
            <h2 className={card.title}>{draft.name}</h2>
          </Stack>
          <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
            {tag}
            <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msCloseFullscreen} />} aria-label={t('indicator.collapse')} onClick={() => close()} />
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
        <MarketPicker market={market} onChange={onMarket} timeframe={settings?.timeframe} />
        <div className={styles.chart}>
          <FitChart sellTone={sellTone} settings={settings} market={market} interactive />
        </div>
        <Stack gap="12">
          {parts}
          {notes}
          {onSave && (
            <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
              <Button variant="secondary" fullWidth iconLeft={<Icon icon={msEdit} />} onClick={() => close(onModify)}>{t('indicator.modify')}</Button>
              <Button variant="primary" fullWidth onClick={() => close(onSave)}>{t('indicator.save')}</Button>
            </Stack>
          )}
        </Stack>
      </div>
    </div>,
    container,
  )
}

/** The indicator chart filling its box: its height follows the box's shape (redrawn as the box grows or shrinks). */
function FitChart({ settings, sellTone, market, interactive = false }: { settings?: IndicatorSettings; sellTone?: 'sell' | 'orange'; market?: Market; interactive?: boolean }) {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [height, setHeight] = useState(150)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = box.current
    if (!el) return
    const fit = () => el.clientWidth > 0 && setHeight(Math.max(120, Math.round((300 * el.clientHeight) / el.clientWidth)))
    fit()
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(fit)
    ro.observe(el)
    return () => ro.disconnect()
  }, [])
  return (
    <div className={styles.fit} ref={box}>
      <MiniChart stage="ready" sellTone={sellTone} settings={settings} height={height} interactive={interactive} market={market} />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/MarketPicker.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msCheck, msKeyboardArrowDown } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { markets, type Market } from '../indicatorData'
import styles from './MarketPicker.module.css'

/**
 * Which index the indicator is drawn on: an L3 Tag (tertiary, neutral grey) with the index and a down caret — it's a
 * dropdown. A tap opens the list of F&O indices (NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY, SENSEX, FINNIFTY, MIDCPNIFTY); picking
 * one redraws the chart on it. Each option is an L3 list cell (Small), the chosen one selected with a ✓.
 */
export function MarketPicker({ market, onChange }: { market: Market; onChange: (market: Market) => void; timeframe?: number }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const listId = useId()
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  // The menu opens over the whole DASH screen (not inside the card, which clips its shadow), under the trigger.
  const [place, setPlace] = useState<{ host: HTMLElement; left: number; top: number } | null>(null)
  const toggle = () => {
    if (open) return setOpen(false)
    const button = trigger.current
    const host = button?.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-dash]')
    if (!button || !host) return
    const h = host.getBoundingClientRect()
    const b = button.getBoundingClientRect()
    const scale = h.width / host.offsetWidth || 1 // the phone mockup may be scaled on screen
    setPlace({ host, left: (b.left - h.left) / scale, top: (b.bottom - h.top) / scale })
    setOpen(true)
  }

  return (
    <span className={styles.wrap}>
      <button ref={trigger} type="button" className={styles.picker} aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={listId} aria-label={t('market.pick', { name: market.name })} onClick={toggle}>
        <Tag variant="tertiary" color="neutral" size="md" iconRight={<Icon icon={msKeyboardArrowDown} />}>{market.name}</Tag>
      </button>
      {open && place && createPortal(
        <>
          <span className={styles.backdrop} onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span className={styles.menu} id={listId} role="menu" aria-label={t('market.label')} style={{ left: place.left, top: place.top }}>
            {markets.map((m) => (
              <ListCell
                key={m.id}
                as="button"
                size="sm"
                label={m.name}
                selected={m.id === market.id}
                iconRight={m.id === market.id ? <Icon icon={msCheck} /> : undefined}
                onClick={() => {
                  onChange(m)
                  setOpen(false)
                }}
                className={styles.option}
              />
            ))}
          </span>
        </>,
        place.host,
      )}
    </span>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/MiniChart.module.css`

```css
/*
 * The indicator preview. SVG geometry is artwork (viewBox units); colours are L3 tokens. Motion: candles fade up one
 * after another, then each line draws itself left to right (stroke-dashoffset 1 → 0), then the labels pop in.
 */
.chart[data-interactive] {
  touch-action: none; /* the full view's drags and pinches are the chart's, not the page's */
}

.chart {
  display: block;
  user-select: none; /* the chart's labels never get selected (dragging it in the full view) */
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  overflow: visible;
}

/* sketch: a faint wave that keeps running while DASH reads the request */
.sketch {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--app-dash-glow-1);
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-dasharray: 0.35 0.65;
  opacity: var(--l3-opacity-60);
  animation: mini-sketch 1.4s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes mini-sketch {
  from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; }
  to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
}

.candles g {
  stroke: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
  fill: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
  opacity: var(--l3-opacity-60);
  animation: mini-candle var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

.candles g[data-up] {
  stroke: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
  fill: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
}

.candles line {
  stroke-width: 1;
}

@keyframes mini-candle {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(6px);
  }
}

.ema,
.trend {
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 1.6;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  stroke-dasharray: 1;
  stroke-dashoffset: 1;
  animation: mini-draw 900ms var(--l3-motion-easing-standard) 500ms forwards;
}

.ema {
  stroke: var(--l3-content-accent-discover-default);
}

.trend {
  stroke: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.trend[data-up] {
  stroke: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
}

/* Axes (like Scalper's chart): hairlines, price and time labels in secondary text, the last price tagged green.
   Labels are 10 px on screen: --mini-label is that size in the chart's viewBox units (MiniChart.tsx). */
.axisLine {
  stroke: var(--l3-border-light);
  stroke-width: 0.8;
}

.tick,
.timeframe,
.lastText {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  font-size: var(--mini-label, 8px);
}

.tick {
  fill: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.timeframe {
  fill: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
  font-size: var(--mini-label, 8px);
}

.lastLine {
  stroke: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
  stroke-width: 0.8;
  stroke-dasharray: 3 2;
}

.lastTag {
  fill: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-default);
}

.lastText {
  fill: var(--l3-static-white);
}

@keyframes mini-draw {
  to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
}

/* ready: lines already drawn (no replay), labels pop in */
.chart[data-stage='ready']:not([data-redraw]) .ema,
.chart[data-stage='ready']:not([data-redraw]) .trend {
  animation: none;
  stroke-dashoffset: 0;
}

.chart[data-stage='ready']:not([data-redraw]) .candles g {
  animation: none;
}

/* redraw (a change was made): the whole build plays again — candles, lines, then the labels once the lines are in. */
.chart[data-redraw] .signal {
  animation-delay: calc(var(--app-dash-redraw-labels) + var(--signal-delay, 0ms));
}

.signal {
  animation: mini-pop var(--app-dash-pop-duration) var(--app-dash-pop-easing) both;
}

.signal rect {
  fill: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
}

.signal[data-side='sell'] rect {
  fill: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
}

.signal[data-side='orange'] rect {
  fill: var(--l3-content-accent-orange-default);
}

.signal text {
  fill: var(--l3-static-white);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-10);
  font-size: 7px; /* viewBox units: the chart scales to ≈ 1.1 × on a 328 card */
  text-anchor: middle;
}

@keyframes mini-pop {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.4);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .sketch,
  .candles g,
  .ema,
  .trend,
  .signal {
    animation: none;
  }

  .ema,
  .trend {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/MiniChart.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type Dispatch, type MouseEvent, type PointerEvent, type SetStateAction, type WheelEvent } from 'react'
import { defaultSettings, ema, markets, sampleCandles, supertrend, timeframeShort, type IndicatorSettings, type Market } from '../indicatorData'
import styles from './MiniChart.module.css'

/**
 * - `sketch`: DASH is still reading — a faint wave runs across (no candles yet);
 * - `candles`: the candles are in, the indicator lines draw themselves in;
 * - `ready`: lines drawn, BUY / SELL labels pop in where the Supertrend flips.
 */
export type MiniChartStage = 'sketch' | 'candles' | 'ready'

const W = 300 // viewBox units — the SVG scales to its box's width
const CARD_H = 150 // the card's chart; the full view passes its own height (`height`)
const PAD = 8
const LABEL_PX = 10 // the axis labels (prices, times, the last price, the timeframe): 10 screen px at any chart size
const TIME_EVERY = 12 // a time label every 12 candles
const SESSION_START = 9 * 60 + 15 // 09:15
const SESSION = 375 // 09:15 → 15:30, in minutes
const HISTORY = 240 // candles behind the chart: the full view can slide back through them
const VISIBLE = 60 // candles on screen (the card; the full view starts here)
const MIN_VISIBLE = 20 // the full view's closest zoom
const MAX_VISIBLE = 200 // …and its widest
const AXIS_DRAG = 120 // px of axis drag that doubles / halves the scale

type MiniChartProps = {
  stage: MiniChartStage
  sellTone?: 'sell' | 'orange'
  settings?: IndicatorSettings
  /** false: the bare chart (the mini card's thumbnail). */
  axes?: boolean
  /** A changed indicator: the ready chart plays its build again (candles up, lines drawing in, then the labels). */
  redraw?: boolean
  /** The chart's height in viewBox units (its width is always 300): the full view fills its space with it. */
  height?: number
  /** The full view: the chart works like Scalper's (see `useChartGestures`). */
  interactive?: boolean
  /** Which index it's drawn on (the card's picker): its price level and its own sample walk. Default NIFTY 50. */
  market?: Market
}

/** What the full view's gestures change: the candles on screen and, once the price axis is touched, its scale. */
type View = {
  /** Index after the last candle on screen (HISTORY = the latest). */
  end: number
  /** Candles on screen (zoom on the time axis). */
  count: number
  /** Price range × this (1 = fitted to the candles; > 1 = squashed, < 1 = stretched). */
  yScale: number
  /** The price range moved up / down (in prices), once the price axis is set by hand. */
  yShift: number
}
const fitted: View = { end: HISTORY, count: VISIBLE, yScale: 1, yShift: 0 }

/**
 * The live preview on the indicator card: sample candles with the indicator drawn on them — Supertrend (green while
 * up, red while down), the EMA (blue) and BUY / SELL labels — with a price axis on the right (the last price tagged),
 * a time axis under it and the timeframe in the corner, like Scalper's chart. Drawn from `settings`, so a change to
 * the timeframe, the EMA or the Supertrend redraws it. It shows the latest 60 of 240 candles; `interactive` (the full
 * view) lets the user move and zoom it like a trading chart.
 */
export function MiniChart({ stage, sellTone = 'sell', settings = defaultSettings, axes = true, redraw = false, height = CARD_H, interactive = false, market = markets[0] }: MiniChartProps) {
  const { timeframe, emaPeriod, stPeriod, stMultiplier } = settings
  const H = height
  const clipId = useId()
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>(fitted)
  const { end, count, yScale, yShift } = view
  // The chart scales with its width, so the labels are sized from it: LABEL_PX on screen, whatever the chart's size.
  // The price axis and the time axis make room for them.
  const svg = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const [shownWidth, setShownWidth] = useState(336)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = svg.current
    if (!el) return
    const measure = () => el.clientWidth > 0 && setShownWidth(el.clientWidth)
    measure()
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure)
    ro.observe(el)
    return () => ro.disconnect()
  }, [])
  const font = (LABEL_PX * W) / shownWidth // the labels' size in viewBox units
  const AXIS = Math.round(font * 4.4) // the price axis on the right, past its line (fits "22672.7")
  const TIME = Math.round(font * 1.8) // the time axis under the plot
  const series = useMemo(() => {
    const candles = sampleCandles(HISTORY, market.start, timeframe, market.walk)
    return { candles, avg: ema(candles, emaPeriod), trend: supertrend(candles, stPeriod, stMultiplier) }
  }, [timeframe, emaPeriod, stPeriod, stMultiplier, market])
  const data = useMemo(() => {
    const first = end - count
    const { avg, trend } = series
    const candles = series.candles.slice(first, end)
    const line = trend.line.slice(first, end)
    const ema = avg.slice(first, end)
    const values = candles.flatMap((c) => [c.high, c.low]).concat(line, ema)
    // Fitted to what's on screen, then scaled / moved if the price axis was set by hand.
    const mid = (Math.min(...values) + Math.max(...values)) / 2 + yShift
    const half = ((Math.max(...values) - Math.min(...values)) / 2) * yScale
    const min = mid - half
    const max = mid + half
    const plotW = axes ? W - AXIS : W
    const plotH = axes ? H - TIME : H
    // The full view runs to the screen's left edge (no gap before the first candle); the card keeps a little room.
    const padLeft = interactive ? 0 : PAD
    const step = (plotW - padLeft - PAD) / count
    const x = (i: number) => padLeft + step * (i + 0.5)
    const y = (v: number) => PAD + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min)) * (plotH - PAD * 2)
    const path = (vs: number[], from = 0) => vs.slice(from).map((v, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(i + from).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join('')
    // Supertrend as runs of one direction, so each run takes its colour.
    const up = trend.up.slice(first, end)
    const runs: { up: boolean; d: string }[] = []
    let start = 0
    for (let i = 1; i <= count; i++) {
      if (i === count || up[i] !== up[start]) {
        runs.push({ up: up[start], d: path(line.slice(0, i), start) })
        start = i
      }
    }
    const last = candles[count - 1].close
    const ticks = niceTicks(min, max, Math.max(3, Math.round(plotH / (font * 4)))).filter((v) => y(v) > PAD && y(v) < plotH - PAD && Math.abs(y(v) - y(last)) > font * 1.3)
    // About five time labels, staying with their candles as the chart moves (every Nth candle of the whole history).
    const every = Math.max(6, Math.round(count / 4 / 6) * 6) // about four (a 10 px time label is wide)
    const times = candles.map((_, i) => i).filter((i) => (first + i) % every === every / 2)
    const signals = trend.signals.filter((s) => s.index > first && s.index < end).map((s) => ({ ...s, index: s.index - first }))
    return { first, candles, x, y, step, plotW, plotH, min, max, last, ticks, times, ema: path(ema), runs, signals }
  }, [series, end, count, yScale, yShift, axes, H, interactive, AXIS, TIME, font])

  const gestures = useChartGestures(interactive, view, setView, data)

  return (
    <svg ref={svg} viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${axes ? H : H - TIME}`} style={{ '--mini-label': `${font}px` } as CSSProperties} className={styles.chart} data-stage={stage} data-redraw={redraw || undefined} data-interactive={interactive || undefined} aria-hidden="true" {...gestures}>
      {stage === 'sketch' ? (
        <path className={styles.sketch} d={`M${PAD},${H / 2} C 60,${H / 2 - 30} 100,${H / 2 + 30} 150,${H / 2} S 240,${H / 2 - 30} ${W - PAD},${H / 2}`} pathLength={1} />
      ) : (
        <>
          {axes && (
            <g className={styles.axes}>
              <line className={styles.axisLine} x1={data.plotW + 0.5} y1={0} x2={data.plotW + 0.5} y2={data.plotH} />
              <line className={styles.axisLine} x1={0} y1={data.plotH + 0.5} x2={W} y2={data.plotH + 0.5} />
              {data.ticks.map((v) => (
                <text key={v} className={styles.tick} x={data.plotW + 4} y={data.y(v)} dominantBaseline="central">{Math.round(v)}</text>
              ))}
              {data.times.map((i) => (
                <g key={i}>
                  <line className={styles.axisLine} x1={data.x(i)} x2={data.x(i)} y1={data.plotH} y2={data.plotH + 3} />
                  <text className={styles.tick} x={data.x(i)} y={data.plotH + TIME / 2 + 1} textAnchor="middle" dominantBaseline="central">{timeAt(data.first + i, timeframe, data.times[data.times.indexOf(i) - 1] === undefined ? undefined : data.first + data.times[data.times.indexOf(i) - 1])}</text>
                </g>
              ))}
              <text className={styles.timeframe} x={data.plotW + AXIS / 2} y={data.plotH + TIME / 2 + 1} textAnchor="middle" dominantBaseline="central">{timeframeShort(timeframe)}</text>
              {/* last price: a dashed line to the axis, then the tag */}
              <line className={styles.lastLine} x1={data.x(data.candles.length - 1)} y1={data.y(data.last)} x2={data.plotW} y2={data.y(data.last)} />
              <rect className={styles.lastTag} x={data.plotW + 1} y={data.y(data.last) - font * 0.75} width={AXIS - 1} height={font * 1.5} rx={2} />
              <text className={styles.lastText} x={data.plotW + 3} y={data.y(data.last)} dominantBaseline="central">{data.last.toFixed(1)}</text>
            </g>
          )}
          <defs>
            <clipPath id={clipId}>
              <rect x={0} y={0} width={data.plotW} height={data.plotH} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>
          <g clipPath={`url(#${clipId})`}>
          <g className={styles.candles}>
            {data.candles.map((c, i) => {
              const up = c.close >= c.open
              const bodyTop = data.y(Math.max(c.open, c.close))
              const bodyH = Math.max(1, Math.abs(data.y(c.open) - data.y(c.close)))
              return (
                <g key={i} data-up={up || undefined} style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 8}ms` }}>
                  <line x1={data.x(i)} x2={data.x(i)} y1={data.y(c.high)} y2={data.y(c.low)} />
                  <rect x={data.x(i) - data.step * 0.3} width={data.step * 0.6} y={bodyTop} height={bodyH} />
                </g>
              )
            })}
          </g>
          <path className={styles.ema} d={data.ema} pathLength={1} />
          {data.runs.map((r, i) => (
            <path key={i} className={styles.trend} data-up={r.up || undefined} d={r.d} pathLength={1} />
          ))}
          {stage === 'ready' &&
            data.signals.map((s, i) => {
              const c = data.candles[s.index]
              const buy = s.side === 'buy'
              const cx = data.x(s.index)
              const cy = buy ? data.y(c.low) + 12 : data.y(c.high) - 12
              return (
                <g key={i} className={styles.signal} data-side={buy ? 'buy' : sellTone} style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 70}ms`, '--signal-delay': `${i * 70}ms`, transformOrigin: `${cx}px ${cy}px` } as CSSProperties}>
                  <rect x={cx - 13} y={cy - 6} width={26} height={12} rx={3} />
                  <text x={cx} y={cy + 3}>{buy ? 'BUY' : 'SELL'}</text>
                </g>
              )
            })}
          </g>
        </>
      )}
    </svg>
  )
}

/** Round price steps (1, 2, 5 × 10ⁿ) for about `labels` labels (more on a taller chart). */
function niceTicks(lo: number, hi: number, labels = 4) {
  const raw = (hi - lo) / labels
  const pow = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw))
  const step = [1, 2, 5, 10].map((m) => m * pow).find((s) => s >= raw) ?? raw
  const first = Math.ceil(lo / step) * step
  return Array.from({ length: Math.floor((hi - first) / step) + 1 }, (_, k) => first + k * step)
}

/**
 * The label under candle `i`: market hours only (09:15–15:30), so longer candles run back over earlier days. A label
 * on a new day shows that day's date instead of a time (like trading charts); daily candles always show the date.
 * The last candle opened at 14:15 today (27 Oct).
 */
function timeAt(g: number, timeframe: number, previous?: number) {
  const date = (daysBack: number) => new Date(2026, 9, 27 - daysBack).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })
  const back = HISTORY - 1 - g // candles before the latest one
  if (timeframe >= 1440) return date(Math.round((back * timeframe) / 1440))
  const at = (candlesBack: number) => 14 * 60 + 15 - SESSION_START - candlesBack * timeframe // minutes into today's session (may be < 0)
  const dayOf = (k: number) => Math.floor(at(HISTORY - 1 - k) / SESSION)
  const day = dayOf(g)
  if (previous !== undefined && dayOf(previous) !== day) return date(-day)
  const t = SESSION_START + (((at(back) % SESSION) + SESSION) % SESSION)
  return `${Math.floor(t / 60)}:${String(t % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`
}

/**
 * The full view's gestures, like Scalper's trading chart (TradingView-style):
 * - drag the chart: move it — sideways through time (right = back), up / down once the price axis is set by hand;
 * - drag the price axis (right) up / down: stretch / squash the prices (it stops fitting itself to the candles);
 * - drag the time axis (bottom) sideways: zoom — right = fewer, wider candles; left = more, narrower;
 * - wheel / trackpad: up / down zooms the time, sideways moves it; pinch (two fingers) zooms the time;
 * - double-tap / double-click: on the price axis, fit the prices again; anywhere else, back to the start.
 * The latest candle stays at the right edge while zooming the time (like Scalper), unless you've moved back.
 */
function useChartGestures(
  on: boolean,
  view: View,
  setView: Dispatch<SetStateAction<View>>,
  data: { step: number; plotW: number; plotH: number; min: number; max: number },
) {
  const start = useRef<{ zone: 'chart' | 'price' | 'time'; x: number; y: number; view: View; pxPerUnit: number } | null>(null)
  const pointers = useRef(new Map<number, number>()) // pointer id → x, for the pinch
  const pinch = useRef<{ gap: number; count: number } | null>(null)
  if (!on) return {}

  const clampView = (v: View): View => {
    const count = Math.round(Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE, Math.min(MAX_VISIBLE, v.count)))
    const end = Math.round(Math.max(count, Math.min(HISTORY, v.end)))
    return { ...v, count, end, yScale: Math.max(0.2, Math.min(5, v.yScale)) }
  }
  const zone = (svg: SVGSVGElement, clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect()
    const unit = box.width / W
    const vx = (clientX - box.left) / unit
    const vy = (clientY - box.top) / unit
    return { zone: vx > data.plotW ? ('price' as const) : vy > data.plotH ? ('time' as const) : ('chart' as const), unit }
  }

  return {
    onPointerDown: (e: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
      e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
      pointers.current.set(e.pointerId, e.clientX)
      if (pointers.current.size === 2) {
        const [a, b] = [...pointers.current.values()]
        pinch.current = { gap: Math.abs(a - b) || 1, count: view.count }
        start.current = null
        return
      }
      const { zone: z, unit } = zone(e.currentTarget, e.clientX, e.clientY)
      start.current = { zone: z, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, view, pxPerUnit: unit }
    },
    onPointerMove: (e: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
      const svg = e.currentTarget
      if (pointers.current.has(e.pointerId)) pointers.current.set(e.pointerId, e.clientX)
      if (pinch.current && pointers.current.size === 2) {
        const [a, b] = [...pointers.current.values()]
        const p = pinch.current
        setView((v) => clampView({ ...v, count: p.count / (Math.abs(a - b) / p.gap) }))
        return
      }
      const s = start.current
      if (!s) {
        // Hover: the axes show how they move.
        const z = zone(svg, e.clientX, e.clientY).zone
        svg.style.cursor = z === 'price' ? 'ns-resize' : z === 'time' ? 'ew-resize' : 'grab'
        return
      }
      const dx = e.clientX - s.x
      const dy = e.clientY - s.y
      if (s.zone === 'price') {
        setView((v) => clampView({ ...v, yScale: s.view.yScale * Math.pow(2, dy / AXIS_DRAG) }))
      } else if (s.zone === 'time') {
        const count = s.view.count * Math.pow(2, -dx / AXIS_DRAG)
        // Keep the right edge where it is: the latest candle stays put (or wherever you'd moved to).
        setView((v) => clampView({ ...v, count, end: s.view.end }))
      } else {
        const perCandle = data.step * s.pxPerUnit
        const pricePerPx = (data.max - data.min) / ((data.plotH - PAD * 2) * s.pxPerUnit)
        const manualY = s.view.yScale !== 1 || s.view.yShift !== 0
        setView((v) => clampView({ ...v, end: s.view.end - dx / perCandle, yShift: manualY ? s.view.yShift + dy * pricePerPx : v.yShift }))
      }
    },
    onPointerUp: (e: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
      pointers.current.delete(e.pointerId)
      if (pointers.current.size < 2) pinch.current = null
      start.current = null
    },
    onPointerCancel: (e: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
      pointers.current.delete(e.pointerId)
      pinch.current = null
      start.current = null
    },
    onWheel: (e: WheelEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
      if (Math.abs(e.deltaX) > Math.abs(e.deltaY)) setView((v) => clampView({ ...v, end: v.end + e.deltaX / 6 }))
      else setView((v) => clampView({ ...v, count: v.count * Math.pow(2, e.deltaY / 300) }))
    },
    onDoubleClick: (e: MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
      if (zone(e.currentTarget, e.clientX, e.clientY).zone === 'price') setView((v) => ({ ...v, yScale: 1, yShift: 0 }))
      else setView(fitted)
    },
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/ModeMenu.module.css`

```css
/* The "what to build" pill: hugs its label, sits after the + in the field's lower row. */
.wrap {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
}

/* The pill: black and 40 — the height of the + and Send beside it (an L3 md pill is 32; in a pill group the group's 4
   padding makes it 40). */
.pill.pill {
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16); /* a little more room either side than the md pill's 12 */
  /* The black chip (the pill group's selected look: surface/inverted, inverted text), raised strong (L3 Raised). */
  --tab-surface: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
  --tab-content: var(--l3-content-inverted);
  --tab-border: transparent;
  --tab-layer-default: var(--l3-state-layer-light-default);
  --tab-layer-hover: var(--l3-state-layer-light-hover);
  --tab-layer-pressed: var(--l3-state-layer-light-pressed);
  --raise-layer: var(--tab-layer);
}

/* While the panel is open it sits over the chip (it grew out of it): the chip itself steps back. */
.wrap[data-open] .pill {
  visibility: hidden;
}

/*
 * The panel the chip grows into: drawn over the DASH screen, its bottom-left corner on the chip's, black (the opposite
 * theme's surface — set on the panel through data-product / data-mode) with round corners; the options are L3 list
 * cells (Small). ModeMenu.tsx animates its clip-path from the chip's box to the full panel and back.
 */
.menu {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 6;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: var(--app-dash-mode-menu); /* one width whatever is picked, so it never wobbles */
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-20);
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.option.option {
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16);
  background-color: transparent;
}

.option.option[data-selected] {
  background-color: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
}

/* Text 2 up from L3's 14 (Label/16) on the chip and in the panel. */
.pill.pill,
.pill.pill * {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-16);
}

.option.option :is(span) {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-16);
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/ModeMenu.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { lmSwitchArrowVertical } from '@l3/components/icons/glyphs'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { Tab } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msCheck } from '@l3/icons/material'
import pickerStyles from './MarketPicker.module.css'
import styles from './ModeMenu.module.css'

/**
 * "What to build" as one pill (setting "Chat input: Dropdown"): the current pick and a ↕ — an L3 action pill (Tab,
 * pill · md), black, 40 like the + and Send. A tap grows the chip itself into the menu: a black, round-cornered panel
 * opens up out of the chip's spot (its corner stays put, the rest unfolds — 250 ms), with the options as L3 list cells
 * (Small) in the opposite theme so they read white on black, the chosen one ✓. Picking, or a tap outside, folds it
 * back into the chip. Room for a 4th option, unlike the pill group.
 */
export function ModeMenu({ value, items, onChange, label }: { value: string; items: { value: string; label: string; isNew?: boolean }[]; onChange: (value: string) => void; label: string }) {
  const listId = useId()
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const menu = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const [place, setPlace] = useState<{ host: HTMLElement; left: number; bottom: number; chipW: number; chipH: number; product?: string; mode?: string } | null>(null)
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false)
  const current = items.find((i) => i.value === value) ?? items[0]

  const open = () => {
    const chip = trigger.current
    const host = chip?.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-dash]')
    if (!chip || !host) return
    const h = host.getBoundingClientRect()
    const b = chip.getBoundingClientRect()
    const scale = h.width / host.offsetWidth || 1 // the phone mockup may be scaled on screen
    // The menu takes the opposite theme of the page (white text on the black panel; in dark mode, the other way).
    const root = document.documentElement.dataset
    setPlace({
      host,
      left: (b.left - h.left) / scale,
      bottom: (h.bottom - b.bottom) / scale,
      chipW: b.width / scale,
      chipH: b.height / scale,
      product: root.product,
      mode: root.mode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark',
    })
  }

  /** The chip's own box inside the open panel (bottom left), as a clip-path: where the panel grows from / folds to. */
  const chipClip = (el: HTMLElement) => {
    if (!place) return ''
    return `inset(${el.offsetHeight - place.chipH}px ${el.offsetWidth - place.chipW}px 0 0 round ${place.chipH / 2}px)`
  }
  const fullClip = 'inset(0 0 0 0 round var(--l3-radius-20))'

  // Opening: unfold from the chip.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = menu.current
    if (!el || !place || closing) return
    el.getAnimations().forEach((a) => a.cancel())
    el.animate([{ clipPath: chipClip(el) }, { clipPath: fullClip }], { duration: 250, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)' })
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [place])

  const close = (pick?: string) => {
    const el = menu.current
    if (pick) onChange(pick)
    if (!el) return setPlace(null)
    setClosing(true)
    el.getAnimations().forEach((a) => a.cancel())
    const fold = el.animate([{ clipPath: fullClip }, { clipPath: chipClip(el) }], { duration: 200, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 1, 1)', fill: 'forwards' })
    fold.onfinish = () => {
      setPlace(null)
      setClosing(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <span ref={trigger} className={styles.wrap} data-open={place ? '' : undefined}>
      <Tab type="button" action appearance="pill" emphasis="tertiary" size="md" iconRight={<Icon icon={lmSwitchArrowVertical} />} aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={!!place} aria-controls={listId} aria-label={`${label}: ${current.label}`} onClick={() => (place ? close() : open())} className={styles.pill} raised="strong">
        {current.label}
      </Tab>
      {place && createPortal(
        <>
          <span className={pickerStyles.backdrop} onClick={() => close()} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span
            ref={menu}
            className={styles.menu}
            id={listId}
            role="menu"
            aria-label={label}
            data-product={place.product}
            data-mode={place.mode}
            style={{ left: place.left, bottom: place.bottom }}
          >
            {items.map((item) => (
              <ListCell
                key={item.value}
                as="button"
                size="sm"
                label={item.label}
                labelSuffix={item.isNew ? 'New' : undefined}
                selected={item.value === value}
                iconRight={item.value === value ? <Icon icon={msCheck} /> : undefined}
                onClick={() => close(item.value)}
                className={styles.option}
              />
            ))}
          </span>
        </>,
        place.host,
      )}
    </span>
  )
}
```
