### `src/flows/dash/components/PineActions.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { msCheck, msContentCopy, msDownload, msShare } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import type { IndicatorSettings } from '../indicatorData'
import { copyPine, downloadPine, pineScriptFor, sharePine } from './pineExport'
import styles from './PineActions.module.css'

/**
 * Export the Pine Script of an indicator DASH built: a row (no icon) with "Export your Pine Script ·
 * Download, copy or share it for TradingView", then Copy · Share (tertiary) and Download (primary, the main action)
 * as small icon buttons. Copy / Share confirm with a ✓ on the button for 2 s (the text never changes).
 * In the Indicator saved sheet and the history details sheet — not in the chat (the card has enough on it).
 */
export function PineActions({ name, settings }: { name: string; settings?: IndicatorSettings }) {
  // What just happened (Copied / Shared): that button's icon turns into a ✓ for 2 s (the text stays put, so the row
  // never changes height).
  const [done, setDone] = useState<'copied' | 'shared' | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!done) return
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setDone(null), 2000)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [done])
  const script = () => pineScriptFor(name, settings)
  return (
    <ListCell
      variant="card"
      size="sm"
      multiline
      label={t('pineExport.title')}
      description={t('pineExport.text')}
      trailing={
        <span className={styles.buttons}>
          <Button
            variant="tertiary"
            size="sm"
            iconLeft={<Icon icon={done === 'copied' ? msCheck : msContentCopy} />}
            aria-label={done === 'copied' ? t('pineExport.copied') : t('pineExport.copy')}
            onClick={async () => setDone((await copyPine(script())) ? 'copied' : null)}
          />
          <Button
            variant="tertiary"
            size="sm"
            iconLeft={<Icon icon={done === 'shared' ? msCheck : msShare} />}
            aria-label={done === 'shared' ? t('pineExport.shared') : t('pineExport.share')}
            onClick={async () => {
              const result = await sharePine(name, script())
              setDone(result === 'cancelled' ? null : result)
            }}
          />
          {/* The main thing to do with it: download the .pine file (primary). */}
          <Button size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msDownload} />} aria-label={t('pineExport.download')} onClick={() => downloadPine(name, script())} />
        </span>
      }
    />
  )
}
```

```css
/*
 * The animated Pine Script tip (PineStory.tsx): the FTUX card's dark body (Chat.module.css .ftux adds the green edge,
 * the tail, the pop and the float) around one light stage — a tiny DASH chat, always white (static colours) so it
 * reads the same in both themes. Everything on the stage is always there and moves by transitions between the
 * story's phases, so nothing cuts: one fingertip, one file that travels and becomes the indicator, Scalper pushing in.
 * Stage geometry is artwork (272 × 172, --app-dash-story-*).
 */
.card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-20);
  background: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
  box-shadow: 0 var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-24) color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-glow-3) 35%, transparent);
}

.head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.logo {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-28);
  height: var(--l3-size-28);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08);
  background: var(--app-dash-glow-1);
  color: var(--l3-static-black);
}

.title {
  flex: 1;
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
}

.close {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-28);
  height: var(--l3-size-28);
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ---- The stage */
.stage {
  --move: var(--app-dash-story-move);
  --ease: var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  height: var(--app-dash-story-window);
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
  background: var(--l3-static-white);
  color: var(--l3-static-black);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  transition: opacity var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--ease);
}

/* The loop's end: a soft fade before it starts again. */
.stage[data-reset] {
  opacity: 0;
}

.field {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  bottom: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-04);
  border: 1px solid var(--app-dash-green);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-static-white);
}

/* While DASH builds, the field slides away (the chat is the card now). */
.field {
  transition: transform var(--move) var(--ease), opacity var(--move) var(--ease);
}

.field[data-away] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(calc(100% + var(--l3-spacing-08)));
}

.plus,
.send {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-28);
  height: var(--l3-size-28);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 16%, transparent);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--ease), background var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--ease);
}

.send {
  margin-left: auto;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 8%, transparent);
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 35%, transparent);
}

.send[data-on] {
  background: var(--l3-static-black);
  color: var(--l3-static-white);
}

.plus[data-press],
.send[data-press] {
  transform: scale(0.82);
}

.placeholder {
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 40%, transparent);
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
}

/* The file picker: a small sheet over the stage's bottom; the picked row lights up. */
.picker {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16) var(--l3-radius-16) 0 0;
  background: var(--l3-static-white);
  box-shadow: 0 calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-04)) var(--l3-spacing-16) color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 14%, transparent);
  transform: translateY(105%);
  transition: transform var(--move) var(--ease);
}

.picker[data-open] {
  transform: none;
}

.pickerTitle {
  margin-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
}

.pickerRow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-06) var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08);
  transition: background var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--ease);
}

.pickerRow[data-muted] {
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 40%, transparent);
}

.pickerRow[data-picked] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 18%, transparent);
}

/* The file: one element that travels — from the field (a chip after the +) up to the message (top right). */
.file {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 1;
  top: calc(var(--app-dash-story-window) - var(--l3-spacing-08) - var(--l3-size-40) / 2 - var(--l3-spacing-12));
  left: var(--l3-spacing-48);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-04) var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 7%, transparent);
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    top var(--move) var(--ease),
    left var(--move) var(--ease),
    padding var(--move) var(--ease),
    border-radius var(--move) var(--ease),
    opacity var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--ease);
}

.file[data-place='field'] {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Sent: it flies up to the top right as the user's message bubble. */
.file[data-place='message'] {
  top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  left: calc(100% - var(--app-dash-story-bubble) - var(--l3-spacing-08));
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-16);
  opacity: 1;
}

/* …and as the card unfolds out of it, it fades into the card. */
.file[data-place][data-gone] {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* DASH working: three pulsing dots. */
.dots {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
}

.dots span {
  width: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--app-dash-green);
  animation: story-dot 900ms ease-in-out infinite;
}

.dots span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 150ms; }
.dots span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 300ms; }

@keyframes story-dot {
  50% { opacity: 0.3; transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-02))); }
}

/* Build: DASH's answer, on the left under the sent file — dots and the line (like the app's thinking). */
.reply {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--l3-spacing-48);
  left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(var(--l3-spacing-08));
  transition: opacity var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--ease), transform var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--ease);
}

.reply[data-on] {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

/* Ready: the answer as the indicator card, taking the whole chat (the file and DASH's line fade away first). */
.result {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  right: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  bottom: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  left: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 60%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
  background: var(--l3-static-white);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(var(--l3-spacing-12));
  transition: opacity var(--move) var(--ease), transform var(--move) var(--ease);
}

.result[data-on] {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

/* Ready: the card's first line, in green. */
.readyNote {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
}

/* The fingertip: one for the whole story — it glides between targets, presses (a ring ripples out), and leaves. */
.cursor {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  width: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  margin: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08)) 0 0 calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-08));
  border: var(--l3-spacing-02) solid var(--l3-static-white);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 70%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 60%, transparent);
  transform: translate(var(--cx), var(--cy));
  transition:
    transform var(--app-dash-story-glide) var(--ease),
    opacity var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--ease);
}

.cursor[data-away] {
  opacity: 0;
}

.cursor[data-press] {
  animation: story-tap var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--ease) both;
}

@keyframes story-tap {
  40% { transform: translate(var(--cx), var(--cy)) scale(0.75); }
  100% { transform: translate(var(--cx), var(--cy)) scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--l3-spacing-12) color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-dash-green) 0%, transparent); }
}

/* ---- Upload · Build · Apply */
.steps {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-08);
}

.track {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-content-inverted) 18%, transparent);
}

.track span {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: var(--app-dash-glow-1);
  transition: width var(--app-dash-story-move) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.act {
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  transition: color var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.act:nth-child(3) { text-align: center; }
.act:nth-child(4) { text-align: end; }

.act[data-state='now'] {
  color: var(--app-dash-glow-1);
}

.act[data-state='done'] {
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted);
}

.caption {
  color: var(--l3-content-inverted);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  animation: story-in var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

@keyframes story-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(var(--l3-spacing-04));
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .stage *,
  .caption,
  .track span {
    transition: none;
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/PineStory.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { msAdd, msArrowUpward, msCheck, msClose, msDescription, msStarFill } from '@l3/icons/material'
import pineScript from '../assets/pine-script.svg'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { MiniChart } from './MiniChart'
import styles from './PineStory.module.css'

/**
 * The story's timeline (ms from the loop's start). One stage, one fingertip, one file that travels:
 * the + → the file picker → the file in the field → Send → it flies up as the message → DASH reads it → the message
 * DASH answers under it, and its answer becomes the indicator card, in the chat → hold → fade, again.
 */
const TIMELINE = [
  { at: 0, phase: 'start' },
  { at: 300, phase: 'toPlus' },
  { at: 1000, phase: 'tapPlus' },
  { at: 1250, phase: 'picker' },
  { at: 1700, phase: 'toFile' },
  { at: 2300, phase: 'tapFile' },
  { at: 2550, phase: 'chip' },
  { at: 2900, phase: 'toSend' },
  { at: 3550, phase: 'tapSend' },
  { at: 3800, phase: 'sent' },
  { at: 4200, phase: 'building' },
  { at: 6600, phase: 'ready' },
  { at: 9400, phase: 'reset' },
] as const
const LOOP_MS = 9900
type Phase = (typeof TIMELINE)[number]['phase']
const order = TIMELINE.map((s) => s.phase)
/** The result card's chart drawing height (300 wide, axes off), so the ready card's chart fills the 272 × 172 stage. */
const RESULT_CHART_H = 116
/** Reduced motion: the still — the ready indicator card in the chat. */
const STILL: Phase = 'ready'

/** Where the fingertip is in each phase (stage px; the stage is 272 × 172). */
const CURSOR: Record<Phase, [number, number]> = {
  start: [300, 200],
  toPlus: [26, 144],
  tapPlus: [26, 144],
  picker: [26, 144],
  toFile: [96, 114],
  tapFile: [96, 114],
  chip: [96, 114],
  toSend: [246, 144],
  tapSend: [246, 144],
  sent: [246, 144],
  building: [300, 200],
  ready: [300, 200],
  reset: [300, 200],
}

const ACTS = ['pineStory.actUpload', 'pineStory.actBuild', 'pineStory.actApply'] as const
const CAPTIONS = ['pineStory.captionUpload', 'pineStory.captionBuild', 'pineStory.captionApply'] as const
const actOf = (p: Phase) => (order.indexOf(p) < order.indexOf('building') ? 0 : order.indexOf(p) < order.indexOf('ready') ? 1 : 2)

/**
 * The Pine Script tip, animated (setting "Pine Script tip: Animated"): a floating card above the + with a small
 * continuous story — one stage, the DASH chat, from start to end (as in the app); one fingertip; one file:
 * Upload (the + → the file picker → the file in the field → Send) · Build (it's sent; DASH answers under it —
 * "Converting Pine Script to indicator…") · Ready (the answer becomes the indicator card in the chat: ready, its chart,
 * on the Scalper chart). A stepper fills as it goes; ✕ hides it.
 */
export function PineStory({ title, onClose }: { title: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const reduced = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>(reduced ? STILL : 'start')
  const [lap, setLap] = useState(0)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced) return
    const timers = TIMELINE.map(({ at, phase: p }) => window.setTimeout(() => setPhase(p), at))
    timers.push(window.setTimeout(() => setLap((n) => n + 1), LOOP_MS))
    return () => timers.forEach(window.clearTimeout)
  }, [lap, reduced])

  const at = (p: Phase) => order.indexOf(phase) >= order.indexOf(p)
  const act = actOf(phase)
  const [cx, cy] = CURSOR[phase]
  const pressing = phase === 'tapPlus' || phase === 'tapFile' || phase === 'tapSend'
  const stage = {
    '--cx': `${cx}px`,
    '--cy': `${cy}px`,
  } as CSSProperties

  return (
    <span className={styles.card} role="note">
      <span className={styles.head}>
        <span className={styles.logo} aria-hidden="true"><Icon icon={pineScript} size={16} /></span>
        <span className={styles.title}>{title}</span>
        <button type="button" className={styles.close} aria-label={t('pineTip.hide')} onClick={onClose}>
          <Icon icon={msClose} size={16} />
        </button>
      </span>

      <span className={styles.stage} style={stage} data-reset={phase === 'reset' || undefined} aria-hidden="true">
        {/* The chat field: + · the picked file · Send. */}
        <span className={styles.field} data-away={at('building') || undefined}>
          <span className={styles.plus} data-press={phase === 'tapPlus' || undefined}><Icon icon={msAdd} size={16} /></span>
          {!at('chip') && <span className={styles.placeholder}>{t('input.placeholder')}</span>}
          <span className={styles.send} data-on={(at('chip') && !at('sent')) || undefined} data-press={phase === 'tapSend' || undefined}>
            <Icon icon={msArrowUpward} size={12} />
          </span>
        </span>

        {/* The file picker: slides up from the bottom, the file is tapped, it slides away. */}
        <span className={styles.picker} data-open={(at('picker') && !at('chip')) || undefined}>
          <span className={styles.pickerTitle}>{t('pineStory.pickerTitle')}</span>
          <span className={styles.pickerRow} data-picked={at('tapFile') || undefined}>
            <Icon icon={msDescription} size={16} />
            my_strategy.pine
          </span>
          <span className={styles.pickerRow} data-muted="">
            <Icon icon={msDescription} size={16} />
            notes.txt
          </span>
        </span>

        {/* The file: in the field, then up as the sent message — the same element travelling. */}
        <span
          className={styles.file}
          data-place={at('sent') ? 'message' : at('chip') ? 'field' : 'hidden'}
          data-gone={at('ready') || undefined}
        >
          <Icon icon={msDescription} size={12} />
          my_strategy.pine
        </span>

        {/* Build: DASH answers in the chat, under the sent file — three dots and what it's doing (as in the app). */}
        <span className={styles.reply} data-on={(at('building') && !at('ready')) || undefined}>
          <span className={styles.dots}><span /><span /><span /></span>
          {t('pineStory.building')}
        </span>

        {/* Ready: its answer becomes the indicator card, taking the whole chat (the earlier messages fade away) — ready,
            its chart in full, and on the Scalper chart. */}
        <span className={styles.result} data-on={at('ready') || undefined}>
          <span className={styles.readyNote}>
            <Icon icon={msCheck} size={12} />
            {t('pineStory.ready')}
          </span>
          {at('ready') && <span className={styles.chart}><MiniChart key={`result-${lap}`} stage="ready" redraw axes={false} height={RESULT_CHART_H} /></span>}
          <span className={styles.applied}>
            <Icon icon={msStarFill} size={12} />
            <span className={styles.appliedName}>{t('pineStory.name')}</span>
            <span className={styles.appliedTag}>{t('pineStory.onScalper')}</span>
          </span>
        </span>

        {/* One fingertip for the whole story. */}
        <span className={styles.cursor} data-press={pressing || undefined} data-away={phase === 'start' || at('building') || undefined} />
      </span>

      {/* Upload · Build · Apply: the line fills as the story goes. */}
      <span className={styles.steps} aria-hidden="true">
        <span className={styles.track}><span style={{ width: `${(act + (at('reset') ? 1 : 0.5)) * 33.34}%` }} /></span>
        {ACTS.map((a, i) => <span key={a} className={styles.act} data-state={i < act ? 'done' : i === act ? 'now' : 'next'}>{t(a)}</span>)}
      </span>
      <span className={styles.caption} key={act}>{t(CAPTIONS[act])}</span>
    </span>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/QuestionCard.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId, useState } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msCheck, msClose, msEdit } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import type { RuleQuestion } from '../data'
import styles from './QuestionCard.module.css'

type QuestionCardProps = {
  question: RuleQuestion
  /** Prototype state: an answer already ticked. */
  selected?: string
  onAnswer?: (answer: string) => void
  onClose?: () => void
}

/** How long the picked answer shows its tick before it's sent (the card then gives way to the next question). */
const ANSWER_TICK_MS = 700

/**
 * DASH asks a follow-up, right under its message in the chat (Figma 5612:40650): the question + ✕, numbered answers,
 * and a last "Type your answer" row for anything else. Tapping an answer turns its number into a check for 0.7 s,
 * then sends it — DASH moves on to the next question, or takes the answer. One pick per card.
 */
export function QuestionCard({ question, selected: initial, onAnswer, onClose }: QuestionCardProps) {
  const id = useId()
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(initial)
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const pick = (answer: string) => {
    if (sent) return
    setSent(true)
    setSelected(answer)
    window.setTimeout(() => onAnswer?.(answer), ANSWER_TICK_MS)
  }
  return (
    <section className={styles.card} aria-labelledby={id}>
      <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="12" className={styles.header}>
        <h2 id={id} className={styles.question}>{question.question}</h2>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msClose} />} aria-label={t('question.close')} onClick={onClose} />
      </Stack>
      <ol className={styles.options}>
        {question.options.map((option, i) => (
          <li key={option}>
            <button type="button" className={styles.option} aria-pressed={selected === option} onClick={() => pick(option)}>
              {/* The number turns into a check when this answer is picked. */}
              <span className={styles.number} data-checked={selected === option || undefined} aria-hidden="true">
                {selected === option ? <Icon icon={msCheck} size={16} /> : i + 1}
              </span>
              <span className={styles.label}>{option}</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      {question.freeText && (
        <form
          className={styles.typeRow}
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault()
            if (typed.trim()) pick(typed.trim())
          }}
        >
          <Icon icon={msEdit} size={20} className={styles.typeIcon} />
          <input
            className={styles.typeField}
            value={typed}
            onChange={(e) => setTyped(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={t('question.typePlaceholder')}
            aria-label={t('question.typeLabel')}
            enterKeyHint="send"
          />
        </form>
      )}
    </section>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/ResumeDrafts.module.css`

```css
/* DASH homes · Pick up where you left off (setting "Resume chats"): moved here from ReturningV2 so every version shows it. */

/* Pick up where you left off: one card per draft, side by side and swiped (snapping), edge to edge; one draft fills
   the width. Each card: the DASH green edge, ✕ at the top right, Continue hugging its label. */
.drafts {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16));
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  overflow-x: auto;
  scroll-padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

/* Two or more drafts: 85 % wide, so the next one peeks in. Every card is as tall as the tallest one (the row
   stretches them; each card fills its slot), whatever its text — Continue sits at the bottom of each. */
.drafts > * {
  flex: none;
  width: 85%;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
}

/* Only one draft: it fills the width (nothing to swipe to). */
.drafts[data-single] > * {
  width: 100%;
}

/* The remove sheet has no content slot, and L3's large header has no bottom space of its own (it expects the
   content's): 24 here so the description doesn't run into the buttons (local fix; designer to audit L3). */
.removeSheet header[data-size='lg'] {
  padding-bottom: var(--l3-spacing-24);
}

/* The remove sheet's header icon (large header, like Delete rule): the bin in a red circle, 64. */
.removeIcon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-64);
  height: var(--l3-size-64);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-accent-error-light);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-error-default);
}

/* Compact card (setting "Resume card", default): like a creation card — white, light edge, radius 12, 12 in; the
   history avatar, the green "Edited …" line over the title, › at the top right. Hold to delete (no ✕). */
.compact {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light); /* 1px: the card's edge */
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  color: inherit;
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none; /* the hold is ours: no iOS callout */
  transition: transform var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.compact:active {
  transform: scale(var(--l3-motion-scale-press-default));
}

.compactText {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  min-width: 0;
}

.compactEdited {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

.compactTitle {
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-14);
  white-space: nowrap; /* one line; a longer title ends in … */
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* The history avatar: the grey disc without L3 Avatar's 1px edge, the icon in content/primary (L3's icon type is
   content/secondary at 60%). */
.compact .compactAvatar::after {
  box-shadow: none;
}

.compact .compactAvatar > * {
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.compactCaret {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .compact {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/ResumeDrafts.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react'
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { BottomSheetHeader } from '@l3/components/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msChevronRight, msDelete, msHistory } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { Sheet } from '../../../shared/ui/Sheet'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { homeDrafts, type HomeDraft } from '../data'
import { useLongPress } from './longPress'
import styles from './ResumeDrafts.module.css'

/** Prototype setting "Resume chats" (every DASH version, returning user): Show → the sample drafts, Hide (default) → none. */
export function useResumeDrafts() {
  const resume = useFlowOption('dash', 'resumeChats', 'hide')
  // No past chats at all (setting "Past chats: Empty") → no drafts either.
  const history = useFlowOption('dash', 'pastChats', 'some')
  const shown = resume === 'show' && history !== 'none'
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState<HomeDraft[]>(shown ? homeDrafts : [])
  useEffect(() => setDrafts(shown ? homeDrafts : []), [shown])
  return [drafts, setDrafts] as const
}

/**
 * Compact resume card (like a creation card): the history avatar, then the green "Draft · Edited …" line over the title, and ›.
 * A tap opens the draft's chat; press and hold (or right-click) asks to delete it.
 */
function CompactDraft({ draft, onOpen, onHold }: { draft: HomeDraft; onOpen: () => void; onHold: () => void }) {
  const press = useLongPress({ onHold, onTap: onOpen })
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="listitem"
      className={styles.compact}
      aria-label={t('home2.resumeHold', { name: draft.title, edited: draft.edited })}
      {...press}
    >
      <Avatar size={40} icon={<Icon icon={msHistory} size={20} />} className={styles.compactAvatar} />
      <span className={styles.compactText}>
        <span className={styles.compactEdited}>{t('home2.draftEdited', { edited: draft.edited })}</span>
        <span className={styles.compactTitle}>{draft.title}</span>
      </span>
      <span className={styles.compactCaret}><Icon icon={msChevronRight} size={16} /></span>
    </button>
  )
}

/**
 * Pick up where you left off: chats left before saving (rare, so only when there are some) — one card each, swiped
 * sideways when there are two or more: the compact card (the big Continue + ✕ card is archived in
 * archive/dash-resume-card-big). A tap opens the draft's chat; press and hold removes one (a sheet asks first).
 */
export function ResumeDrafts({ drafts, onOpen, onRemove, onViewAll }: {
  drafts: HomeDraft[]
  /** View all: every past chat (the Past chats page). */
  onViewAll?: () => void
  onOpen: (kind: HomeDraft['kind']) => void
  onRemove: (id: string) => void
}) {
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<HomeDraft | null>(null)
  const sheetId = useId()
  if (drafts.length === 0) return null
  return (
    <Stack as="section" gap="12" aria-label={t('home2.resume')}>
      <SectionHeader title={t('home2.resume')} headingLevel={2} action={onViewAll && { type: 'view-all', onClick: onViewAll }} />
      <div className={styles.drafts} data-single={drafts.length === 1 || undefined} role="list">
        {drafts.map((d) => <CompactDraft key={d.id} draft={d} onOpen={() => onOpen(d.kind)} onHold={() => setRemoving(d)} />)}
      </div>

      {removing && (
        <Sheet
          labelledBy={sheetId}
          onClose={() => setRemoving(null)}
          className={styles.removeSheet}
          header={<BottomSheetHeader size="lg" headingId={sheetId} heading={t('home2.removeTitle')} description={t('home2.removeText', { name: removing.title })} icon={<span className={styles.removeIcon}><Icon icon={msDelete} size={24} /></span>} />}
          footer={
            <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('home2.removeTitle')} direction="vertical">
              <Button
                onClick={() => {
                  onRemove(removing.id)
                  setRemoving(null)
                }}
              >
                {t('home2.removeConfirm')}
              </Button>
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setRemoving(null)}>{t('home2.removeKeep')}</Button>
            </ButtonGroup>
          }
        />
      )}
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/RibbonTabs.module.css`

```css
/* V11 · Ribbon. The tabs row sits over the field; the field + picked tab union is an SVG behind the whole form
   (the form itself is see-through: Chat.module.css [data-ribbon]). Once a conversation has started the tabs sink
   back into the field and the row closes (height → 0). */
.row {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  height: var(--l3-size-40);
  transition: height var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
  /* 36 in: past the field's rounded corner (its radius + the tab's 12 curve), so the curves land on the straight edge */
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-36);
}

/* The tabs sunk (a conversation going): the row closes; the labels are gone. */
.row[data-closed] {
  height: 0;
}

.row[data-closed] .tabs {
  visibility: hidden;
}

/* The union: covers the form's border box, behind its content. */
.union {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -1;
  top: -1px;
  left: -1px;
  overflow: visible;
  filter: var(--app-dash-union-shadow);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.fill {
  fill: var(--l3-surface-primary);
}

/* Figma: 1px inside, the gradient at 50%; full while typing (the field is active). */
.stroke {
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 2px;
  stroke-opacity: 0.5;
  transition: stroke-opacity var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

:global(form[data-typing]) .stroke,
:global(form:focus-within) .stroke {
  stroke-opacity: 1;
}

.edge1 { stop-color: var(--app-dash-union-edge-1); }
.edge2 { stop-color: var(--app-dash-union-edge-2); }
.edge3 { stop-color: var(--app-dash-union-edge-3); }

/* L3's ribbon row and tabs go see-through: the union draws the picked one. */
.tabs.tabs {
  position: relative;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.tabs.tabs [role='tab'][role='tab'] {
  --tab-padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-08); /* 8 (L3 ribbon: 12): three tabs with icons fit the field's width */
  --tab-surface: transparent;
  --tab-border: transparent;
  --tab-content: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  box-shadow: none;
  transition: color var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

.tabs.tabs [role='tab'][role='tab']::before {
  content: none;
}

/* The other kinds' tabs are drawn in the SVG under the union (the picked tab always on top): white, a light edge. */
.otherTab {
  fill: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  stroke: var(--l3-border-light);
  stroke-width: 1px;
}

.tabs.tabs [role='tab'][role='tab'][aria-selected='true'] {
  --tab-content: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .tabs [role='tab'] {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/RibbonTabs.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import styles from './RibbonTabs.module.css'

/** The tab's top corners and the curves where it meets the field (Figma "Union": ~12). */
const CORNER = 12
const FLARE = 12
/** Tab → tab: the union's tab part slides and stretches (ms). */
const SLIDE_MS = 250
/** Coming in: each tab rises out of the field (ms), the next one this much later. */
const RISE_MS = 320
const RISE_STAGGER_MS = 90
/** A conversation started: the tabs sink back into the field together (ms), then the row closes. */
const SINK_MS = 260
const ease = (t: number) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3)
/** The union's gradient edge: one full turn (s). */
const EDGE_TURN_S = 4

type Span = [number, number]

/**
 * The union outline (Figma "Union" 6850:44252): the field (a pill under the tabs row) and the picked tab as ONE shape —
 * tab corners, curves into the field's top edge. `rise` 0–1: how far the tab is out of the field (0 = a plain pill).
 */
function unionPath(w: number, h: number, rowH: number, [x0, x1]: Span, rise: number) {
  const r = Math.min((h - rowH) / 2, 28) // the field: a pill
  const tabH = rowH * rise
  const f = Math.min(FLARE, tabH / 2)
  const c = Math.min(CORNER, tabH / 2)
  const top = rowH - tabH + 0.5
  const tab = tabH < 0.5
    ? [`H ${w - r}`]
    : [
        `H ${x0 - f}`,
        `A ${f} ${f} 0 0 0 ${x0} ${rowH - f}`,
        `V ${top + c}`,
        `A ${c} ${c} 0 0 1 ${x0 + c} ${top}`,
        `H ${x1 - c}`,
        `A ${c} ${c} 0 0 1 ${x1} ${top + c}`,
        `V ${rowH - f}`,
        `A ${f} ${f} 0 0 0 ${x1 + f} ${rowH}`,
        `H ${w - r}`,
      ]
  return [
    `M ${r} ${rowH}`,
    ...tab,
    `A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${w} ${rowH + r}`,
    `V ${h - r}`,
    `A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${w - r} ${h}`,
    `H ${r}`,
    `A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 0 ${h - r}`,
    `V ${rowH + r}`,
    `A ${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${r} ${rowH}`,
    'Z',
  ].join(' ')
}

/** Another kind's tab (rounded top, open at the bottom — the field covers it), `rise` 0–1 out of the field. */
function tabPath(rowH: number, [a, b]: Span, rise: number) {
  const tabH = rowH * rise
  if (tabH < 0.5) return ''
  const c = Math.min(CORNER, tabH)
  const top = rowH - tabH + 0.5
  return `M ${a + 0.5} ${rowH + 1} V ${top + c} A ${c} ${c} 0 0 1 ${a + c} ${top} H ${b - c} A ${c} ${c} 0 0 1 ${b - 0.5} ${top + c} V ${rowH + 1}`
}

/**
 * V11 · Ribbon: Rule · Indicator · Strategy as folder tabs growing out of the top of the field. The field and the
 * picked tab are one union (white, a green → lime → yellow 1px inside edge, low shadow — Figma "Union"); the other
 * kinds are white tabs with a light edge behind it, so the picked one is always on top.
 * - Coming in: the tabs rise out of the field one by one (labels fade up with them).
 * - A new pick: the union's tab slides and stretches there.
 * - `sunk` (a conversation has started): the tabs sink back into the field and the row closes.
 * Built on L3 Tabs (ribbon: keyboard and a11y); the shapes are one SVG behind the whole field.
 */
export function RibbonTabs({ value, items, onChange, label, sunk = false }: {
  value: string
  items: { value: string; label: string; iconLeft?: ReactNode; /** Setting "Pill counts": a tiny count on the unpicked ones. */ badge?: ReactNode }[]
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  label: string
  sunk?: boolean
}) {
  const row = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const id = useId()
  const [shape, setShape] = useState<{ w: number; h: number; rowH: number; picked: Span; tabs: Span[]; pickedIndex: number } | null>(null)
  // What's on screen right now (animated): the union's tab span and each tab's rise.
  const shownSpan = useRef<Span | null>(null)
  const rises = useRef<number[]>(items.map(() => (sunk ? 1 : 0)))
  const [closed, setClosed] = useState(false)
  const slideFrame = useRef(0)
  const riseFrame = useRef(0)

  // Read the layout and draw with the current animated values.
  const render = () => {
    const el = row.current
    const form = el?.closest('form')
    if (!el || !form) return
    const tabEls = [...el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role=tab]')]
    const span = (tab: HTMLElement): Span => {
      let x = tab.offsetLeft
      for (let n = tab.offsetParent as HTMLElement | null; n && n !== form; n = n.offsetParent as HTMLElement | null) x += n.offsetLeft
      return [x + form.clientLeft, x + form.clientLeft + tab.offsetWidth]
    }
    const pickedIndex = tabEls.findIndex((t) => t.getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true')
    if (pickedIndex < 0) return
    const rowH = el.offsetHeight + form.clientTop
    // The labels ride with their tab: up out of the field, fading in.
    tabEls.forEach((t, i) => {
      const r = rises.current[i] ?? 1
      t.style.transform = r < 1 ? `translateY(${(1 - r) * 0.6 * rowH}px)` : ''
      t.style.opacity = r < 1 ? String(r) : ''
    })
    setShape({ w: form.offsetWidth, h: form.offsetHeight, rowH, picked: shownSpan.current ?? span(tabEls[pickedIndex]), tabs: tabEls.map(span), pickedIndex })
  }
  const targetSpan = (): Span | null => {
    const el = row.current
    const form = el?.closest('form')
    const picked = el?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role=tab][aria-selected=true]')
    if (!el || !form || !picked) return null
    let x = picked.offsetLeft
    for (let n = picked.offsetParent as HTMLElement | null; n && n !== form; n = n.offsetParent as HTMLElement | null) x += n.offsetLeft
    return [x + form.clientLeft, x + form.clientLeft + picked.offsetWidth]
  }

  // A new pick: slide the union's tab there (the first placement doesn't slide).
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const to = targetSpan()
    if (!to) return
    const from = shownSpan.current
    cancelAnimationFrame(slideFrame.current)
    if (!from || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      shownSpan.current = to
      render()
      return
    }
    const start = performance.now()
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const t = ease(Math.min(1, (now - start) / SLIDE_MS))
      shownSpan.current = [from[0] + (to[0] - from[0]) * t, from[1] + (to[1] - from[1]) * t]
      render()
      if (t < 1) slideFrame.current = requestAnimationFrame(step)
    }
    slideFrame.current = requestAnimationFrame(step)
  }, [value, items.map((i) => `${i.value}${i.iconLeft ? '+' : ''}${i.badge ? '#' : ''}`).join('|')])

  // Coming in (rise one by one) or a conversation started (sink together, then close the row).
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(riseFrame.current)
    if (!sunk) setClosed(false)
    const from = rises.current.slice()
    const to = items.map(() => (sunk ? 0 : 1))
    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      rises.current = to
      setClosed(sunk)
      render()
      return
    }
    const start = performance.now()
    const step = (now: number) => {
      let done = true
      rises.current = from.map((r, i) => {
        const delay = sunk ? 0 : i * RISE_STAGGER_MS
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (now - start - delay) / (sunk ? SINK_MS : RISE_MS)))
        if (t < 1) done = false
        return r + (to[i] - r) * ease(t)
      })
      render()
      if (!done) riseFrame.current = requestAnimationFrame(step)
      else if (sunk) setClosed(true)
    }
    riseFrame.current = requestAnimationFrame(step)
  }, [sunk])

  // The field grows with its text (and the row closes): redraw in place. (The first callback, on starting to watch,
  // is skipped — it would cut a slide short.)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const form = row.current?.closest('form')
    if (!form) return
    let watching = false
    const watch = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      if (watching) render()
      watching = true
    })
    watch.observe(form)
    return () => {
      watch.disconnect()
      cancelAnimationFrame(slideFrame.current)
      cancelAnimationFrame(riseFrame.current)
    }
  }, [])

  const rise = (i: number) => rises.current[i] ?? 1
  const reduceMotion = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  return (
    <span ref={row} className={styles.row} data-closed={closed || undefined}>
      {shape && (
        <svg className={styles.union} width={shape.w} height={shape.h} viewBox={`0 0 ${shape.w} ${shape.h}`} aria-hidden="true">
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={`${id}-edge`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.15" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0" className={styles.edge1} />
              <stop offset="0.57" className={styles.edge2} />
              <stop offset="1" className={styles.edge3} />
              {/* The edge's colours turn slowly round the shape (one turn per EDGE_TURN_S), like V5's create cards. */}
              {!reduceMotion && <animateTransform attributeName="gradientTransform" type="rotate" from="0 0.5 0.5" to="360 0.5 0.5" dur={`${EDGE_TURN_S}s`} repeatCount="indefinite" />}
            </linearGradient>
            <clipPath id={`${id}-clip`}>
              <path d={unionPath(shape.w, shape.h, shape.rowH, shape.picked, rise(shape.pickedIndex))} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>
          {/* Behind: the other kinds' tabs. */}
          {shape.tabs.map((s, i) => (i === shape.pickedIndex ? null : <path key={i} className={styles.otherTab} d={tabPath(shape.rowH, s, rise(i))} />))}
          {/* The union: white fill, then a 2px stroke clipped to the inside = a 1px inside edge (Figma's inside stroke). */}
          <path d={unionPath(shape.w, shape.h, shape.rowH, shape.picked, rise(shape.pickedIndex))} className={styles.fill} />
          <path d={unionPath(shape.w, shape.h, shape.rowH, shape.picked, rise(shape.pickedIndex))} className={styles.stroke} stroke={`url(#${id}-edge)`} clipPath={`url(#${id}-clip)`} />
        </svg>
      )}
      <Tabs aria-label={label} appearance="ribbon" size="md" items={items} value={value} onChange={onChange} className={styles.tabs} />
    </span>
  )
}
```

```css
/* Figma rule card (5612:41008): 1px border-light, radius 12, white body 12 / 12 / 16, then the backtest strip. */
.card {
  overflow: clip;
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
}

.body {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

.title {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* Figma dashed line under the name (1px, border-light). */
.rule {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--l3-border-light);
}

/* The value the user picked: a grey chip (Figma 12 / 8, full radius, Label/12). */
.valueChip {
  align-self: flex-start;
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

/* The description (2 lines, cut with …) + chevron: opens the read-more sheet. */
.description {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.descriptionText {
  display: -webkit-box;
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  color: var(--l3-content-tertiary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
}

.chevron {
  flex: none;
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.description:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--l3-content-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-04);
}

/* ---- Backtest strip: Figma 12 / 8, a top-to-bottom tint from white into the result's light accent (to 135%). */
.strip {
  --tint: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  --tone: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-08) var(--l3-spacing-12);
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--l3-surface-default), var(--tint) 135%);
}

.strip[data-result='saved'] {
  --tint: var(--l3-surface-accent-success-light);
  --tone: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

.strip[data-result='cost'] {
  --tint: var(--l3-surface-accent-error-light);
  --tone: var(--l3-content-accent-error-default);
}

/* In the read-more sheet: a card of its own (Figma: 1px edge in the result's colour, radius 8, a left-to-right tint). */
.strip[data-shape='pill'] {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08);
  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--tint), var(--l3-surface-default) 60%);
}

.strip[data-shape='pill'][data-result='saved'] { border-color: var(--l3-border-accent-success-light); }
.strip[data-shape='pill'][data-result='cost'] { border-color: var(--l3-border-accent-error-light); }

.stripIcon {
  flex: none;
  color: var(--tone);
}

.strip[data-result='none'] .stripIcon {
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.stripText {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.amount {
  color: var(--tone);
}

/* The backtest strip unfolds (height + fade, 300 ms) when DASH's backtest comes back; the description fades in. */
.unfold {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  animation: rule-unfold var(--app-dash-pin-duration) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

.unfoldInner {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

@keyframes rule-unfold {
  from {
    grid-template-rows: 0fr;
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

.description {
  animation: rule-fade var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) both;
}

@keyframes rule-fade {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .unfold,
  .description {
    animation: none;
  }
}


/* Version 1's pinned card, folded while the chat scrolls: only the title row stays (300 ms, ease in and out). */
.fold {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing);
}

.foldInner {
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.card[data-compact] .fold {
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
}

.card[data-compact] .body {
  gap: 0;
}

.card[data-compact] {
  cursor: pointer;
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/RuleCard.tsx`

```tsx
import type { KeyboardEvent } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { msChevronRight, msError, msTrendingDown, msTrendingUp } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { rupees, type Backtest, type DraftRule } from '../data'
import { DashOrb } from '../../../shared/ui/dash/DashOrb'
import styles from './RuleCard.module.css'

type RuleCardProps = {
  rule: DraftRule
  /** Preview (before the backtest): the picked value as a chip. Once tested: the description + the backtest strip. */
  backtest?: Backtest
  /** The description opens the "read more" sheet. */
  onOpen?: () => void
  /** Version 1, pinned: the chat was scrolled — it folds to its title row (a tap opens it again). */
  compact?: boolean
  onExpand?: () => void
}

/**
 * The rule DASH is building, pinned above the chat: the DASH orb + the rule's name, a dashed line, then the value
 * the user picked (preview) or the rule's description (tap → read more) and what the backtest says, on a strip
 * tinted by the result (saved = green, cost = red, no data = grey).
 */
export function RuleCard({ rule, backtest, onOpen, compact = false, onExpand }: RuleCardProps) {
  return (
    <article
      className={styles.card}
      aria-label={rule.title}
      data-compact={compact || undefined}
      {...(compact && onExpand && { role: 'button', tabIndex: 0, 'aria-expanded': false, onClick: onExpand, onKeyDown: (e: KeyboardEvent) => (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && onExpand() })}
    >
      <Stack gap="12" className={styles.body}>
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08">
          <DashOrb size="sm" />
          <h2 className={styles.title}>{rule.title}</h2>
        </Stack>
        {/* Everything under the title folds away in the mini card (300 ms). */}
        <div className={styles.fold} inert={compact || undefined}>
        <div className={styles.foldInner}>
        <Stack gap="12">
        <hr className={styles.rule} />
        {backtest ? (
          <button type="button" className={styles.description} onClick={onOpen} aria-label={`${rule.description} ${t('rule.readMore')}`}>
            <span className={styles.descriptionText}>{rule.description}</span>
            <Icon icon={msChevronRight} size={20} className={styles.chevron} />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <span className={styles.valueChip}>{rule.value}</span>
        )}
        </Stack>
        </div>
        </div>
      </Stack>
      {backtest && !compact && (
        // Unfolds under the card when the backtest comes back (same page, so it plays once).
        <div className={styles.unfold}>
          <div className={styles.unfoldInner}>
            <BacktestStrip backtest={backtest} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </article>
  )
}

/** What the backtest says, on a strip tinted by the result. Also used, rounded, in the read-more sheet. */
export function BacktestStrip({ backtest, shape = 'strip' }: { backtest: Backtest; shape?: 'strip' | 'pill' }) {
  const icon = backtest.result === 'saved' ? msTrendingUp : backtest.result === 'cost' ? msTrendingDown : msError
  return (
    <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="08" className={styles.strip} data-result={backtest.result} data-shape={shape}>
      <Icon icon={icon} size={24} className={styles.stripIcon} />
      <p className={styles.stripText}>
        {backtest.result === 'none' ? (
          t('backtest.none')
        ) : (
          <>
            {t(backtest.result === 'saved' ? 'backtest.savedBefore' : 'backtest.costBefore')}
            <strong className={styles.amount}>{rupees(backtest.amount)}</strong>
            {t(backtest.result === 'saved' ? 'backtest.savedAfter' : 'backtest.costAfter', { months: backtest.months })}
          </>
        )}
      </p>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/RulesIntro.tsx`

```tsx
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { DashOrb } from '../../../shared/ui/dash/DashOrb'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { examplePrompts, firstName } from '../data'
import { PromptChips, SparkleHeading, SuggestionList } from './Chat'
import styles from './RulesIntro.module.css'

type RulesIntroProps = {
  onPick?: (prompt: string, from: HTMLElement) => void
  /** Defaults: Trading rules. The indicator chat passes its own. */
  title?: string
  description?: string
  examples?: string[][]
  /** Typing (Figma "3.1 Manual typing"): the heading and the examples fold away, the logo stays in the middle. */
  typing?: boolean
  /**
   * How the suggestions show. 'list' (primary, default): "Top 3 suggestions" as a vertical list just above the
   * input. 'rows': the earlier example rows drifting sideways under the orb — secondary, kept for later, not used now.
   */
  suggestions?: 'list' | 'rows'
  /** The list's suggestions (default: the first three examples). */
  top?: string[]
  /** An action after the top suggestions (Upload a Pine Script). */
  topAction?: { label: string; onPick: () => void }
}

/**
 * The empty chat (Figma "2. Set trading rules – Chat screen"): heading, the orb, example prompts drifting by — the
 * body centred between the top bar and the input, 40 between the parts. It's the first state of the one chat
 * screen: a chip sends itself; tapping the input folds the heading and the examples away (300 ms) so the orb sits
 * alone above the keyboard.
 */
export function RulesIntro({ onPick, title = t('rulesHome.title', { name: firstName }), description = t('rulesHome.description'), examples = examplePrompts, typing = false, suggestions = 'list', top = examples.flat().slice(0, 3), topAction }: RulesIntroProps) {
  return (
    <Stack align="stretch" justify="center" className={styles.body}>
      <div className={styles.fold} data-part="heading" data-gone={typing || undefined}>
        <div className={styles.foldInner}>
          <Inset paddingInline="16">
            <Stack gap="08" className={styles.heading}>
              <h1 className={styles.title}>{title}</h1>
              <p className={styles.description}>{description}</p>
            </Stack>
          </Inset>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Stack align="center">
        <DashOrb size="lg" />
      </Stack>
      <div className={styles.fold} data-part="examples" data-layout={suggestions} data-gone={typing || undefined}>
        <div className={styles.foldInner}>
          {suggestions === 'list' ? (
            <Inset paddingInline="16">
              <SuggestionList items={top} onPick={onPick} action={topAction} />
            </Inset>
          ) : (
            <Stack as="section" gap="24">
              <SparkleHeading>{t('rulesHome.examples')}</SparkleHeading>
              <PromptChips rows={examples} onPick={onPick} />
            </Stack>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

```css
.scene[data-move='back'][data-role='enter'] { animation: scene-in-from-start var(--app-dash-scene) var(--app-dash-scene-easing) both; }
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/SceneSwap.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactElement } from 'react'
import { SceneRole } from './DashDock'
import styles from './SceneSwap.module.css'

/** How one scene replaces another (Figma prototype): push (landing ↔ chat) or dissolve. */
export type SceneMove = 'push' | 'back' | 'fade'

type Layer = { key: string; node: ReactElement; role: 'current' | 'enter' | 'exit' }

/** Matches --app-dash-scene (300 ms) plus a little room; a fallback for when the animation doesn't run. */
const SETTLE_MS = 400

/**
 * Inside the one DASH screen, the body changes scene while the background and the top bar stay put. When `sceneKey`
 * changes, the old scene stays on screen while it leaves (keeping its state) and the new one comes in:
 * push = the new scene from the right, the old one out to the left; back = the reverse; fade = a dissolve.
 */
export function SceneSwap({ sceneKey, move, children }: { sceneKey: string; move: SceneMove; children: ReactElement }) {
  const [layers, setLayers] = useState<Layer[]>([{ key: sceneKey, node: children, role: 'current' }])
  const [lastMove, setLastMove] = useState(move)
  /** The last element the scene on show rendered — what it looks like as it leaves. */
  const lastShown = useRef(children)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (layers[layers.length - 1].key === sceneKey) lastShown.current = children
  })

  // A new scene (derived during render, React's "previous props" pattern); same scene: keep its element up to date.
  const top = layers[layers.length - 1]
  if (top.key !== sceneKey) {
    // the leaving scene keeps the element it had (its state stays with its key)
    setLayers([{ ...top, node: lastShown.current, role: 'exit' }, { key: sceneKey, node: children, role: 'enter' }])
    setLastMove(move)
  }

  const entering = layers.some((l) => l.role === 'enter')
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!entering) return
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setLayers((ls) => ls.filter((l) => l.role !== 'exit').map((l) => ({ ...l, role: 'current' }))), SETTLE_MS)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
  }, [entering])

  return (
    <div className={styles.stage}>
      {layers.map((l) => (
        <div key={l.key} className={styles.scene} data-role={l.role} data-move={lastMove} inert={l.role === 'exit'}>
          {/* the scene on show always renders the latest props; the one leaving keeps its last look */}
          <SceneRole.Provider value={l.role}>{l.role === 'exit' ? l.node : children}</SceneRole.Provider>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```css
/* The track: the pill group's grey container (drawn here so the thumb can sit between it and the labels). The pills
   themselves have no fill. */
.track {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--pills-track, var(--l3-surface-secondary)); /* a field may set --pills-track (V7 dock: primary) */
  box-shadow: var(--pills-track-shadow, none); /* …and --pills-track-shadow (the dock's white track: a low shadow) */
}

/* The black thumb under the picked pill, raised strong (L3 Raised); it glides to the next one (left / width, 250 ms). */
.thumb {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  bottom: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-inverted);
}

.thumb[data-ready='yes'] {
  transition:
    left var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard),
    width var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

/* The L3 group and its pills go transparent: the thumb shows through; the labels swap colour as it passes. */
.tabs.tabs {
  position: relative;
  background: transparent;
}

/* Every pill transparent — the picked one too (L3 would paint it black itself, flipping instantly while the thumb
   is still sliding): only the thumb is black. */
.tabs.tabs [role='tab'][role='tab'][role='tab'] { /* outranks L3's picked-pill rule */
  --tab-surface: transparent;
  --tab-border: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
  background-image: none;
  transition: color var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-standard);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .thumb[data-ready='yes'],
  .tabs [role='tab'] {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* Full width (DASH V3 "Pills above", the field's top row): the track and the L3 group stretch; the pills share it
   equally. Inside the field, so it keeps the grey track. */
.track[data-fill] {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
}

.track[data-fill] .tabs {
  flex: 1;
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/SlidingPills.tsx`

```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Badge } from '@l3/components/Badge'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msFunction, msMonitoring, msRule } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { dashRules, savedIndicators } from '../data'
import { useDashUser } from './dashVersion'
import styles from './SlidingPills.module.css'

/** Setting "Pill icons": each kind's icon before its name (the same marks as V5 · Cards' cards). */
const KIND_ICONS: Record<string, string> = { rule: msRule, indicator: msMonitoring, strategy: msFunction }

/**
 * Setting "Pill counts" (A/B, every version): a tiny rounded count on each unpicked kind — how many of it the user
 * has made (none → no tag). Returns the badge for a pill, or nothing.
 */
export function usePillCount() {
  const on = useFlowOption('dash', 'pillCounts', 'off') === 'on'
  const { made } = useDashUser()
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {
    rule: made.rule ? dashRules.length : 0,
    indicator: made.indicator ? savedIndicators.length : 0,
    strategy: 0, // strategies can't be made yet
  }
  return (value: string, picked: boolean): ReactNode =>
    on && !picked && counts[value] ? <Badge count={counts[value]} color="neutral" size="sm" label={`${counts[value]}`} /> : undefined
}

/** The kind switcher's icon for a value while the setting "Pill icons" is on (also used by V11's ribbon tabs). */
export function usePillIcon() {
  const on = useFlowOption('dash', 'pillIcons', 'off') === 'on'
  return (value: string) => (on && KIND_ICONS[value] ? <Icon icon={KIND_ICONS[value]} size={16} /> : undefined)
}

/**
 * The field's "what to build" pill group (L3 Tabs, pill-group · toggle · md) with a sliding black thumb: the picked
 * pill's black doesn't flip from one pill to the next, it glides there (250 ms) and the labels swap colour as it
 * passes. The pills themselves are transparent here; the grey track and the thumb are drawn behind them.
 */
export function SlidingPills({ value, items, onChange, label, newLabel, fill = false }: {
  value: string
  items: { value: string; label: string; isNew?: boolean }[]
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  label: string
  newLabel: string
  /** Full width, the pills sharing it equally (Chat input "Pills above"). */
  fill?: boolean
}) {
  const icons = useFlowOption('dash', 'pillIcons', 'off') === 'on'
  // The thumb re-measures when counts come or go (they change the pills' widths).
  const countsOn = useFlowOption('dash', 'pillCounts', 'off') === 'on'
  const track = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const thumb = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const first = useRef(true)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const picked = track.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role=tab][aria-selected=true]')
    const el = thumb.current
    if (!picked || !el) return
    el.style.left = `${picked.offsetLeft}px`
    el.style.width = `${picked.offsetWidth}px`
    // The first placement doesn't animate; the slide (CSS transition on left / width) switches on a frame later, so
    // even the very first pick glides — turning it on in the same frame as a move made that move jump.
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { el.dataset.ready = 'yes' })
    }
  }, [value, fill, icons, countsOn, items.map((i) => i.value).join('|')]) // also when the pills themselves change (3 → 1 once a chat starts)
  const count = usePillCount()
  const withBadges = items.map(({ isNew, ...item }) => ({
    ...item,
    ...(icons && KIND_ICONS[item.value] ? { iconLeft: <Icon icon={KIND_ICONS[item.value]} size={16} /> } : {}),
    // A New dot wins over a count; a count only on the unpicked pills (setting "Pill counts").
    ...(isNew ? { badge: <Badge dot color="discover" label={newLabel} /> as ReactNode } : count(item.value, item.value === value) ? { badge: count(item.value, item.value === value) } : {}),
  }))
  return (
    <span ref={track} className={styles.track} data-fill={fill || undefined}>
      <span ref={thumb} className={styles.thumb} data-raised="strong" aria-hidden="true" />
      <Tabs aria-label={label} appearance="pill-group" behavior="toggle" size="md" width={fill ? 'fill' : 'hug'} items={withBadges} value={value} onChange={onChange} className={styles.tabs} />
    </span>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/SuccessBurst.module.css`

```css
/*
 * "Your rule is created" — timings from the live recording (2026-10-23): the sheet is up at ~0.25 s; the disc pops
 * 0.15 → 0.55 s (slight overshoot), the tick draws 0.35 → 0.6 s, confetti bursts with the pop and falls for 1.6 s.
 * Confetti px values are artwork geometry (set per piece in SuccessBurst.tsx).
 */
.burst {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-48);
  height: var(--l3-size-48);
}

.tick {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--l3-size-48);
  height: var(--l3-size-48);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  color: var(--l3-static-white);
  animation: tick-pop var(--app-dash-pop-duration) var(--app-dash-pop-easing) 150ms both;
}

@keyframes tick-pop {
  from {
    transform: scale(0);
  }
}

/* View Rules: the tick turns away like a coin (live: 28.5 → 28.8 s) before the list fades in. */
.tick[data-leaving] {
  animation: tick-flip var(--l3-motion-duration-short) var(--l3-motion-easing-accelerate) both;
}

@keyframes tick-flip {
  to {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
}

.check {
  width: var(--l3-size-28);
  height: var(--l3-size-28);
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 3; /* artwork stroke, in the 24 viewBox */
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.check path {
  stroke-dasharray: 1;
  stroke-dashoffset: 1;
  animation: tick-draw var(--l3-motion-duration-medium) var(--l3-motion-easing-decelerate) 350ms forwards;
}

@keyframes tick-draw {
  to {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  }
}

/* Confetti: every piece starts at the tick, bursts out to (dx, dy), then drifts down and fades. */
.confetti {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.confetti span {
  position: absolute;
  width: var(--l3-size-04);
  height: var(--l3-size-04);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: confetti var(--app-dash-confetti-duration) cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.7, 0.4, 1) calc(150ms + var(--delay)) forwards;
}

.confetti span[data-tone='1'] {
  background: var(--l3-base-hue-yellow-200);
}

.confetti span[data-tone='2'] {
  background: var(--l3-base-hue-brand-lemonn-400); /* lime in light mode … */
}

:root[data-mode='dark'] .confetti span[data-tone='2'] {
  background: var(--l3-base-neutral-white-base); /* … white in dark, as in the live app */
}

.confetti span[data-long] {
  width: var(--l3-size-08);
  height: var(--l3-spacing-02);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-02);
}

@keyframes confetti {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.4);
  }
  8% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  30% {
    transform: translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) rotate(calc(var(--turn) / 3)) scale(1);
  }
  80% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(var(--dx), calc(var(--dy) + var(--fall))) rotate(var(--turn)) scale(1);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .tick,
  .tick[data-leaving],
  .check path,
  .confetti span {
    animation: none;
  }

  .check path {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  }
}
```
