### `src/flows/dash/components/SuccessBurst.tsx`

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react'
import styles from './SuccessBurst.module.css'

/** Confetti pieces. Positions are spread with the golden angle, so they look random but render the same every time. */
const PIECES = Array.from({ length: 36 }, (_, i) => {
  const angle = (i * 137.5 * Math.PI) / 180
  const reach = 48 + ((i * 53) % 132) // 48 … 180 out from the tick
  return {
    dx: Math.round(Math.cos(angle) * reach * 1.3), // wider than tall, like the live burst
    dy: Math.round(Math.sin(angle) * reach * 0.55 - 24), // biased upwards
    fall: 90 + ((i * 37) % 70), // then drifts down 90 … 160
    turn: (i * 71) % 360,
    delay: (i % 6) * 30,
    tone: i % 3, // green · yellow · white
    long: i % 4 === 0, // a few strips among the dots
  }
})

/**
 * The success moment on "Your rule is created" (live app recording, 2026-10-23): a green disc pops in with a slight
 * overshoot, the tick draws itself, and confetti bursts out of it and drifts down for ~1.6 s.
 * `leaving` flips the tick away (a coin turn, 200 ms) before the next screen. Decoration only: the heading says it.
 */
export function SuccessBurst({ leaving = false }: { leaving?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span className={styles.burst} aria-hidden="true">
      <span className={styles.confetti}>
        {PIECES.map((p, i) => (
          <span
            key={i}
            data-tone={p.tone}
            data-long={p.long || undefined}
            style={{ '--dx': `${p.dx}px`, '--dy': `${p.dy}px`, '--fall': `${p.fall}px`, '--turn': `${p.turn}deg`, '--delay': `${p.delay}ms` } as CSSProperties}
          />
        ))}
      </span>
      <span className={styles.tick} data-leaving={leaving || undefined}>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" className={styles.check}>
          <path d="M6 12.5l4 4 8-9" pathLength={1} />
        </svg>
      </span>
    </span>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/askModes.ts`

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useDashVersion } from './dashVersion'
import { t } from '../copy'

export type Mode = 'rule' | 'indicator' | 'strategy'

/**
 * The DASH home field's "what to build" switch (setting "Chat input": Pills / Dropdown / Previous). With the switch, the
 * field always shows Rule · Indicator · Strategy — so someone who has only made rules still sees what else DASH
 * builds — and the placeholder and where Send goes follow the pick. Plain: the rotating placeholder, Send guesses.
 */
export function useAskModes({ onRules, onIndicator, guess, newKind }: { onRules?: () => void; onIndicator?: () => void; guess: (text: string) => void; /** The kind launched last: marked New in the switch (returning home V3). */ newKind?: Mode }) {
  const field = useDashVersion().field
  const on = field !== 'plain'
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('rule')
  if (!on) return null
  return {
    /** The pick: the + (Pine Script upload) only shows for indicators. */
    mode,
    modes: {
      value: mode,
      label: t('askModes.label'),
      items: (['rule', 'indicator', 'strategy'] as const).map((value) => ({ value, label: t(`askModes.${value}`), isNew: value === newKind })),
      onChange: (v: string) => setMode(v as Mode),
      // Dropdown: one pill (↕) that opens a menu; Pills: all three side by side in the field; Pills above: over it.
      display: field === 'menu' ? ('menu' as const) : field === 'above' ? ('above' as const) : ('pills' as const),
    },
    placeholder: t(`askModes.placeholder.${mode}`),
    // Rules and indicators open their chat; a strategy (no chat yet) goes by what was typed.
    send: (text: string) => (mode === 'rule' ? onRules?.() : mode === 'indicator' ? onIndicator?.() : guess(text)),
  }
}

/**
 * Inside a chat: the same two-row field as the home's, always with all three pills — they tell people what DASH can
 * make (the AI adapts to whatever is typed; the pick isn't a filter). Before anything is sent (switcher given), a pick
 * flips the chat's suggestions (or opens the other chat); once the conversation has started, a pick only moves the
 * highlight. Plain field (a version with the Previous field) → none.
 */
export function useChatKind(kind: Mode, switcher?: { onChange: (kind: Mode) => void } | null) {
  const version = useDashVersion()
  const field = version.field
  // The highlighted pill: this chat's kind, or what was picked during the conversation.
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Mode>(kind)
  useEffect(() => setPicked(kind), [kind])
  if (field === 'plain') return null
  // Once the conversation has started (no switcher) the pills go — the field turns into a plain one-line box, so a
  // stray tap can't switch kinds mid-chat. V11's ribbon keeps them a moment to sink back into the field.
  if (!switcher && !version.ribbonTabs) return null
  return {
    value: picked,
    label: t('askModes.label'),
    items: (['rule', 'indicator', 'strategy'] as const).map((value) => ({ value, label: t(`askModes.${value}`) })),
    onChange: (v: string) => {
      if (switcher) switcher.onChange(v as Mode)
      else setPicked(v as Mode)
    },
    display: field === 'above' ? ('above' as const) : ('pills' as const),
    /** The conversation has started (no switcher): V11's ribbon tabs sink back into the field. */
    sunk: !switcher,
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/dashVersion.ts`

```ts
import { useFlowOption } from '../../../shared/prototype'

/**
 * DASH versions — the prototype setting "DASH version" (dropdown, Home group). A version is the whole DASH home
 * experience: which home a new and a returning user see, and the chat input's style. Pure data here; each version's
 * scenes are in screens/homes.tsx (same `value`).
 *
 * To add a version: one entry here + one in screens/homes.tsx (build new scenes in new files, so the others stay).
 * The user (setting "User": New / Returning, and "Made so far" for a returning one) is NOT part of a version: every
 * version reads it with useDashUser() and adapts its cards (a rule made → no "Create rule" card, its numbers instead).
 */

/** The chat input's style: Previous (plain, rotating placeholder) · Pills (Rule · Indicator · Strategy in the field) ·
 *  Pills above (a full-width switch over the field) · Dropdown (one chip that opens a menu). */
export type AskField = 'plain' | 'switch' | 'above' | 'menu'

export type DashVersionInfo = {
  /** Stored value of the setting (keep it once published: people's picks are saved under it). */
  value: string
  /** In the dropdown: "V7 · Dock" — one short word after the number. */
  label: string
  /** Off the dropdown, code kept (an old pick still shows it). */
  hidden?: boolean
  field: AskField
  /** The field is a dock: edge to edge at the bottom, rounded top corners, text on top and the controls (pills, +,
   *  Send) in a row under it (like Gemini). */
  dock?: boolean
  /** First message focus: while typing the first message of a chat (home or empty chat) the field glows, what's
   *  behind it washes out under white, and suggestions stack above the field. Later messages type as usual. */
  firstMessageFocus?: boolean
  /** Create pills ("Create strategy" · "Create indicator") as the top row inside the field (the + · text · Send row
   *  under them, no kind pills); the "Your creations" row then shows only what's been made (no + Create card). */
  createPills?: boolean
  /** V10: while the first message is typed, one card over the field — a row per kind (how many, how many active) with
   *  Create — instead of the suggestion pills. */
  firstCard?: boolean
  /** While the first message is typed: the suggestions over the field, and the DASH orb + title step away (V7). V8's
   *  firstMessageFocus includes this. */
  firstSuggestions?: boolean
  /** Only the white wash while the first message is typed — no field edge or suggestions (V9). 'rise': the wash
   *  clears at the bottom and the glow climbs behind what sits over the field. */
  firstMessageWash?: 'wash' | 'rise'
  /** The glow rises higher from the bottom (the white disc ends higher): 'dock' behind the field (V7), 'cards' up
   *  behind the cards above it too (V9). */
  glowRise?: 'dock' | 'cards'
  /** V8 · Tabs: Rule · Indicator · Strategy as tabs in the middle of the top bar (not in the field); the whole home
   *  body follows the pick. The field is the plain floating one. */
  topKinds?: boolean
  /** V9 · Switch (with field 'above'): the Rule · Indicator · Strategy toggle takes the field's whole top row; the +,
   *  the text and Send make the row under it. */
  switchFullTop?: boolean
  /** V10 · Heading: the Rule · Indicator · Strategy pills right under the page's question, not in the field. */
  pillsUnderTitle?: boolean
  /** V11 · Ribbon (with field 'above' + switchFullTop): the kinds as L3 ribbon (folder) tabs, the field's top row on a
   *  grey strip — the picked tab is white and opens into the field. */
  ribbonTabs?: boolean
  /** V12 · Center: the field's edge is the green → lime → yellow gradient, turning slowly round it. */
  edgeTurn?: boolean
}

// The dropdown numbers the shown versions in order (V1–V6); `value` stays the original id (picks are saved under it,
// and the code and changelog call them by it): V3 Dock = '7', V4 Focus = '8', V5 Cards = '9', V6 Creations = '10', V7 Pills = '11'.
// Hidden ones ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', 'combined') are older ideas kept in the code. The shown labels keep their
// numbers (V3–V7) so they match what's been shared.
export const dashVersions: DashVersionInfo[] = [
  { value: '1', label: 'Old · V1 Classic', hidden: true, field: 'plain' }, // archived 2026-10-30
  { value: '2', label: 'Old · V2 Pills', hidden: true, field: 'switch' }, // archived 2026-10-30 (was the default)
  { value: '3', label: 'Old · Pills above', hidden: true, field: 'above' },
  { value: '4', label: 'Old · Dropdown field', hidden: true, field: 'menu' },
  { value: '5', label: 'Old · A section per kind', hidden: true, field: 'plain' },
  { value: '6', label: 'Old · One home, Create cards', hidden: true, field: 'switch' },
  { value: '7', label: 'V3 · Dock', field: 'switch', dock: true, glowRise: 'dock', firstSuggestions: true },
  { value: '8', label: 'V4 · Floating', field: 'switch', firstMessageFocus: true },
  { value: '9', label: 'V5 · Cards', field: 'switch', dock: true, glowRise: 'cards', firstMessageWash: 'rise', firstSuggestions: true },
  { value: '10', label: 'V6 · Creations', field: 'switch', firstMessageFocus: true, firstCard: true },
  { value: '11', label: 'V7 · Pills', field: 'plain', dock: true, glowRise: 'dock', createPills: true, firstSuggestions: true },
  { value: '12', label: 'V8 · Tabs', field: 'plain', topKinds: true },
  { value: '13', label: 'V9 · Switch', field: 'above', switchFullTop: true, firstSuggestions: true },
  { value: '14', label: 'V10 · Heading', field: 'switch', pillsUnderTitle: true, firstSuggestions: true },
  { value: '15', label: 'V11 · Ribbon', field: 'above', switchFullTop: true, ribbonTabs: true, firstSuggestions: true },
  { value: '16', label: 'V12 · Center', field: 'plain', firstSuggestions: true, edgeTurn: true },
  { value: '17', label: 'V13 · Center pills', field: 'switch', firstSuggestions: true, edgeTurn: true },
  { value: 'combined', label: 'Combined', hidden: true, field: 'switch' },
]

/** The setting's default: V7 · Pills (since 2026-10-30; V2 · Pills before it was archived). */
export const defaultDashVersion = '11'

export const dashVersionInfo = (value: string) => dashVersions.find((v) => v.value === value) ?? dashVersions.find((v) => v.value === defaultDashVersion)!

/** The picked DASH version. */
export function useDashVersion() {
  return dashVersionInfo(useFlowOption('dash', 'dashVersion', defaultDashVersion))
}

export type CreationKind = 'rule' | 'indicator' | 'strategy'

/**
 * The person using DASH (settings "User" and "Made so far"): new (nothing made) or returning, and what they've made.
 * `forced` (a screen that is always one or the other, e.g. dash-28) wins over the setting.
 */
export function useDashUser(forced?: boolean) {
  const picked = useFlowOption('dash', 'user', 'returning') === 'returning'
  const madeSetting = useFlowOption('dash', 'made', 'both')
  const returning = forced ?? picked
  const made: Record<CreationKind, boolean> = {
    rule: returning && madeSetting !== 'indicators',
    indicator: returning && madeSetting !== 'rules',
    strategy: false, // strategies can't be made yet
  }
  return { returning, made }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/edgeFade.ts`

```ts
import { useEffect, type RefObject } from 'react'

/**
 * Soft edges on a scrolling chat: marks the scroller `data-fade-top` while there's content above (scrolled down) and
 * `data-fade-bottom` while there's content below — the CSS fades that edge out, so messages slide in and out of view
 * (behind the input) instead of being cut. At rest at either end that edge stays sharp. Re-checked on scroll, resize
 * and whenever the conversation changes. Written straight onto the element (no re-render per scroll).
 */
export function useEdgeFade(scroller: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = scroller.current
    if (!el) return
    const check = () => {
      el.toggleAttribute('data-fade-top', el.scrollTop > 1)
      el.toggleAttribute('data-fade-bottom', el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight - el.scrollTop > 1)
    }
    check()
    el.addEventListener('scroll', check, { passive: true })
    const resize = new ResizeObserver(check)
    resize.observe(el)
    const changes = new MutationObserver(check)
    changes.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true })
    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener('scroll', check)
      resize.disconnect()
      changes.disconnect()
    }
  }, [scroller])
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/flyMessage.ts`

```ts
// The sent message flies to its place: the chip that was tapped (or the text that was typed) becomes the user's
// message at the top of the chat — like ChatGPT / Claude, the screen itself changes state, nothing is pushed in.
//
// How: a copy ("ghost") of the source is drawn on top of the screen at the source's place, then moved and reshaped
// into the message bubble's place and look; the real bubble shows when it lands. Measured, so it works for any chip,
// any text length and any screen width. If anything goes wrong, the bubble simply shows.

type Look = {
  left: string
  top: string
  width: string
  height: string
  borderRadius: string
  backgroundColor: string
  borderColor: string
  fontSize: string
  lineHeight: string
  paddingTop: string
  paddingRight: string
  paddingBottom: string
  paddingLeft: string
}

/** Where something was and how it looked, captured before the screen changes. */
export type FlyOrigin = { rect: DOMRect; text: string; borderWidth: string; snapshot: Omit<Look, 'left' | 'top' | 'width' | 'height'> }

function lookOf(s: CSSStyleDeclaration): FlyOrigin['snapshot'] {
  return {
    borderRadius: s.borderRadius,
    backgroundColor: s.backgroundColor,
    borderColor: s.borderTopColor,
    fontSize: s.fontSize,
    lineHeight: s.lineHeight,
    paddingTop: s.paddingTop,
    paddingRight: s.paddingRight,
    paddingBottom: s.paddingBottom,
    paddingLeft: s.paddingLeft,
  }
}

export function captureOrigin(el: HTMLElement, text: string): FlyOrigin {
  // Read now: the source leaves the screen as soon as the message is sent.
  const style = getComputedStyle(el)
  return { rect: el.getBoundingClientRect(), text, borderWidth: style.borderTopWidth, snapshot: lookOf(style) }
}

const reduced = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches

/**
 * Fly a ghost from `origin` to `target` (the real message bubble, already laid out). `stage` is the positioned element
 * the ghost is drawn in (the screen). The target is hidden until the ghost lands.
 */
export function flyMessage(origin: FlyOrigin, target: HTMLElement, stage: HTMLElement, durationMs: number) {
  if (reduced()) return
  const s = stage.getBoundingClientRect()
  const to = target.getBoundingClientRect()
  const targetStyle = getComputedStyle(target)
  const box = (r: DOMRect) => ({ left: `${r.left - s.left}px`, top: `${r.top - s.top}px`, width: `${r.width}px`, height: `${r.height}px` })
  const from: Look = { ...box(origin.rect), ...origin.snapshot }
  const end: Look = { ...box(to), ...lookOf(targetStyle) }

  const ghost = document.createElement('div')
  ghost.textContent = origin.text
  ghost.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
  ghost.dataset.flyGhost = ''
  Object.assign(ghost.style, {
    position: 'absolute',
    zIndex: '30',
    boxSizing: 'border-box',
    display: 'flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    overflow: 'hidden',
    pointerEvents: 'none',
    borderStyle: 'solid',
    borderWidth: origin.borderWidth,
    color: targetStyle.color,
    fontFamily: targetStyle.fontFamily,
    fontWeight: targetStyle.fontWeight,
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap', // one line, like the chip and the bubble (the border would otherwise make it wrap)
    ...from,
  })

  const land = () => {
    target.style.visibility = ''
    ghost.remove()
  }
  try {
    stage.appendChild(ghost)
    target.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    const animation = ghost.animate([from, { ...end, borderColor: 'transparent' }], { duration: durationMs, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)', fill: 'forwards' })
    animation.onfinish = land
    animation.oncancel = land
    // Safety net: never leave the message hidden.
    window.setTimeout(land, durationMs + 300)
  } catch {
    land()
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Which tab the history page (Created with DASH) opens on, when another screen asks — the returning home's View all
 * on Your rules / Your indicators. Held for a moment and taken once as the page opens; otherwise it opens on All.
 */
export type HistoryTab = 'all' | 'rules' | 'indicators' | 'strategies'
let pending: HistoryTab | null = null

export function openHistoryOn(tab: HistoryTab) {
  pending = tab
}

/** The asked-for tab (the page takes it as it opens; cleared after this tick, so a dev-mode double render gets it too). */
export function takeHistoryTab(): HistoryTab {
  const tab = pending ?? 'all'
  window.setTimeout(() => (pending = null), 0)
  return tab
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/homeKeyboard.tsx`

```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { TextKeyboard, typeText } from '../../../shared/ui/TextKeyboard'
import chat from '../screens/RuleChat.module.css'
import { holdMessage } from './pendingMessage'

/**
 * The drawn keyboard on the DASH home screens (returning v1 / v2, combined), as in the chats: tapping the field turns
 * the typing state on and the prototype's keyboard rises (a phone's own keyboard stays closed — ChatInput sets
 * inputMode none on touch); the drawn keys type into the field; tapping the page or sending puts it away. The
 * screen's background ends above it (--dash-kb). Typing is kept by the DASH screen (DashAI).
 */
export function useHomeKeyboard({ typing = false, onTyping }: { typing?: boolean; onTyping?: (typing: boolean) => void }) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('')
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const screen = box.current?.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-dash]')
    if (screen && box.current) screen.style.setProperty('--dash-kb', `${(box.current.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null)?.offsetHeight ?? 0}px`)
  }, [typing])
  return {
    /** Spread on the ChatInput. */
    field: { value: draft, onChange: setDraft, typing, onFocus: () => onTyping?.(true) },
    /** On the page: a tap puts the keyboard away. */
    close: typing ? () => onTyping?.(false) : undefined,
    /** Wraps Send: the keyboard goes once the message is sent. */
    sending: <A extends unknown[]>(send: (...args: A) => void) => (...args: A) => {
      // The typed message goes with it: the chat that opens sends it (pendingMessage).
      if (typeof args[0] === 'string') holdMessage(args[0])
      onTyping?.(false)
      send(...args)
    },
    keyboard: (
      <div className={chat.keyboard} data-open={typing || undefined}>
        <div className={chat.keyboardInner} ref={box}>
          <TextKeyboard onKey={(k) => setDraft((d) => typeText(d, k))} />
        </div>
      </div>
    ),
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/homeKind.ts`

```ts
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
import type { Mode } from './askModes'

/**
 * V8 · Tabs: what the home is about (Rule · Indicator · Strategy). The pick lives in the top bar (DashAI) and the home
 * body follows it (HomeTabs), so it's one small shared value both read.
 */
let kind: Mode = 'rule'
const listeners = new Set<() => void>()

export function setHomeKind(next: Mode) {
  if (next === kind) return
  kind = next
  listeners.forEach((l) => l())
}

export function useHomeKind(): Mode {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    (l) => { listeners.add(l); return () => { listeners.delete(l) } },
    () => kind,
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/longPress.ts`

```ts
import { useRef, type MouseEvent, type PointerEvent } from 'react'

/** How long a press must be held to count as a long press. */
export const HOLD_MS = 500

/**
 * Press and hold (0.5 s, or right-click on a laptop) → `onHold`; a plain tap → `onTap`. Moving the finger (swiping a
 * row) cancels the hold, and the click that ends a hold doesn't count as a tap. Spread the result on the pressable.
 */
export function useLongPress({ onHold, onTap }: { onHold: () => void; onTap?: () => void }) {
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  const start = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null)
  const held = useRef(false)
  const cancel = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    start.current = null
  }
  return {
    onPointerDown: (e: PointerEvent) => {
      held.current = false
      start.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        held.current = true
        start.current = null
        navigator.vibrate?.(10)
        onHold()
      }, HOLD_MS)
    },
    onPointerMove: (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (start.current && Math.hypot(e.clientX - start.current.x, e.clientY - start.current.y) > 8) cancel()
    },
    onPointerUp: cancel,
    onPointerLeave: cancel,
    onPointerCancel: cancel,
    onContextMenu: (e: MouseEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); cancel(); held.current = true; onHold() },
    onClick: () => { if (held.current) { held.current = false; return } onTap?.() },
  }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/pendingMessage.ts`

```ts
/**
 * A message sent from the DASH home's field: held here for a moment, so the chat it opens sends it straight away (it
 * flies up from the field as the first message and DASH starts on it) — the conversation carries on instead of
 * starting over on an empty chat. Prototype only.
 */
let pending: string | null = null

export function holdMessage(text: string) {
  pending = text.trim() || null
}

/** Is a message waiting? (The DASH screen cross-fades the body instead of pushing a new screen.) */
export function hasHeldMessage() {
  return pending != null
}

/** The held message, once (the chat takes it as it opens; cleared after this tick, so a dev-mode double render gets it too). */
export function takeMessage() {
  const text = pending
  window.setTimeout(() => (pending = null), 0)
  return text
}

/**
 * Switching what to build from a chat's empty state (the field's Rule · Indicator · Strategy): the next chat opens in
 * that kind (Strategy opens the rules chat in its strategy mode) and the DASH screen cross-fades the body only.
 */
let pendingKind: 'rule' | 'strategy' | null = null
let switching = false

export function switchKind(kind: 'rule' | 'strategy' | 'indicator') {
  pendingKind = kind === 'indicator' ? null : kind
  switching = true
  window.setTimeout(() => (switching = false), 400) // past the screen change (the route updates after this tick)
}

/** Is a switch under way? (the DASH screen cross-fades instead of pushing) */
export function isSwitchingKind() {
  return switching
}

/** The kind the rules chat opens in, once (cleared after this tick, for a dev-mode double render). */
export function takeKind() {
  const kind = pendingKind
  window.setTimeout(() => (pendingKind = null), 0)
  return kind
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/pineExport.ts`

```ts
import { defaultSettings, type IndicatorSettings } from '../indicatorData'

/**
 * The Pine Script (v5) behind an indicator DASH built, for Copy / Download (prototype: written from the indicator's
 * settings — the real app gets it from DASH). Supertrend + EMA by default; the opening-range sample has its own.
 */
export function pineScriptFor(name: string, settings: IndicatorSettings = defaultSettings): string {
  if (/opening range/i.test(name)) {
    return [
      '//@version=5',
      `indicator("${name}", overlay = true)`,
      '',
      '// The first 15 minutes of the session: its high and low, drawn for the rest of the day',
      'rangeMinutes = input.int(15, "Opening range (minutes)")',
      'session = input.session("0915-1530", "Market hours")',
      '',
      'inSession = not na(time(timeframe.period, session))',
      'start = ta.valuewhen(inSession and not inSession[1], time, 0)',
      'inRange = inSession and time < start + rangeMinutes * 60 * 1000',
      '',
      'var float orHigh = na',
      'var float orLow = na',
      'if inSession and not inSession[1]',
      '    orHigh := high',
      '    orLow := low',
      'else if inRange',
      '    orHigh := math.max(orHigh, high)',
      '    orLow := math.min(orLow, low)',
      '',
      'plot(inSession ? orHigh : na, "Range high", color.green, 2, plot.style_linebr)',
      'plot(inSession ? orLow : na, "Range low", color.red, 2, plot.style_linebr)',
      '',
    ].join('\n')
  }
  const { stPeriod, stMultiplier, emaPeriod } = settings
  return [
    '//@version=5',
    `indicator("${name}", overlay = true)`,
    '',
    '// Built with DASH on Lemonn',
    `atrPeriod = input.int(${stPeriod}, "Supertrend ATR period")`,
    `factor = input.float(${stMultiplier}, "Supertrend multiplier", step = 0.1)`,
    `emaLength = input.int(${emaPeriod}, "EMA length")`,
    '',
    '[supertrend, direction] = ta.supertrend(factor, atrPeriod)',
    'ema = ta.ema(close, emaLength)',
    '',
    'plot(direction < 0 ? supertrend : na, "Up trend", color.green, 2, plot.style_linebr)',
    'plot(direction < 0 ? na : supertrend, "Down trend", color.red, 2, plot.style_linebr)',
    'plot(ema, "EMA", color.orange, 1)',
    '',
    '// BUY when the trend turns up above the EMA, SELL when it turns down below it',
    'buy = ta.change(direction) < 0 and close > ema',
    'sell = ta.change(direction) > 0 and close < ema',
    'plotshape(buy, "BUY", shape.labelup, location.belowbar, color.green, text = "BUY", textcolor = color.white)',
    'plotshape(sell, "SELL", shape.labeldown, location.abovebar, color.red, text = "SELL", textcolor = color.white)',
    '',
  ].join('\n')
}

/** Copies the script; resolves false if the browser won't (no clipboard access). */
export async function copyPine(script: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(script)
    return true
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

/** The file name: "<name>.pine" (letters and digits, underscores between). */
const fileName = (name: string) => `${name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '_').replace(/^_|_$/g, '') || 'indicator'}.pine`

/**
 * Shares the script through the phone's share sheet (as a .pine file where the browser can, else as text). Where there's
 * no share sheet (most laptops), it copies instead. Resolves what happened: 'shared' · 'copied' · 'cancelled'.
 */
export async function sharePine(name: string, script: string): Promise<'shared' | 'copied' | 'cancelled'> {
  const file = new File([script], fileName(name), { type: 'text/plain' })
  try {
    if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: name })
    else if (navigator.share) await navigator.share({ title: name, text: script })
    else return (await copyPine(script)) ? 'copied' : 'cancelled'
    return 'shared'
  } catch {
    return 'cancelled' // closed the share sheet
  }
}

/** Saves the script as "<name>.pine" (made on the phone — nothing is sent anywhere). */
export function downloadPine(name: string, script: string) {
  const file = fileName(name)
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([script], { type: 'text/plain' }))
  const a = document.createElement('a')
  a.href = url
  a.download = file
  a.click()
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000)
}
```

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { PineUploadSheet } from '../sheets/PineUploadSheet'
import { holdFile } from './pendingFile'

/**
 * The field's + (Pine Script upload), for a home: the + opens a sheet that explains it,
 * Choose a file opens the picker, and the indicator chat opens with the file attached. Spread `onAttach` on the
 * ChatInput and render `ui` next to it.
 */
export function usePineUpload(onIndicator?: () => void) {
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState(false)
  const ui = (
    <>
      <input
        ref={fileInput}
        type="file"
        hidden
        onChange={(e) => {
          const file = e.target.files?.[0]
          e.target.value = ''
          if (!file) return
          holdFile({ name: file.name })
          onIndicator?.()
        }}
      />
      {sheet && (
        <PineUploadSheet
          onClose={() => setSheet(false)}
          onChoose={() => {
            setSheet(false)
            fileInput.current?.click()
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  )
  return { onAttach: () => setSheet(true), ui }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/components/stickToBottom.ts`

```ts
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react'

/** How close to the bottom (px) still counts as "at the newest message". */
const NEAR_BOTTOM = 64

/**
 * Chat-app scrolling: the newest message stays in view.
 * - Each new turn (`turn` changes) glides to the bottom; so does starting to type (the keyboard comes up).
 * - While the reader is at the bottom, anything that grows the chat — a card building itself, a turn fading in, the
 *   phone's keyboard shrinking the screen — keeps it pinned there.
 * - Scrolling up by hand (wheel, swipe) lets go, so older messages can be read; coming back down to the bottom pins
 *   it again. The chat moving itself never lets go.
 */
export function useStickToBottom(scroller: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, turn: readonly unknown[]) {
  const pinned = useRef(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = scroller.current
    if (!el) return
    const distance = () => el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight - el.scrollTop
    // Instant, so it keeps up with the keyboard sliding in (a glide would trail behind it).
    const follow = () => {
      if (pinned.current) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight
    }
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (distance() < NEAR_BOTTOM) pinned.current = true
    }
    // Only the reader's own scrolling lets go (checked a frame later, once the scroll has moved).
    const onUserScroll = () => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (distance() >= NEAR_BOTTOM) pinned.current = false
    })
    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    el.addEventListener('wheel', onUserScroll, { passive: true })
    el.addEventListener('touchmove', onUserScroll, { passive: true })
    // The scroller itself (keyboard, rotation) and each of its children (the conversation growing).
    const resize = new ResizeObserver(follow)
    const watch = () => {
      resize.disconnect()
      resize.observe(el)
      for (const child of el.children) resize.observe(child)
    }
    watch()
    const changes = new MutationObserver(() => {
      watch()
      follow()
    })
    changes.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true })
    // The phone's keyboard opening or closing (the screen above it shrinks / grows).
    const view = window.visualViewport
    view?.addEventListener('resize', follow)
    return () => {
      view?.removeEventListener('resize', follow)
      el.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
      el.removeEventListener('wheel', onUserScroll)
      el.removeEventListener('touchmove', onUserScroll)
      resize.disconnect()
      changes.disconnect()
    }
  }, [scroller])

  // A new turn: back to the newest message, gliding.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    pinned.current = true
    scroller.current?.scrollTo({ top: scroller.current.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' })
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, turn)
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/copy.ts`

```ts
import { makeCopy } from '../../shared/copy'
import copy from './copy.json'

/** Every user-facing string of DASH AI is in copy.json: t('screen.title'), t('key', { count }). */
export const t = makeCopy('dash', copy)
```

### `src/flows/dash/data.ts`

```ts
// DASH AI · Trading rules — sample data and the shapes the app needs from the DASH API.
import { inr } from '../../shared/data/format'
import { user } from '../../shared/data/user'

/** First name for DASH's greeting ("Hello, Rohan!"). The fictional user every flow uses. */
export const firstName = user.name.split(' ')[0]

/** Example prompts on the rules landing, in two sideways-scrolling rows. Tapping one sends it as the message. */
/** The top suggestions on the empty chat (primary layout: a vertical list just above the input). */
export const topSuggestions: string[] = ["Don't let me overtrade", 'Set Max daily loss to save more', 'Cut losing trades automatically']

export const examplePrompts: string[][] = [
  ["Don't let me overtrade", 'Max daily loss', 'Limit my number of trades'],
  ['Limit my position size', 'Cut losing trades automatically', 'Protect my profits'],
]

/** A follow-up DASH asks before it can build the rule: a few suggested answers, or the user types one. */
export type RuleQuestion = {
  question: string
  options: string[]
  /** Free-text answer allowed (the "Type your answer" row). */
  freeText: boolean
}

export const dailyLossQuestion: RuleQuestion = {
  question: 'At what daily loss should I step in?',
  options: ['₹2,000', '₹5,000', '₹10,000'],
  freeText: true,
}

/**
 * What a backtest of the rule on the user's last 3 months of trades says.
 * - saved: the rule would have stopped losses — `amount` saved.
 * - cost: the rule would have stopped trades that ended in profit — `amount` of profit missed ("weak rule").
 * - none: not enough trading history to test it.
 */
export type Backtest =
  | { result: 'saved'; amount: number; months: number }
  | { result: 'cost'; amount: number; months: number }
  | { result: 'none' }

export type DraftRule = {
  title: string
  /** The value the user picked (shown as a chip on the preview card). */
  value: string
  /** One sentence on what the rule does. */
  description: string
}

export const maxDailyLoss: DraftRule = {
  title: 'Max daily loss',
  value: '₹5,000',
  description: 'This rule will help prevent revenge trading by stopping you once your daily losses reach ₹5,000.',
}

export const backtests = {
  saved: { result: 'saved', amount: 18400, months: 3 },
  cost: { result: 'cost', amount: 22390, months: 3 },
  none: { result: 'none' },
} satisfies Record<string, Backtest>

/** A rule the user has saved (Active rules list). `on` = DASH is watching it. */
export type SavedRule = {
  id: string
  title: string
  /** One line: what it does, at what limit. */
  summary: string
  /** Version 2: made by DASH from the user's trading (the "Smart Rule ⓘ" tag). */
  smart?: boolean
  on: boolean
  /** What happened lately / when it was made — the card's footer line. `strong` is the part in bold. */
  activity: { text: string; strong?: string; after?: string }
  /** What Activity says once it's turned off, when that's different (e.g. an indicator taken off its chart). */
  activityOff?: { text: string; strong?: string; after?: string }
}

export const activeRules: SavedRule[] = [
  { id: 'max-daily-loss', title: 'Max daily loss', summary: 'Warns at ₹2,000', on: true, activity: { text: 'Created on 30 Jul’26' } },
  { id: 'lot-size-cap', title: 'Lot size cap', summary: 'Max 4 lots per order', on: false, activity: { text: 'Stepped in ', strong: '3 times', after: ' this month' } },
  { id: 'daily-trade-limit', title: 'Daily trade limit', summary: 'This rule will help prevent overtrading by stopping you once your daily trade count reaches 5.', on: true, activity: { text: 'Hit the limit ', strong: '2 days', after: ' this month' } },
  { id: 'cut-losers', title: 'Cut losers', summary: 'Exits any position at −8%', on: true, activity: { text: 'Saved ', strong: '₹6,200', after: ' this month' } },
]

/** After deleting "Max daily loss". */
export const rulesAfterDelete = activeRules.filter((r) => r.id !== 'max-daily-loss')

/**
 * Version 2 · Created with DASH: the user's saved indicators (same shape as a rule — `on` = on the chart in Scalper).
 * Strategies: none yet (that tab shows its empty state).
 */
export const savedIndicators: SavedRule[] = [
  { id: 'supertrend-ema', title: 'Supertrend (10, 3) with EMA 20', summary: 'On the price chart · 15 min candles', on: true, activity: { text: 'On your ', strong: 'Nifty 50', after: ' chart' }, activityOff: { text: 'Removed from your ', strong: 'Nifty 50', after: ' chart' } },
  { id: 'opening-range', title: '15-min opening range', summary: 'Marks the first 15 minutes’ high and low', on: false, activity: { text: 'Created on 22 Oct’26' } },
]
export const savedStrategies: SavedRule[] = []

/** Version 2 · the user's rules as the live app shows them (titles, wording, on / off and dates from its screens). */
export const dashRules: SavedRule[] = [
  { id: 'day-pnl-gate', title: 'Day P&L Gate at 5% Opening balance', summary: 'When your Day P&L, closed trades and open positions together, is down 5% of your opening balance, you’ll see a warning before you place a new entry order.', on: true, activity: { text: 'Created on 26 Oct’26' } },
  { id: 'expiry-day-entry', title: 'Expiry Day Options Entry Warning', summary: 'You’ll see a warning when you try to place a new entry order for an option on its expiry day.', on: true, activity: { text: 'Created on 22 Oct’26' } },
  { id: 'day-profit-5000', title: 'Day Profit Hits ₹5,000', summary: 'You’ll get a push notification even when the app is closed, and you’ll see a warning the next time you place a new entry order when your day’s profit, closed trades and open positions together, hits ₹5,000.', on: true, activity: { text: 'Created on 22 Oct’26' } },
  { id: 'options-sl-target', title: 'Options Need Stop-Loss And Target', summary: 'You’ll see a warning when you place a new options entry order without a stop-loss and a target.', on: false, activity: { text: 'Created on 22 Oct’26' } },
  { id: 'time-held-3m', title: 'Time held reaches 3 minutes', summary: 'You’ll get a push notification when an options position has been open for 3 minutes.', on: false, activity: { text: 'Created on 22 Oct’26' } },
  { id: 'wallet-25', title: '25% wallet balance lost reminder', summary: 'You’ll see an alert in the app when your day P&L is down 25% of the balance in your wallet.', on: false, smart: true, activity: { text: 'Created on 21 Oct’26' } },
  { id: 'exit-40', title: 'Exit Reminder at 40% loss', summary: 'You’ll see an alert in the app whenever an open position is down 40%.', on: false, smart: true, activity: { text: 'Created on 21 Oct’26' } },
  { id: 'sl-15', title: 'SL Reminder at 15% loss', summary: 'You’ll see an alert in the app whenever an open position is down 15%.', on: false, smart: true, activity: { text: 'Created on 21 Oct’26' } },
]

/** ₹ with Indian grouping, no paise: 18400 → "₹18,400". */
export const rupees = (n: number) => inr(n, 0)

/**
 * Past chats (DASH's history button, dash-30): every chat with DASH, newest first. `saved` = what the chat built (its
 * rule / indicator) was saved; `false` = left before saving (a draft). `edited` = when it was last touched, for drafts.
 */
export type PastChat = { id: string; kind: 'rule' | 'indicator'; title: string; day: 'today' | 'yesterday' | 'earlier'; time: string; saved: boolean; edited?: string }
export const pastChats: PastChat[] = [
  { id: 'chat-supertrend', kind: 'indicator', title: 'Supertrend (10, 3) with EMA 20', day: 'today', time: '2 hours ago', saved: false, edited: 'Edited 2 hr ago' },
  { id: 'chat-cooldown', kind: 'rule', title: 'Expiry Day Options Entry Warning', day: 'today', time: '9:20 am', saved: true },
  { id: 'chat-max-loss', kind: 'rule', title: 'Max daily loss at ₹5,000', day: 'yesterday', time: '6:45 pm', saved: false, edited: 'Edited yesterday' },
  { id: 'chat-rsi', kind: 'indicator', title: 'RSI 14 with overbought at 70', day: 'yesterday', time: '11:02 am', saved: true },
  { id: 'chat-overtrade', kind: 'rule', title: 'Stop after 5 trades a day', day: 'earlier', time: '24 Oct', saved: true },
  { id: 'chat-vwap', kind: 'indicator', title: 'VWAP with 2 bands', day: 'earlier', time: '21 Oct', saved: true },
  { id: 'chat-revenge', kind: 'rule', title: 'Pause 30 min after a loss of ₹2,000', day: 'earlier', time: '18 Oct', saved: true },
]

/** A "Pick up where you left off" card on the home. */
export type HomeDraft = { id: string; kind: 'rule' | 'indicator'; title: string; meta: string; /** Compact card's green line. */ edited: string }
/**
 * Pick up where you left off = only the past chats whose rule / indicator was NOT saved (newest first). A chat whose
 * creation was saved never shows here — it lives in Your creations, and the chat stays reachable from Past chats.
 */
export const homeDrafts: HomeDraft[] = pastChats
  .filter((c) => !c.saved)
  .map((c) => {
    const edited = c.edited ?? c.time
    return { id: c.id, kind: c.kind, title: c.title, meta: `Draft, not saved · ${edited.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${edited.slice(1)}`, edited }
  })
export type HomeEvent = { id: string; kind: 'rule' | 'indicator'; text: string; time: string }
export const homeEvents: HomeEvent[] = [
  { id: 'cooldown-stop', kind: 'rule', text: 'Expiry Day Options Entry Warning stopped a new entry', time: '11:42' },
  { id: 'st-buy', kind: 'indicator', text: 'Supertrend gave a BUY on Nifty 50', time: '10:15' },
  { id: 'pnl-gate', kind: 'rule', text: 'Day P&L Gate warned you at −4.8%', time: 'Yesterday' },
]
/** How many times each rule stepped in today (sample; missing = none). */
export const homeTriggers: Record<string, number> = { 'day-pnl-gate': 2, 'expiry-day-entry': 1 }
```

### `src/flows/dash/indicatorData.ts`

```ts
// DASH AI · Custom indicators — sample data, the questions DASH asks, and the maths the mini chart draws.
// The indicator values are really computed (EMA, Supertrend) on sample candles, so the preview looks like the real
// thing. In the app, the candles come from the chart's own data feed.
import type { RuleQuestion } from './data'

/** Example prompts on the empty indicator chat (simple, plain words — no formulas). */
export const indicatorPrompts: string[][] = [
  ['Supertrend with a 20 EMA', 'Show the trend with a 50-day average'],
  ['Mark the 15-minute opening range', 'Highlight candles with 2× average volume'],
]

/** What DASH may ask before building — only what the request didn't say. */
export type IndicatorAsk = 'chart' | 'timeframe'

/**
 * Version 2's three example requests — one per case: everything said (DASH asks nothing and builds), no timeframe
 * (DASH asks the timeframe), no chart (DASH asks where it goes). `chart` / `timeframe` are what the request already says.
 */
export type IndicatorPrompt = { text: string; asks: IndicatorAsk[]; chart: string; timeframe: string }
export const indicatorPromptsV2: IndicatorPrompt[] = [
  { text: 'Supertrend with a 20 EMA on Nifty 50', asks: ['timeframe'], chart: 'Nifty 50', timeframe: '15 min' },
  { text: 'Supertrend with a 20 EMA on 15-min candles', asks: ['chart'], chart: 'Nifty 50', timeframe: '15 min' },
  { text: 'Supertrend with a 20 EMA on any 15-min chart', asks: [], chart: 'any chart', timeframe: '15 min' },
]

/** What DASH asks before building (only what the prompt didn't say). */
export const chartQuestion: RuleQuestion = {
  question: 'Which chart should it go on?',
  options: ['Nifty 50', 'Bank Nifty', 'Any chart I open'],
  freeText: false,
}

export const timeframeQuestion: RuleQuestion = {
  question: 'Which timeframe?',
  options: ['5 min', '15 min', '1 hour', '1 day'],
  freeText: false,
}

/** The indicator DASH builds from the sample prompt. */
export type IndicatorDraft = {
  name: string
  /** What it draws, as chips: lines and labels. */
  parts: { kind: 'line' | 'label'; label: string; tone: 'trend' | 'average' | 'buy' | 'sell' }[]
  /** "On the price chart · checked on 500 candles". */
  placement: string
  testedOn: number
  /** DASH's notes from testing — things worth knowing before using it. */
  notes: string[]
}

export const supertrendEma: IndicatorDraft = {
  name: 'Supertrend (10, 3) with EMA 20',
  parts: [
    { kind: 'line', label: 'Supertrend', tone: 'trend' },
    { kind: 'line', label: 'EMA 20', tone: 'average' },
    { kind: 'label', label: 'BUY', tone: 'buy' },
    { kind: 'label', label: 'SELL', tone: 'sell' },
  ],
  placement: 'On the price chart',
  testedOn: 500,
  notes: [
    'It gave 14 buy and 13 sell signals on the last 500 candles, about one a day on 15 min.',
    'In sideways markets the trend flips often; the 20 EMA helps you spot those stretches.',
  ],
}

/**
 * What the preview chart is drawn with — the parts a plain-words change can tune: the candle timeframe (minutes), the
 * EMA's length and the Supertrend's ATR period and multiplier.
 */
export type IndicatorSettings = { timeframe: number; emaPeriod: number; stPeriod: number; stMultiplier: number; /** A name the user gave it (rename). */ name?: string }
export const defaultSettings: IndicatorSettings = { timeframe: 15, emaPeriod: 20, stPeriod: 10, stMultiplier: 3 }

/** "15 min" / "1 hour" / "1 day" (the timeframe question's answers) → minutes. Unknown → 15. */
export function minutesOf(label: string): number {
  const m = label.toLowerCase().match(/(\d+)\s*(min|hour|day)/)
  if (!m) return 15
  return Number(m[1]) * (m[2] === 'hour' ? 60 : m[2] === 'day' ? 1440 : 1)
}

/** Minutes → how people say it: "20 min", "1 hour", "2 hours", "1 day". */
export function timeframeLabel(minutes: number): string {
  if (minutes % 1440 === 0) return minutes === 1440 ? '1 day' : `${minutes / 1440} days`
  if (minutes % 60 === 0) return minutes === 60 ? '1 hour' : `${minutes / 60} hours`
  return `${minutes} min`
}

/** Minutes → the chart corner's short form: "20m", "1h", "1D". */
export function timeframeShort(minutes: number): string {
  if (minutes % 1440 === 0) return `${minutes / 1440}D`
  if (minutes % 60 === 0) return `${minutes / 60}h`
  return `${minutes}m`
}

/** The indicator as the card shows it, for these settings (name, the EMA chip, the notes' timeframe). */
export function draftFor(settings: IndicatorSettings): IndicatorDraft {
  const { emaPeriod, stPeriod, stMultiplier, timeframe } = settings
  return {
    ...supertrendEma,
    name: settings.name ?? `Supertrend (${stPeriod}, ${stMultiplier}) with EMA ${emaPeriod}`,
    parts: supertrendEma.parts.map((p) => (p.tone === 'average' ? { ...p, label: `EMA ${emaPeriod}` } : p)),
    notes: [
      `It gave 14 buy and 13 sell signals on the last 500 candles, about one a day on ${timeframeLabel(timeframe)}.`,
      `In sideways markets the trend flips often; the ${emaPeriod} EMA helps you spot those stretches.`,
    ],
  }
}

/**
 * What a typed change touched. 'other': a change the prototype can't read — it's accepted anyway (there's no real
 * DASH behind it), the chart redrawn as it was.
 */
export type IndicatorChange = { settings: IndicatorSettings; changed: ('timeframe' | 'ema' | 'supertrend' | 'name' | 'other')[] }

/**
 * Reads a plain-words change — "make the time period 20 minutes", "EMA 50", "50-day average", "supertrend 7, 2",
 * "multiplier 2" — into new settings. The prototype's stand-in for DASH understanding the request.
 */
export function applyChange(settings: IndicatorSettings, text: string): IndicatorChange {
  // A rename ("Change the indicator name to: My trend") only renames.
  const renamed = text.match(/name\s+(?:it\s+)?to\s*:?\s*(.+)$/i)?.[1]?.trim()
  if (renamed) return { settings: { ...settings, name: renamed }, changed: ['name'] }
  let rest = ` ${text.toLowerCase()} `
  const next = { ...settings }
  const changed: IndicatorChange['changed'] = []
  // The EMA first ("50-day average" is the EMA, not a 50-day timeframe); its number is then taken out of the text.
  const ema = rest.match(/(?:ema|average)\D{0,12}?(\d+)/) ?? rest.match(/(\d+)\s*-?\s*(?:(?:day|period|candle)s?\s*)?(?:ema|average)/)
  if (ema) {
    next.emaPeriod = Number(ema[1])
    changed.push('ema')
    rest = rest.replace(ema[0], ' ')
  }
  const st = rest.match(/supertrend\D{0,12}?(\d+)(?:\s*[,x×/ ]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?))?/)
  const mult = rest.match(/multiplier\D{0,8}?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/)
  if (st || mult) {
    if (st) next.stPeriod = Number(st[1])
    if (st?.[2]) next.stMultiplier = Number(st[2])
    if (mult) next.stMultiplier = Number(mult[1])
    changed.push('supertrend')
    rest = rest.replace(st?.[0] ?? '', ' ').replace(mult?.[0] ?? '', ' ')
  }
  const tf = rest.match(/(\d+)\s*-?\s*(minutes?|mins?|m|hours?|hrs?|h|days?|d)\b/)
  if (tf) {
    const unit = tf[2][0]
    next.timeframe = Number(tf[1]) * (unit === 'h' ? 60 : unit === 'd' ? 1440 : 1)
    changed.push('timeframe')
  }
  const valid = next.timeframe > 0 && next.emaPeriod > 1 && next.stPeriod > 0 && next.stMultiplier > 0
  // Prototype: every change is accepted. One it can't read keeps the settings and is shown as made ('other').
  return valid && changed.length ? { settings: next, changed } : { settings, changed: ['other'] }
}

/** The steps DASH shows while it builds. */
export const buildSteps = ['Reading your request', 'Writing the logic', 'Testing it on 500 candles'] as const
/** …and while it rebuilds a Pine Script for Lemonn charts. */
export const pineBuildSteps = ['Reading your Pine Script', 'Matching its inputs and plots', 'Testing it on 500 candles'] as const

/** Pasted text that reads like Pine Script (its version line, or an indicator / strategy / plot call). */
export function looksLikePine(text: string) {
  return /\/\/@version|\b(indicator|strategy|study)\s*\(|\bplot(shape)?\s*\(|\bta\.\w+\s*\(/.test(text)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sample candles + indicator maths

export type Candle = { open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number }

/**
 * 60 sample candles around Nifty's level — a deterministic random walk (the same every time for one timeframe; another
 * timeframe gets its own walk, and longer candles move more).
 */
export function sampleCandles(count = 60, start = 22650, timeframe = 15, walk = 0): Candle[] {
  let seed = 7 + (timeframe === 15 ? 0 : timeframe * 31) + walk * 977
  const scale = Math.sqrt(timeframe / 15) * (start / 22650)
  const rand = () => ((seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647)
  const candles: Candle[] = []
  let close = start
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const drift = Math.sin(i / 5) * 9 * scale // gentle swings, so the trend flips a few times
    const open = close
    close = open + drift + (rand() - 0.5) * 28 * scale
    const high = Math.max(open, close) + rand() * 12 * scale
    const low = Math.min(open, close) - rand() * 12 * scale
    candles.push({ open, high, low, close })
  }
  return candles
}

/**
 * The F&O indices the indicator can be tried on (the card's picker, like Scalper's): each has its own price level and
 * its own sample walk. Sample data.
 */
export type Market = { id: string; name: string; start: number; walk: number }
export const markets: Market[] = [
  { id: 'nifty', name: 'NIFTY 50', start: 22650, walk: 0 },
  { id: 'banknifty', name: 'BANK NIFTY', start: 48250, walk: 1 },
  { id: 'sensex', name: 'SENSEX', start: 74480, walk: 2 },
  { id: 'finnifty', name: 'FINNIFTY', start: 21390, walk: 3 },
  { id: 'midcpnifty', name: 'MIDCPNIFTY', start: 12310, walk: 4 },
]

/** Exponential moving average of the closes. */
export function ema(candles: Candle[], period: number): number[] {
  const k = 2 / (period + 1)
  const out: number[] = []
  candles.forEach((c, i) => out.push(i === 0 ? c.close : c.close * k + out[i - 1] * (1 - k)))
  return out
}

/** Supertrend (ATR period, multiplier): the line and its direction per candle; a flip is a buy / sell signal. */
export function supertrend(candles: Candle[], period = 10, multiplier = 3) {
  const tr = candles.map((c, i) => (i === 0 ? c.high - c.low : Math.max(c.high - c.low, Math.abs(c.high - candles[i - 1].close), Math.abs(c.low - candles[i - 1].close))))
  const atr: number[] = []
  tr.forEach((t, i) => atr.push(i === 0 ? t : (atr[i - 1] * (period - 1) + t) / period))
  const line: number[] = []
  const up: boolean[] = []
  let upper = 0
  let lower = 0
  candles.forEach((c, i) => {
    const mid = (c.high + c.low) / 2
    const bu = mid + multiplier * atr[i]
    const bl = mid - multiplier * atr[i]
    const prevClose = i ? candles[i - 1].close : c.close
    upper = i && (bu < upper || prevClose > upper) ? bu : i ? upper : bu
    lower = i && (bl > lower || prevClose < lower) ? bl : i ? lower : bl
    const wasUp = i ? up[i - 1] : true
    const isUp = wasUp ? c.close >= lower : c.close > upper
    up.push(isUp)
    line.push(isUp ? lower : upper)
  })
  const signals = up.flatMap((u, i) => (i > 0 && u !== up[i - 1] ? [{ index: i, side: u ? ('buy' as const) : ('sell' as const) }] : []))
  return { line, up, signals }
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/screens/ActiveRules.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Switch } from '@l3/components/Switch'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msInfo } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { t } from '../copy'
import { dashRules, savedIndicators, savedStrategies, type SavedRule } from '../data'
import { Creations } from './Creations'
import styles from './ActiveRules.module.css'

type ActiveRulesProps = {
  rules: SavedRule[]
  /** Version 2: Create on the AI Indicators tab. */
  onCreateIndicator?: () => void
  /** Version 2 · card style New: the details' Edit with DASH / Add to chart. */
  onAddToChart?: () => void
  onEditIndicator?: () => void
  onEditRule?: () => void
  onBack?: () => void
  onDelete?: (rule: SavedRule) => void
  onCreate?: () => void
  sheet?: ReactNode
}

/**
 * Trading rules — the user's saved rules (Figma "Active rules" 5612:42076): one L3 card per rule — its initial, name,
 * what it does and an on / off switch; the footer says what the rule did lately, with Delete. Create New in the dock.
 */
export function ActiveRules({ rules, onBack, onDelete, onCreate, onCreateIndicator, onAddToChart, onEditIndicator, onEditRule, sheet }: ActiveRulesProps) {
  // The history page: everything made with DASH, tabbed (Creations). The older "Trading rules" list (History V1) is in
  // archive/dash-history-versions.
  return <Creations rules={dashRules} indicators={savedIndicators} strategies={savedStrategies} onBack={onBack} onDeleteRule={onDelete} onCreateRule={onCreate} onCreateIndicator={onCreateIndicator} onAddToChart={onAddToChart} onEditIndicator={onEditIndicator} onEditRule={onEditRule} sheet={sheet} />
}

/**
 * One saved strategy on the history page (strategies don't have the simple card yet): leading mark, name, what it
 * does, a switch; footer: activity + Delete. (The older rule / indicator cards: archive/dash-history-versions.)
 */
export function RuleItem({ rule, onDelete, leading, hideLeading = false, toggleLabel }: { rule: SavedRule; onDelete: () => void; /** Default: the name's initial. */ leading?: ReactNode; hideLeading?: boolean; /** The switch's name (default "{name} on"). */ toggleLabel?: string }) {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(rule.on)
  const { text, strong, after } = rule.activity
  const activity = (
    <>
      {text}
      {strong && <strong>{strong}</strong>}
      {after}
    </>
  )
  const mark = hideLeading ? undefined : (leading ?? <Avatar initials={rule.title.charAt(0)} size={40} />)
  const title = rule.smart ? (
    <Stack gap="04" align="start">
      <Tag color="success" size="sm" iconRight={<Icon icon={msInfo} size={14} />}>{t('rules.smart')}</Tag>
      <span>{rule.title}</span>
    </Stack>
  ) : (
    rule.title
  )
  const toggle = <Switch checked={on} onChange={(e) => setOn(e.target.checked)} aria-label={toggleLabel ?? t('rules.toggleLabel', { name: rule.title })} />

  return (
    <Card
      as="li"
      padding="none"
      footerFilled
      footer={
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="12" className={styles.footer}>
          <p className={styles.activity}>{activity}</p>
          <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={onDelete} aria-label={t('rules.deleteLabel', { name: rule.title })}>
            {t('rules.delete')}
          </Button>
        </Stack>
      }
    >
      <Inset style={{ height: 'fit-content' }} paddingInline="12">
        <ListCell className={styles.cell} iconLeft={mark} label={title} multiline description={<span className={styles.summary}>{rule.summary}</span>} trailing={toggle} />
      </Inset>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/dash/screens/Creations.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Aerobar } from '@l3/components/Aerobar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { EmptyState } from '@l3/components/EmptyState'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Inset } from '@l3/components/Inset'
import { SectionHeader } from '@l3/components/SectionHeader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msAdd } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { Screen } from '../../../shared/ui/Screen'
import { t } from '../copy'
import type { SavedRule } from '../data'
import { CreationDetailsSheet, DeleteRuleSheet } from '../sheets/RuleSheets'
import { takeHistoryTab } from '../components/historyFilter'
import { RuleItem } from './ActiveRules'
import { SimpleCreationCard } from './SimpleCreationCard'
import styles from './Creations.module.css'

type Kind = 'rules' | 'indicators' | 'strategies'
type Tab = 'all' | Kind

type CreationsProps = {
  rules: SavedRule[]
  indicators: SavedRule[]
  strategies: SavedRule[]
  onBack?: () => void
  /** Version 1's rule-delete screens (unused here: Version 2 confirms in its own sheet). */
  onDeleteRule?: (rule: SavedRule) => void
  onCreateRule?: () => void
  onCreateIndicator?: () => void
  /** Card style "New" · details: Edit with DASH (a rule / an indicator) and Add to chart (an indicator). */
  onAddToChart?: () => void
  /** An indicator's Edit (details sheet): opens it in the DASH chat, ready to change. */
  onEditIndicator?: () => void
  /** A rule's Edit (details sheet): opens it in the rules chat, ready to change. */
  onEditRule?: () => void
  /** Version 1's sheets over this screen (unused here: Version 2 opens its own details / delete sheets). */
  sheet?: ReactNode
}

/**
 * Version 2 · Created with DASH — everything the user made with DASH, on a plain screen (L3 Actionbar, no DASH
 * background): pill tabs in the Actionbar's bottom slot filter it — All · AI Rules · AI Indicators · AI Strategies.
 * All shows a section per kind that has something; a tab (or All) with nothing shows the L3 empty state with a way to
 * create one. Rules and indicators are the same card — the name's initial in an L3 Avatar, a switch (on / on the chart), footer: activity + Delete.
 * Create New in the dock makes the kind of the tab (All → a rule).
 */
export function Creations({ rules, indicators, strategies, onBack, onDeleteRule, onCreateRule, onCreateIndicator, onAddToChart, onEditIndicator, onEditRule, sheet }: CreationsProps) {
  // Opened from the home's View all on rules / indicators: that tab; otherwise All.
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>(takeHistoryTab)
  const [ruleList, setRuleList] = useState(rules)
  const [list, setList] = useState(indicators)
  // One sheet at a time: a creation's details (its ›) or the delete confirmation (rule or indicator).
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<{ kind: 'details' | 'delete'; item: SavedRule; of: 'rules' | 'indicators' } | null>(null)
  // On / off per item (New): kept here so the toast can undo a toggle.
  const [onMap, setOnMap] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => Object.fromEntries([...rules, ...indicators].map((r) => [r.id, r.on])))
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ key: number; heading: string; undo: () => void } | null>(null)
  const toggle = (item: SavedRule, of: 'rules' | 'indicators', on: boolean) => {
    const was = onMap[item.id]
    setOnMap((m) => ({ ...m, [item.id]: on }))
    const heading = of === 'rules' ? (on ? t('cards.ruleOn') : t('cards.rulePaused')) : on ? t('cards.indicatorOn') : t('cards.indicatorOff')
    setToast({ key: Date.now(), heading, undo: () => { setOnMap((m) => ({ ...m, [item.id]: was })); setToast(null) } })
  }
  // What's on comes first (by how they were when the screen opened, so cards don't jump while you toggle).
  const activeFirst = (list: SavedRule[]) => [...list].sort((a, b) => Number(b.on) - Number(a.on))
  const counts: Record<Kind, number> = { rules: ruleList.length, indicators: list.length, strategies: strategies.length }
  const kinds: Kind[] = tab === 'all' ? (['rules', 'indicators', 'strategies'] as Kind[]).filter((k) => counts[k] > 0) : [tab]
  const create = tab === 'indicators' ? onCreateIndicator : tab === 'strategies' ? undefined : onCreateRule

  const section = (kind: Kind) => {
    // Rules and indicators: the simple card — status and name on the left, the switch on the right; the name opens the
    // details. (Older card versions: archive/dash-history-versions.)
    if (kind !== 'strategies') {
      const of = kind
      const f = filter[of]
      return activeFirst(of === 'rules' ? ruleList : list)
        .filter((r) => f === 'all' || (onMap[r.id] ?? r.on) === (f === 'on'))
        .map((r) => (
          <SimpleCreationCard key={r.id} item={r} kind={of === 'rules' ? 'rule' : 'indicator'} on={onMap[r.id] ?? r.on} onToggle={(on) => toggle(r, of, on)} onOpen={() => setOpen({ kind: 'details', item: r, of })} />
        ))
    }
    return strategies.map((r) => <RuleItem key={r.id} rule={r} onDelete={() => {}} />)
  }

  // New: "3 active · 5 paused" (indicators: "1 on chart · 1 off") under each section's title.
  const status = (kind: 'rules' | 'indicators') => {
    const items = kind === 'rules' ? ruleList : list
    const on = items.filter((r) => onMap[r.id] ?? r.on).length
    return kind === 'rules' ? t('cards.rulesStatus', { on, off: items.length - on }) : t('cards.indicatorsStatus', { on, off: items.length - on })
  }

  // Quick filter per section (the header's switcher, a tap moves on): All → Active → Paused (indicators: All → On chart
  // → Not on chart), each with its count.
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Record<'rules' | 'indicators', 'all' | 'on' | 'off'>>({ rules: 'all', indicators: 'all' })
  const nextFilter = { all: 'on', on: 'off', off: 'all' } as const
  const filterLabel = (kind: 'rules' | 'indicators') => {
    const items = kind === 'rules' ? ruleList : list
    const on = items.filter((r) => onMap[r.id] ?? r.on).length
    const f = filter[kind]
    const count = f === 'all' ? items.length : f === 'on' ? on : items.length - on
    return t(`creations.filter.${kind}.${f}`, { count })
  }

  const empty = kinds.length === 0 || kinds.every((k) => counts[k] === 0)
  const emptyKey = tab === 'all' ? 'All' : tab === 'rules' ? 'Rules' : tab === 'indicators' ? 'Indicators' : 'Strategies'
  const emptyAction = tab === 'rules' || tab === 'all' ? { label: t('creations.createRule'), on: onCreateRule } : tab === 'indicators' ? { label: t('creations.createIndicator'), on: onCreateIndicator } : { label: t('creations.createStrategy'), on: undefined }

  return (
    <Screen
      toast={toast && <Aerobar key={toast.key} floating type="primary" emphasis="primary" heading={toast.heading} action={{ label: t('cards.undo'), onClick: toast.undo }} duration={4000} onDismiss={() => setToast(null)} />}
      top={
        <Actionbar
          title={t('creations.title')}
          onBack={onBack}
          bottom={
            <Tabs
              aria-label={t('creations.tabs')}
              appearance="pill"
              value={tab}
              onChange={(v) => setTab(v as Tab)}
              items={[
                { value: 'all', label: t('creations.all') },
                { value: 'rules', label: t('creations.rules') },
                { value: 'indicators', label: t('creations.indicators') },
                { value: 'strategies', label: t('creations.strategies') },
              ]}
            />
          }
        />
      }
      bottom={
        !empty && (
          <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('creations.title')}>
            <Button iconLeft={<Icon icon={msAdd} />} onClick={create} disabled={!create}>{t('rules.createNew')}</Button>
          </ButtonGroup>
        )
      }
      sheet={
        open?.kind === 'details' ? (
          <CreationDetailsSheet
            item={open.item}
            kind={open.of === 'rules' ? 'rule' : 'indicator'}
            on={onMap[open.item.id] ?? open.item.on}
            onToggle={(on) => toggle(open.item, open.of === 'rules' ? 'rules' : 'indicators', on)}
            onClose={() => setOpen(null)}
            onEdit={open.of === 'rules' ? onEditRule : onEditIndicator}
            onDelete={() => setOpen({ kind: 'delete', item: open.item, of: open.of })}
          />
        ) : open?.kind === 'delete' ? (
          <DeleteRuleSheet
            large
            rule={open.item}
            heading={open.of === 'rules' ? t('creations.deleteRule') : t('creations.deleteIndicator')}
            onNo={() => setOpen(null)}
            onYes={() => {
              const gone = (l: SavedRule[]) => l.filter((r) => r.id !== open.item.id)
              if (open.of === 'rules') setRuleList(gone)
              else setList(gone)
              setOpen(null)
            }}
          />
        ) : null
      }
    >
      {empty ? (
        <div className={styles.empty}>
          <EmptyState
            title={t(`creations.empty${emptyKey}`)}
            description={t(`creations.empty${emptyKey}Text`)}
            action={<Button variant="primary" size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msAdd} />} onClick={emptyAction.on} disabled={!emptyAction.on}>{emptyAction.label}</Button>}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Inset paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="24">
          <Stack gap="24">
            {kinds.map((kind) => (
              <Stack as="section" gap="16" key={kind} aria-label={t(`creations.${kind}Count`, { count: counts[kind] })}>
                <SectionHeader
                  title={t(`creations.${kind}Count`, { count: counts[kind] })}
                  action={
                    kind !== 'strategies'
                      ? { type: 'switcher', label: filterLabel(kind), onClick: () => setFilter((f) => ({ ...f, [kind]: nextFilter[f[kind]] })), 'aria-label': t('creations.filterLabel', { label: filterLabel(kind) }) }
                      : undefined
                  }
                />
                <Stack as="ul" gap="16" className={styles.list}>{section(kind)}</Stack>
              </Stack>
            ))}
          </Stack>
        </Inset>
      )}
    </Screen>
  )
}
```
